x: The Master was gentle yet stern, commanding yet not fierce, respectful yet at ease. 孔子温和而又严正，有威仪而不凶猛，恭敬而又安详。 明孔子德也。 先生极温和，而严厉。

t: Taibo may be called a man of the highest virtue!
y: 子曰：泰伯，其可谓至德也已矣！三以天下让，民无得而称焉。
x: The Master said: Taibo may be called a man of the highest virtue! Three times he declined the realm, and the people could find no words to praise him. 孔子说：泰伯，可算是德行到了顶点了！他再三把天下让出去，让得不露痕迹，百姓竟找不出话来称颂他。 云泰伯其可謂至德也已矣者，泰伯，周太王之長子也。 泰伯，那可以说是品德极崇高了。 泰伯可称为至德了。

t: Respect without ritual becomes toil
y: 子曰：恭而无礼则劳，慎而无礼则葸，勇而无礼则乱，直而无礼则绞。君子笃于亲，则民兴于仁；故旧不遗，则民不偷。
x: The Master said: Respect without ritual becomes toil; caution without ritual becomes timidity; courage without ritual becomes disorder; straightness without ritual becomes harshness. When the gentleman is devoted to his kin, the people rise to humaneness; when old friends are not forgotten, the people are not cold. 孔子说：只讲恭敬而不以礼节制，就劳苦不堪；只讲谨慎而不以礼节制，就畏缩怯懦；只讲勇敢而不以礼节制，就会闯祸作乱；只讲直率而不以礼节制，就尖刻逼人。在上位的人厚待亲族，百姓就会兴起仁风；不丢下故交旧人，百姓的风气就不会淡薄。 此章明行事悉須禮以為節也。 注重容貌态度的端庄，却不知礼，就未免劳倦；只知谨慎，… 恭而没有礼，便会劳扰不安。

t: Zengzi was ill and called his disciples: Uncover my feet!
y: 曾子有疾，召门弟子曰：启予足！启予手！诗云战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰。而今而后，吾知免夫！小子！
x: Zengzi was ill and called his disciples: Uncover my feet! Uncover my hands! The Odes say: 'Fearful and careful, as if near a deep abyss, as if treading thin ice.' From now on, I know I am spared, my young friends! 曾子病重，把学生们叫到跟前，说：把被子揭开，瞧瞧我的两脚！瞧瞧我的两手！《诗经》上讲：“小心谨慎，好像站在深潭边上，好像踩在薄冰上面。”从今往后，我知道自己可以免于毁伤了！孩子们！ 云曾子有疾者，疾，病也。 《诗经》上说：‘小心呀！ 看看我的手和足吧！

t: Zengzi was ill and Meng Jingzi came to ask after him
y: 曾子有疾，孟敬子问之。曾子言曰：鸟之将死，其鸣也哀；人之将死，其言也善。君子所贵乎道者三：动容貌，斯远暴慢矣；正颜色，斯近信矣；出辞气，斯远鄙倍矣。笾豆之事，则有司存。
x: Zengzi was ill and Meng Jingzi came to ask after him. Zengzi said: When a bird is about to die, its cry is mournful; when a man is about to die, his words are good. There are three things in the Way that a gentleman values: in his bearing, he keeps far from violence and insolence; in setting his countenance, he comes near to good faith; in his words and tone, he keeps far from vulgarity and impropriety. As for the matters of ritual vessels, there are officers for that. 曾子病重，孟敬子来探问。曾子开口说：鸟快死时，叫声凄哀；人快死时，说的话也良善。君子看重的修身之道有三条：举止容貌端庄，就能远离粗暴与怠慢；神色端正，就近于诚实可信；说话注意言辞语气，就能远离鄙陋与悖理。至于祭器陈设那些细务，自有专管的小吏。 云曾子有疾孟敬子問疾者，孟敬子，魯大夫仲孫捷也。 曾参病了，孟敬子探问他。 曾子得了重病，孟敬子来问病。

t: Able, yet asking those less able
y: 曾子曰：以能问于不能，以多问于寡；有若无，实若虚；犯而不校。昔者吾友尝从事于斯矣。
x: Zengzi said: Able, yet asking those less able; knowing much, yet asking those who know little; having, as if not having; full, as if empty; wronged, yet not retaliating — once I had a friend who lived this way. 曾子说：自己有本事，却去请教没本事的人；自己知道得多，却去请教知道得少的人；有学问像没学问，满腹充实像一无所有；受了冒犯也不跟人较量。我过去有个朋友，就曾在这些上头下功夫。 此明顏淵謙德也。 有能力却向无能力的人请教，知识丰富却向知识缺少的人请教；… 自己才能高，去问才能低于他的人。

t: One who can be entrusted with an orphaned young ruler, who can…
y: 曾子曰：可以托六尺之孤，可以寄百里之命，临大节而不可夺也。君子人与？君子人也。
x: Zengzi said: One who can be entrusted with an orphaned young ruler, who can be given charge of a state of a hundred li, and who in a great crisis cannot be swayed — is he a gentleman? He is a gentleman. 曾子说：可以把年幼的君主托付给他，可以把一国的政令交给他代管，碰上生死关头的大节，谁也不能使他动摇。这样的人算是君子吗？是君子啊。 云曾子曰可以託六尺之孤，謂童子無父而為國君者也。 可以把幼小的孤儿和国家的命脉都交付给他，… 可以把六尺的孤儿托付他，可以把百里的政令寄放于他，…

t: A scholar must be broad and resolute, for his burden is heavy…
y: 曾子曰：士不可以不弘毅，任重而道远。仁以为己任，不亦重乎？死而后已，不亦远乎？
x: Zengzi said: A scholar must be broad and resolute, for his burden is heavy and his road is long. He takes humaneness as his burden — is that not heavy? It ends only with death — is that not long? 曾子说：读书人不能不胸襟宽广、意志坚韧，因为他肩上担子重而路途远。把实现仁当作自己的责任，这担子还不重吗？到死方才放下，这路还不远吗？ 云曾子曰士不可以不弘毅者，士，通謂大夫也。 读书人不可以不刚强而有毅力，因为他负担沉重，路程遥远。 一个士，不可不弘大而强毅，因他担负重而道路远。

t: Be roused by the Odes, be established by ritual, be completed…
y: 子曰：兴于诗，立于礼。成于乐。
x: The Master said: Be roused by the Odes, be established by ritual, be completed by music. 孔子说：由读《诗》而振起向善的心，由守礼而站稳脚跟，由习乐而最终成就。 此章明人學須次第也。 诗篇使我振奋，礼使我能在社会上站得住，… 兴起在诗，卓立在礼，完成在乐。

t: The people can be made to follow it, but cannot be made to…
y: 子曰：民可使由之，不可使知之。
x: The Master said: The people can be made to follow it, but cannot be made to understand it. 孔子说：对百姓，可以让他们照着正理去做，却很难让每个人都明白其中的所以然。 此明天道深遠，非人道所知也。 老百姓，可以使他们照着我们的道路走去，… 在上者指导民众，有时只可使民众由我所指导而行，…

t: One who loves daring and hates poverty will make trouble
y: 子曰：好勇疾贫，乱也。人而不仁，疾之已甚，乱也。
x: The Master said: One who loves daring and hates poverty will make trouble. A man who is not humane, if hated too much, will make trouble. 孔子说：好逞勇力又厌恶贫困，就会生乱。对于不仁的人，憎恶得太过分，也会逼出乱子。 云好勇疾貧亂也者，好勇之人，若不能樂道自居貧賤，則此人必為亂也。 以勇敢自喜却厌恶贫困，是一种祸害。 若其民好勇，又恶贫，就易于兴乱。

t: Even with the talents and fine qualities of the Duke of Zhou…
y: 子曰：如有周公之才之美，使骄且吝，其余不足观也已。
x: The Master said: Even with the talents and fine qualities of the Duke of Zhou, if a man were arrogant and stingy, the rest would not be worth looking at. 孔子说：即便有周公那样出众的才能，只要骄傲又吝啬，其余的也就不值一看了。 周公者，周公旦也。 假如才能的美妙真比得上周公，只要骄傲而吝啬，… 若有人能有像周公的才那样美，只要他兼有着骄傲与吝啬，…

t: One who studies for three years without aiming at a salary is…
y: 子曰：三年学，不至于谷，不易得也。
x: The Master said: One who studies for three years without aiming at a salary is not easy to find. 孔子说：求学三年，心思还没有落到求官得禄上，这样的人不容易碰到。 勸人學也。 读书三年并不存做官的念头，这是难得的。 学了三年，其心还能不到谷禄上去的人，是不易得的呀！

t: Hold firmly to good faith and love learning
y: 子曰：笃信好学，守死善道。危邦不入，乱邦不居。天下有道则见，无道则隐。邦有道，贫且贱焉，耻也；邦无道，富且贵焉，耻也。
x: The Master said: Hold firmly to good faith and love learning; guard the good Way unto death. Do not enter a state in danger; do not live in a state in disorder. When the realm has the Way, show yourself; when it lacks the Way, stay hidden. When the state has the Way, to be poor and lowly is shameful; when the state lacks the Way, to be rich and honored is shameful. 孔子说：坚定地信守，又爱好学问，至死守护善道。有危险的国家不进去，有祸乱的国家不久留。天下有道就出来做事，无道就隐居起来。邦国有道，自己仍旧贫贱，是可耻的；邦国无道，自己反倒富贵，同样可耻。 此章教人立身法也。 坚定地相信我们的道，努力学习它，誓死保全它。 该笃信，又该好学，坚执固守以至于死，以求善其道。

t: When not in the office, do not plan its affairs
y: 子曰：不在其位，不谋其政。
x: The Master said: When not in the office, do not plan its affairs. 孔子说：不处在那个职位上，就不去筹划那个职位上的政事。 不居于那个职位，便不考虑它的政务。 不在此职位上，即不谋此职位上的事。

t: From Music Master Zhi's opening to the finale of the Guanju —…
y: 子曰：师挚之始，关雎之乱，洋洋乎！盈耳哉。
x: The Master said: From Music Master Zhi's opening to the finale of the Guanju — how full and flowing it fills the ears! 孔子说：从乐师挚开头演奏，到《关雎》终曲合奏，满耳都是盛大美好的乐声啊！ 師，魯太師也；摯，太師名也。 当太师挚开始演奏的时候，当结尾演奏《关雎》之曲的时候，… 由于太师挚之升歌开始，迄于关雎之合乐终结，…

t: Wild yet not straight, ignorant yet not honest, simple yet not…
y: 子曰：狂而不直，侗而不愿，悾悾而不信，吾不知之矣。
x: The Master said: Wild yet not straight, ignorant yet not honest, simple yet not trustworthy — such people I do not understand. 孔子说：狂放却不坦直，无知却不老实，没本事又不守信用，这样的人，我真不知道该拿他怎么办。 此章歎時世與古反也。 狂妄而不直率，幼稚而不老实，无能而不讲信用，… 粗狂而不爽直，颟顸而不忠厚，愚悫而不可信靠，…

t: Learn as if you could not catch up, and still fear losing it
y: 子曰：学如不及，犹恐失之。
x: The Master said: Learn as if you could not catch up, and still fear losing it. 孔子说：求学就像追赶什么，总怕追不上，追上了又怕丢掉。 言學之為法，急務取得，恒如追前人欲取必及，故云如不及也。 做学问好像〔追逐什么似的，〕生怕赶不上；〔赶上了，… 求学如像来不及般，还是怕失去了。

t: How lofty! Shun and Yu possessed the realm, yet did not make it…
y: 子曰：巍巍乎！舜禹之有天下也，而不与焉。
x: The Master said: How lofty! Shun and Yu possessed the realm, yet did not make it their concern. 孔子说：多么崇高啊！舜和禹拥有天下，却不把权位放在心上。 此美舜禹也。 贵为天子，富有四海，〔却整年地为百姓勤劳，〕一点也不为自己。 这是多么伟大呀！

t: Great indeed was Yao as a ruler!
y: 子曰：大哉！尧之为君也。巍巍乎！唯天为大，唯尧则之。荡荡乎！民无能名焉。巍巍乎！其有成功也。焕乎！其有文章。
x: The Master said: Great indeed was Yao as a ruler! How lofty! Only Heaven is great, and only Yao modeled himself on it. How vast! The people could find no name for it. How lofty were his achievements! How brilliant his culture! 孔子说：尧作为君主，真是伟大！崇高啊！只有天最大，只有尧能效法天。广阔啊！百姓找不出词句来称道他。崇高啊！他成就的功业。光辉啊！他制定的礼乐典章。 此美堯也。 只有天最高最大，只有尧能够学习天。 伟大呀！

t: Shun had five ministers and the realm was well governed
y: 舜有臣五人而天下治。武王曰：予有乱臣十人。孔子曰：才难，不其然乎？唐、虞之际，于斯为盛。有妇人焉，九人而已。三分天下有其二，以服事殷。周之德，其可谓至德也已矣。
x: Shun had five ministers and the realm was well governed. King Wu said: I have ten ministers who keep order. Confucius said: Talent is hard to find — is it not so? From the time of Tang and Yu, it flourished most in this age; and one of them was a woman, so there were only nine men. Holding two thirds of the realm, Zhou still served Yin. The virtue of Zhou may be called the highest virtue. 舜手下有五个能臣，天下便安定了。周武王说：我有能治理天下的大臣十人。孔子说：俗话说人才难得，难道不对吗？唐虞交替之后，要数武王这一代人才最多，十人中还有一位妇人，男子只有九位而已。文王时周已占有三分天下中的两分，却依旧以臣礼侍奉殷商。周的德行，可以说是到了顶点了。 記者又美舜德也。 舜有五位贤臣，天下便太平。 舜有贤臣五人而天下治。

t: In Yu I find no fault. He ate and drank simply, yet was utterly…
y: 子曰：禹，吾无间然矣。菲饮食，而致孝乎鬼神；恶衣服，而致美乎黻冕；卑宫室，而尽力乎沟洫。禹，吾无间然矣。
x: The Master said: In Yu I find no fault. He ate and drank simply, yet was utterly devoted to the spirits; he wore poor clothes, yet made his ceremonial robes and cap beautiful; he lived in a low palace, yet gave all his strength to the irrigation channels. In Yu I find no fault. 孔子说：大禹，我挑不出他的毛病了。自己吃得简单，却尽心备办祭祀鬼神的供品；自己穿得粗陋，却把祭祀穿的礼服礼帽做得华美；自己住得低矮，却把力气全用在田间沟渠上。大禹，我挑不出他的毛病了。 此美禹之德也。 他自己吃得很坏，却把祭品办得极丰盛；穿得很坏，… 禹，我对他是无话可批评的了。

t: The Master seldom spoke of profit, but he endorsed fate and…
y: 子罕言利与命与仁。
x: The Master seldom spoke of profit, but he endorsed fate and endorsed humaneness. 利益、天命、仁，这三样孔子平时难得开口讲。 子，孔子也。罕者，希也。 孔子很少〔主动〕谈到功利、命运和仁德。 先生平日少言利，只赞同命与仁。

t: A man of Daxiang village said: Great indeed is Confucius!
y: 达巷党人曰：大哉孔子！博学而无所成名。子闻之，谓门弟子曰：吾何执？执御乎？执射乎？吾执御矣。
x: A man of Daxiang village said: Great indeed is Confucius! He has learned so broadly, yet made no name in any one thing. Hearing this, the Master said to his disciples: What should I take up? Charioteering? Archery? I will take up charioteering. 达巷那地方有人说：孔子真博大啊！学问渊博，可惜没有哪一门专长让他成名。孔子听了，对门下弟子说：我专攻哪样好呢？驾车吗？射箭吗？那我就专攻驾车吧。 云達巷云云者，五百家為黨，黨各有名，此黨名達巷。 学问广博，可惜没有足以树立名声的专长。 伟大呀孔子！

t: A linen cap is the ritual
y: 子曰：麻冕，礼也；今也纯，俭。吾从众。拜下，礼也；今拜乎上，泰也。虽违众，吾从下。
x: The Master said: A linen cap is the ritual; now silk is used, which is more frugal, and I follow the majority. Bowing below the hall is the ritual; now people bow above it, which is presumptuous. Though it goes against the majority, I bow below. 孔子说：用细麻织礼帽，是古礼；如今改用丝织，省工省料，我跟从大家。臣下拜见君主先在堂下行拜，是古礼；如今直接上堂才拜，那是傲慢。虽然和众人不同，我还是坚持在堂下拜。 云麻冕禮也者，禮謂周禮也。 礼帽用麻料来织，这是合于传统的礼的；今天大家都用丝料，… 麻冕是古礼，现在改用黑丝作冕，比麻冕节省了，我从众，…

t: The Master was free of four things: no presumption, no…
y: 子绝四：毋意，毋必，毋固，毋我。
x: The Master was free of four things: no presumption, no insistence, no stubbornness, no self. 孔子杜绝了四种毛病：不凭私意揣度，不预先认定一定如此，不固执己见，不以自我为中心。 云子絶四者，絶者，無也。 孔子一点也没有四种毛病——不悬空揣测，不绝对肯定，… 先生平日绝无四种心。

t: The Master was in peril in Kuang
y: 子畏于匡。曰：文王既没，文不在兹乎？天之将丧斯文也，后死者不得与于斯文也；天之未丧斯文也，匡人其如予何？
x: The Master was in peril in Kuang. He said: Since King Wen is gone, is culture not here in me? If Heaven meant to destroy this culture, those who came after would not have shared in it. If Heaven does not mean to destroy this culture, what can the people of Kuang do to me? 孔子在匡地遭到围困，心存戒惧。他说：周文王已经去世，礼乐文化不就在我这里吗？上天若要灭绝这种文化，我这个后死的人就不会掌握它了；上天既然还不让它灭绝，匡人又能把我怎样？ 云子畏於匡者，心服曰畏，匡宋地名也。 周文王死了以后，一切文化遗产不都在我这里吗？ 文王既死，道不就在此吗？

t: The Grand Steward asked Zigong: Is your Master a sage?
y: 大宰问于子贡曰：夫子圣者与？何其多能也？子贡曰：固天纵之将圣，又多能也。子闻之，曰：大宰知我乎？吾少也贱，故多能鄙事。君子多乎哉？不多也。牢曰：子云，吾不试，故艺。
x: The Grand Steward asked Zigong: Is your Master a sage? How many skills he has! Zigong said: Heaven has indeed endowed him to be nearly a sage, and he has many skills as well. Hearing this, the Master said: Does the Grand Steward know me? When young I was of low station, so I became skilled in many humble things. Does a gentleman need many skills? Not many. Lao said: The Master said, 'I was not given office, so I learned the arts.' 太宰问子贡：你们老师是圣人吧？怎么会有那么多本领？子贡说：这本来是上天放手成就他，几乎要成为圣人，同时又多才多艺。孔子听说后，说：太宰了解我吗？我小时候出身低微，所以学会了许多粗活杂事。君子需要会那么多吗？不需要多。琴牢说：老师说过，“我没被朝廷任用，所以学会了些技艺。” 云大宰問於子貢云云者，大宰，大夫官名也。 这本是上天让他成为圣人，又使他多才多艺。 你们的先生是圣人了吧？

t: Do I have knowledge? I do not
y: 子曰：吾有知乎哉？无知也。有鄙夫问于我，空空如也，我叩其两端而竭焉。
x: The Master said: Do I have knowledge? I do not. If a common man asks me something, and I am completely empty, I lay out both ends of the matter and exhaust it. 孔子说：我有什么知识吗？其实没有。有个乡下人来问我，脑子里空空的，我便抓住他所问之事的正反两端，反复叩问，直到把话说尽。 云吾有知者，知謂有私意於其間之知也。 我有知吗？

t: The phoenix does not come, the River gives forth no chart
y: 子曰：凤鸟不至，河不出图，吾已矣夫！
x: The Master said: The phoenix does not come, the River gives forth no chart. It is all over with me! 孔子说：凤凰不再飞临，黄河也不再献出图来，我这一辈子大约就到头了！ 夫時人皆願孔子有大主之事。 凤鸟不来，河中不再出图，大概我是完了吧！

t: When the Master saw someone in mourning dress, someone in…
y: 子见齐衰者、冕衣裳者与瞽者，见之，虽少必作；过之，必趋。
x: When the Master saw someone in mourning dress, someone in ceremonial cap and robes, or a blind man, he would rise on seeing them, even if they were young; passing them, he would quicken his step. 孔子遇见穿丧服的人、戴礼帽穿礼服的人和盲人，相见时，对方即便年轻，孔子也一定起身；从他们面前经过，一定加快脚步。 云子見齊衰者，齊衰，五服之第二者也。 先生见到服齐衰丧服的，以及轻丧去冠括发的，…

t: Yan Yuan sighed deeply and said: The more I look up to it, the…
y: 颜渊喟然叹曰：仰之弥高，钻之弥坚；瞻之在前，忽焉在后。夫子循循然善诱人，博我以文，约我以礼。欲罢不能，既竭吾才，如有所立卓尔。虽欲从之，末由也已。
x: Yan Yuan sighed deeply and said: The more I look up to it, the higher it is; the more I bore into it, the harder it is. I see it before me, and suddenly it is behind. The Master leads people on step by step; he broadens me with culture and restrains me with ritual. I want to stop but cannot. When I have used up all my ability, it seems to stand there, towering. Though I want to follow it, there is no way. 颜渊长叹一声说：老师的道，越仰望越觉得高，越钻研越觉得坚实；看着好像在前面，忽然又像在后面。老师一步一步、很有次序地引导人，用典籍文献使我的见识丰富，用礼来约束我的行为。我想停也停不下来，已经用尽了我的才力，好像有个东西高高地立在眼前；想追随上去，却找不到路径。 顏淵上賢，賢聖道絕，故顏致歎也。 我仰望它，愈望愈高。

t: The Master was gravely ill, and Zilu had disciples act as his…
y: 子疾病，子路使门人为臣。病间，曰：久矣哉！由之行诈也，无臣而为有臣。吾谁欺？欺天乎？且予与其死于臣之手也，无宁死于二三子之手乎？且予纵不得大葬，予死于道路乎？
x: The Master was gravely ill, and Zilu had disciples act as his retainers. When the illness eased, the Master said: How long Zilu has been practicing this deceit! I have no retainers, yet he acts as if I do. Whom am I deceiving? Am I deceiving Heaven? Besides, rather than die in the hands of retainers, would I not rather die in your hands, my friends? And even if I am not given a grand burial, would I die by the roadside? 孔子病重，子路让同门弟子充当家臣，准备办理丧事。孔子病情稍稍好转后，说：仲由弄虚作假，已经很久了！我没有家臣却装作有家臣，我要欺骗谁呢？欺骗上天吗？再说，与其让什么家臣送我走，我宁可在你们几个学生身边闭眼！再说，我就算得不到隆重的葬礼，难道会死在路上没人埋吗？ 云子疾病者，孔子疾甚也。 先生病得很重，子路派使先生门人作为先生的家臣，来预备丧事。

t: Here is a beautiful jade
y: 子贡曰：有美玉于斯，韫匵而藏诸？求善贾而沽诸？子曰：沽之哉！沽之哉！我待贾者也。
x: Zigong said: Here is a beautiful jade. Should one store it away in a case, or seek a good price and sell it? The Master said: Sell it! Sell it! I am waiting for the right price. 子贡说：假如这儿有块好玉，是把它包好锁进柜里呢，还是等个出好价钱的人把它出手？孔子说：出手吧！出手吧！我就是在等那个肯出价的人。 云子貢曰有美玉於斯者，子貢欲觀孔子聖德藏用，故託事於斯者也。 若有一块美玉在这里，还是装在匣中藏起呢？

t: The Master wished to live among the nine Yi tribes
y: 子欲居九夷。或曰：陋，如之何！子曰：君子居之，何陋之有？
x: The Master wished to live among the nine Yi tribes. Someone said: They are crude; what would you do? The Master said: If a gentleman lived there, what crudeness would there be? 孔子想搬到东方九夷那里去住。有人说：那里简陋，怎么住得惯？孔子说：君子去住了，还有什么简陋的？ 孔子有聖道不行於中國，故記欲東往居於九夷也。 先生想居住到九夷去。

t: Only after I returned from Wei to Lu was the music set right…
y: 子曰：吾自卫反鲁，然后乐正，雅颂各得其所。
x: The Master said: Only after I returned from Wei to Lu was the music set right, and the Ya and Song each found their proper place. 孔子说：自打我离卫归鲁，乐曲才得到校正，《雅》《颂》各归其位。 孔子去魯後，而魯禮樂崩壞，子來還乃正之也。 我自卫返到鲁国，始把乐厘正了。

t: Abroad, serving dukes and ministers
y: 子曰：出则事公卿，入则事父兄，丧事不敢不勉，不为酒困，何有于我哉？
x: The Master said: Abroad, serving dukes and ministers; at home, serving father and elder brothers; in mourning, never daring not to do my utmost; never being overcome by wine — which of these is in me? 孔子说：在外事奉公卿，在家事奉父兄，办丧事不敢不尽力，不被酒弄得昏乱，这几件事我做到了哪一样呢？ 公，君也。卿，長也。 出外奉事公卿，入门奉事父兄，有丧事不敢不勉尽我力，…

t: Standing by a river, the Master said: It flows on like this…
y: 子在川上，曰：逝者如斯夫！不舍昼夜。
x: Standing by a river, the Master said: It flows on like this, never ceasing day or night. 孔子站在河边，说：消逝的一切就像这河水吧！日日夜夜，从不停息。 孔子在於川水之上，見川流迅邁，未嘗停止。 去的就像这样呀！

t: I have never seen anyone who loves virtue as much as he loves…
y: 子曰：吾未见好德如好色者也。
x: The Master said: I have never seen anyone who loves virtue as much as he loves beauty. 孔子说：我还没见过喜爱德行像喜爱美色那样真切的人。 時人多好色而無好德者也。 我没有见过好德能像好色般的人呀。

t: It is like building a mound: if I stop when it lacks only one…
y: 子曰：譬如为山，未成一篑，止，吾止也；譬如平地，虽覆一篑，进，吾往也。
x: The Master said: It is like building a mound: if I stop when it lacks only one basket of earth, it is I who stop. It is like leveling the ground: even if I have tipped out only one basket, if I go on, it is I who go forward. 孔子说：好比用土堆山，只差一筐土就成了，停下来，那是我自己停的；好比在平地上填土，虽然才倒下一筐，接着往前干，那是我自己往前的。 此戒人為善垂成而止者也。 譬如堆一山，只一篑未成，停止了，这是我自己停止了的呀。

t: One who never grew lax when I spoke to him — that was Hui!
y: 子曰：语之而不惰者，其回也与！
x: The Master said: One who never grew lax when I spoke to him — that was Hui! 孔子说：我讲给他听，他从不松懈走神，这样的人，就是颜回吧！ 與，歎辭也。 和他讲说了不怠懈的，只是颜回了吧！

t: Speaking of Yan Yuan, the Master said: What a pity!
y: 子谓颜渊，曰：惜乎！吾见其进也，未见其止也。
x: Speaking of Yan Yuan, the Master said: What a pity! I saw him go forward; I never saw him stop. 孔子谈到颜渊，说：可惜啊！我只见他不断前进，从没见他停下来。 顏淵死後，孔子有此歎也。 可惜呀！

t: There are sprouts that never flower!
y: 子曰：苗而不秀者有矣夫！秀而不实者有矣夫！
x: The Master said: There are sprouts that never flower! There are flowers that never bear fruit! 孔子说：长出了苗却不抽穗开花的，有吧！抽穗开花却不结果实的，也有吧！ 夫子又為歎顏淵為譬也。 发了苗，没有结成穗的有了吧！

t: The young are to be held in awe
y: 子曰：后生可畏，焉知来者之不如今也？四十、五十而无闻焉，斯亦不足畏也已。
x: The Master said: The young are to be held in awe. How do we know those to come will not equal those of today? But one who at forty or fifty has made no name — he is not worth holding in awe. 孔子说：后辈不可小看，谁能说将来的人赶不上今天的人？不过一个人活到四十、五十岁仍旧默默无闻，那也就没什么可敬畏的了。 可畏謂有才學可服畏者也。 年轻人是可畏的呀！

t: Words of correction — can one fail to accept them?
y: 子曰：法语之言，能无从乎？改之为贵。巽与之言，能无说乎？绎之为贵。说而不绎，从而不改，吾末如之何也已矣。
x: The Master said: Words of correction — can one fail to accept them? What matters is to change. Words of gentle advice — can one fail to be pleased? What matters is to think them through. Pleased but not thinking it through, accepting but not changing — with such a person I can do nothing. 孔子说：正言规劝的话，能不听从吗？但贵在真正改过。委婉开导的话，听了能不高兴吗？但贵在仔细推敲它的用意。只是高兴而不推敲，只是表面听从而不改正，这样的人我也没有办法了。 彼人有過失，若我以法則語之，人聞法當時無不口從而云止當不敢復為者也。 别人用规则正言来告诫我，能不服从吗？

t: Hold loyalty and good faith as primary
y: 子曰：主忠信，毋友不如己者，过则勿惮改。
x: The Master said: Hold loyalty and good faith as primary. Do not befriend those not your equal. When you err, do not fear to correct it. 孔子说：立身以忠和信为根本，比不上自己的人别去结为朋友，犯了错，别怕去改。 此事再出也。

t: The three armies can be robbed of their commander
y: 子曰：三军可夺帅也，匹夫不可夺志也。
x: The Master said: The three armies can be robbed of their commander; a common man cannot be robbed of his will. 孔子说：一国的军队，可以夺走它的主帅；一个普通人，却不能夺走他的志向。 明人能守志也。 三军之众，可把它元帅夺了。

t: Wearing a tattered padded robe and standing beside men in fox…
y: 子曰：衣敝缊袍，与衣狐貉者立，而不耻者，其由也与？不忮不求，何用不臧？子路终身诵之。子曰：是道也，何足以臧？
x: The Master said: Wearing a tattered padded robe and standing beside men in fox and badger furs without shame — that would be You, would it not? 'Not envious, not grasping — how could he not be good?' Zilu kept reciting these lines all his life. The Master said: That way alone — how is it enough to be good? 孔子说：穿着破旧的乱麻絮袍子，跟穿着狐皮貉皮袍子的人站在一起，而不觉得低人一等的，大概就数仲由了？《诗》里说：“不嫉妒，不贪求，怎么会不好？”子路从此终身念诵这两句。孔子说：仅仅这样，怎么就算够好了呢？ 衣，猶著也。弊，敗也。 穿着破旧的绵絮袍，和穿狐裘的人同立在一起，…

t: Only when the year turns cold do we know that the pine and…
y: 子曰：岁寒，然后知松柏之后彫也。
x: The Master said: Only when the year turns cold do we know that the pine and cypress are the last to wither. 孔子说：到了一年最冷的时候，才知道松柏是最后凋零的。 此欲明君子德性與小人異也。 要到岁寒，才知松柏的后凋呀！

t: The wise are not perplexed
y: 子曰：知者不惑，仁者不忧，勇者不惧。
x: The Master said: The wise are not perplexed; the humane are not anxious; the brave are not afraid. 孔子说：明智的人不会迷惑，仁德的人不会忧愁，勇敢的人不会畏惧。 此章談人性分不同也。 知者心无惑乱，仁者心无愁虑，勇者心无惧怕。

t: Some you can study with, but not go with toward the Way
y: 子曰：可与共学，未可与适道；可与适道，未可与立；可与立，未可与权。
x: The Master said: Some you can study with, but not go with toward the Way; some you can go with toward the Way, but not stand with; some you can stand with, but not weigh things with. 孔子说：可以一起求学的人，未必能一起走向正道；能一起走向正道的人，未必能一起站稳立场；能一起站稳的人，未必能一起通权达变。 此章明權道之難也。 有人可和他共同向学，但未必可和他共同向道。

t: The blossoms of the cherry tree flutter and turn
y: 唐棣之华，偏其反而。岂不尔思？室是远而。子曰：未之思也，夫何远之有？
x: 'The blossoms of the cherry tree flutter and turn. How could I not think of you? But your home is far away.' The Master said: He did not really think of her. What distance would there be? 古诗说：“唐棣开花，随风轻轻翻动。哪是不把你想？只怪家住得远。”孔子说：那是心里并不真想，若是真想，哪来什么远呢？ 云唐棣之華偏其反而者，唐棣，棣樹也。華，花也。 唐棣花开，翩啊翻啊地摇动着。

t: In his home village, Confucius was simple and sincere, as if…
y: 孔子于乡党，恂恂如也，似不能言者。其在宗庙朝廷，便便言，唯谨尔。
x: In his home village, Confucius was simple and sincere, as if unable to speak. In the ancestral temple and at court, he spoke fluently, but always with care. 孔子在家乡，温和恭顺，诚诚恳恳，好像不大会说话。在宗庙和朝廷上，他说话清楚流畅，只是处处小心。 孔子在鄉黨之時，並記孔子平生德行也。 孔子在本乡的地方上非常恭顺，好像不能说话的样子。 孔子在乡里间，其貌温恭谦逊，好像不能说话的一般。

t: At court, speaking with lower officers, he was direct and at…
y: 朝，与下大夫言，侃侃如也；与上大夫言，訚訚如也。君在，踧踖如也。与与如也。
x: At court, speaking with lower officers, he was direct and at ease; speaking with higher officers, he was respectful and exact. When the ruler was present, he was reverent yet composed. 上朝时，孔子同下大夫说话，刚直从容；同上大夫说话，和颜悦色而又敢于直言。国君在场时，他恭敬而略带不安，举止又安详得体。 朝，孔子與之言宜用和樂相接。 上朝的时候，〔君主还没有到来，〕同下大夫说话，… 孔子在朝廷，当他和下大夫交谈时，侃侃然和气而又欢乐。

t: When the ruler summoned him to receive guests, his face would…
y: 君召使摈，色勃如也，足躩如也。揖所与立，左右手。衣前后，襜如也。趋进，翼如也。宾退，必复命曰：宾不顾矣。
x: When the ruler summoned him to receive guests, his face would change and his steps would quicken. Bowing to those standing beside him, he moved his hands left and right, his robe swaying evenly front and back. Hurrying forward, he moved like a bird with spread wings. When the guest had left, he would report: The guest is no longer looking back. 国君召孔子去接待外宾，他神色立刻庄重起来，脚步也放得小心。向两旁同列的人作揖，左手右手轮流拱揖，衣裳前后摆动，却始终整齐。快步向前时，两袖张开，像鸟儿展翅。客人告辞后，他一定回报国君说：客人已经走远，不再回头了。 儐者，為君接賓。 鲁君召他去接待外国的贵宾，面色矜持庄重，脚步也快起来。 君召孔子使作摈相，孔子必变容庄敬，行路如脚下有戒惧般。

t: Entering the palace gate, he bowed as if there were no room for…
y: 入公门，鞠躬如也，如不容。立不中门，行不履阈。过位，色勃如也，足躩如也，其言似不足者。摄齐升堂，鞠躬如也，屏气似不息者。出，降一等，逞颜色，怡怡如也。没阶趋，翼如也。复其位，踧踖如也。
x: Entering the palace gate, he bowed as if there were no room for him. He did not stand in the middle of the gateway nor step on the threshold. Passing the ruler's seat, his face changed and his steps quickened, and he spoke as if short of words. Lifting his robe to ascend the hall, he bowed and held his breath as if not breathing. Coming out and descending one step, he relaxed his face and looked at ease. At the bottom of the steps he hurried forward like a bird with spread wings. Returning to his place, he was reverent and composed. 孔子走进国君的宫门，弯着身子，好像门容不下他。站立不站在门中间，行走不踩门槛。经过国君的空座位时，神色庄重，脚步放小，言语低微像气力不够。双手撩起衣摆上堂，弯着身子，屏住气息，好像不敢呼吸。出来时，走下一级台阶，脸色放松，显出舒坦的样子。走完台阶，快步向前，两袖如鸟展翅。回到自己的位置，又是恭敬不安的样子。 鞠躬，曲敬也。 孔子走进朝廷的门，害怕而谨慎的样子，好像没有容身之地。 孔子跑进公门，必敛身谨敬，像那公门容不下他身子般。

t: Holding the jade tablet, he bowed as if it were too heavy to…
y: 执圭，鞠躬如也，如不胜。上如揖，下如授。勃如战色，足蹜蹜，如有循。享礼，有容色。私觌，愉愉如也。
x: Holding the jade tablet, he bowed as if it were too heavy to bear. He raised it as if bowing and lowered it as if handing something over. His face was grave as if in fear, and his steps were short as if following a line. At the presentation of gifts, his face was composed; at a private meeting, he was cheerful. 孔子代国君出使，捧着圭，弯着身子，好像举不动。往上举不高过作揖，往下放不低过递物。面色庄重得像在战栗，脚步细碎，像沿着一条线走。献礼的时候，神情和悦。以私人身份会见对方时，就显得轻松愉快。 鄰國為使以聘問時也。 〔孔子出使到外国，举行典礼，〕拿着圭，恭敬谨慎地，… 孔子为聘使，执君之圭，敛着身，像不胜其重的样子。

t: The gentleman did not use dark purple or puce for trimmings…
y: 君子不以绀緅饰。红紫不以为亵服。当暑，袗𫄨绤，必表而出之。缁衣羔裘，素衣麑裘，黄衣狐裘。亵裘长。短右袂。必有寝衣，长一身有半。狐貉之厚以居。去丧，无所不佩。非帷裳，必杀之。羔裘玄冠不以吊。吉月，必朝服而朝。
x: The gentleman did not use dark purple or puce for trimmings, nor red or purple for everyday clothes. In hot weather he wore unlined fine or coarse linen, always over an inner garment. With a black robe, lambskin; with a white robe, fawnskin; with a yellow robe, fox fur. His everyday fur coat was long, with the right sleeve short. He always had a sleeping garment one and a half times his body length. Thick fox and badger furs were for sitting at home. Out of mourning, he wore all his pendants. Except for the ceremonial skirt, his skirts were cut narrower. He did not wear lambskin and a black cap to offer condolences. On the first day of the month, he always went to court in court dress. 君子不用深青透红色和黑里带红的布做衣服镶边。红色、紫色不用来做家常便服。暑天穿单层的细葛布或粗葛布衣，一定在里面衬上衣，再把葛衣罩在外面。黑衣配黑羊羔皮袍，白衣配白鹿皮袍，黄衣配狐皮袍。家居穿的皮袍做得长些，右边袖子短些，便于做事。睡觉一定有被子，长度是身长的一倍半。用厚实的狐貉皮毛做坐垫，家居时用。除去丧服以后，各种佩饰都可以佩戴。不是上朝祭祀穿的整幅帷裳，一定要裁剪缝制。黑羊羔皮袍和黑色礼帽不穿戴去吊丧。每月初一，一定穿上朝服去朝见国君。 君子衣服有法，不可雜色也。 君子不用〔近乎黑色的〕天青色和铁灰色作镶边，… 君子不把玄色纁色来作衣领与袖之边。

t: When fasting, he always had a clean garment of plain cloth
y: 齐，必有明衣，布。齐，必变食，居必迁坐。
x: When fasting, he always had a clean garment of plain cloth. When fasting, he always changed his diet and moved to a different place to sit. 斋戒时，一定要有洗浴后穿的干净内衣，用布做。斋戒时，一定改变平日的饮食，居处也一定换个地方。 云齊必有明衣布者，謂齊浴時所著用衣，布為之。 斋戒沐浴的时候，一定有浴衣，用布做的。 遇斋戒时，必有特备的浴衣，用布为之。

t: He did not tire of finely polished rice or of finely sliced meat
y: 食不厌精，脍不厌细。食饐而餲，鱼馁而肉败，不食。色恶，不食。臭恶，不食。失饪，不食。不时，不食。割不正，不食。不得其酱，不食。肉虽多，不使胜食气。惟酒无量，不及乱。沽酒市脯不食。不撤姜食。不多食。祭于公，不宿肉。祭肉不出三日。出三日，不食之矣。食不语，寝不言。虽疏食菜羹，瓜祭，必齐如也。
x: He did not tire of finely polished rice or of finely sliced meat. Rice that had spoiled and turned sour, fish gone bad, or meat that had rotted, he did not eat. Food of bad color he did not eat; food of bad smell he did not eat. Food badly cooked he did not eat; food out of season he did not eat. Meat not cut properly he did not eat; without the right sauce he did not eat. Even when there was much meat, he did not let it overpower the rice. Only in wine he set no limit, but never to the point of disorder. Wine and dried meat bought at the market he did not eat. He did not do without ginger, but did not eat much. After a sacrifice at the duke's, he did not keep the meat overnight. Sacrificial meat he did not keep beyond three days; beyond three days, he would not eat it. He did not converse while eating, nor talk in bed. Even with coarse rice and vegetable soup, he offered some in sacrifice, always with reverence. 米越舂得白越好，肉越切得细越好。饭受潮发馊变了味，鱼肉腐坏了，不吃。颜色难看的，不吃。气味难闻的，不吃。烹调不得当，不吃。不到时令，不吃。切得不合规矩，不吃。没有相配的酱，不吃。桌上的肉再多，也不让它压过饭食。酒没有一定的量，只是不到醉乱的地步。从街上买来的酒和干肉，不吃。每顿离不了姜，但也不多吃。陪国君祭祀分得的肉，当天就分给别人，不留过夜。自家祭祀的肉，不超过三天，过了三天就不吃了。吃饭时不交谈，睡下时不说话。即使只是粗饭菜汤，吃前也一定先取出一点来祭先人，神情必定像斋戒一样恭敬。 云食不厭精者，此明平常禮食。 粮食不嫌舂得精，鱼和肉不嫌切得细。 吃饭不因饭米精便多吃了。

t: If the mat was not straight, he did not sit
y: 席不正，不坐。
x: If the mat was not straight, he did not sit. 坐席摆得不端正，孔子不坐。 云席不正不坐者，所以共敬其正也。 坐席没有端正，不坐。

t: When villagers drank together, he left only after those with…
y: 乡人饮酒，杖者出，斯出矣。乡人傩，朝服而立于阼阶。
x: When villagers drank together, he left only after those with walking staffs had left. When villagers held the exorcism, he stood on the eastern steps in court dress. 乡里人举行饮酒礼，散席时等拄拐杖的老人先出去，孔子才出去。乡里人举行驱疫的傩仪，孔子便身着朝服，立在主人位的东阶之上。 鄉人飲酒謂鄉飲酒禮也。 乡人饮酒，待老人持杖者离席，也就离席了。

t: When sending a messenger to inquire after someone in another…
y: 问人于他邦，再拜而送之。康子馈药，拜而受之。曰：丘未达，不敢尝。
x: When sending a messenger to inquire after someone in another state, he bowed twice as he sent him off. When Ji Kangzi sent him medicine, he bowed and accepted it, saying: I do not know this medicine, so I dare not taste it. 孔子托人去别国问候朋友，要向受托的人拜两拜送他上路。季康子送药给孔子，孔子拜谢后收下，说：我还不清楚这药的药性，不敢尝。 鄰國之君更相聘問也。 孔子使使者向他邦友人问好，必再拜而送之。

t: The stables burned down
y: 厩焚。子退朝，曰：伤人乎？不问马。
x: The stables burned down. Returning from court, the Master said: Was anyone hurt? He did not ask about the horses. 马厩失火了。孔子从朝廷回来，问：伤着人没有？没问马。 孔子家養馬之處焚燒也。 伤人了吗？

t: When the ruler gave him cooked food, he would straighten his…
y: 君赐食，必正席先尝之；君赐腥，必熟而荐之；君赐生，必畜之。侍食于君，君祭，先饭。疾，君视之，东首，加朝服，拖绅。君命召，不俟驾行矣。入太庙，每事问。
x: When the ruler gave him cooked food, he would straighten his mat and taste it first. When the ruler gave him raw meat, he would cook it and offer it to his ancestors. When the ruler gave him a live animal, he would raise it. When dining in attendance on the ruler, while the ruler made the offering, he would taste the food first. When he was ill and the ruler came to see him, he lay with his head to the east, with his court robe laid over him and his sash drawn across. When summoned by the ruler's command, he set off without waiting for his carriage to be yoked. Entering the Grand Temple, he asked about everything. 国君赏下煮好的食物，孔子必定把席子摆正，先亲口尝过。国君赐给生肉，一定煮熟后先供奉祖先。国君赐给活物，一定把它养起来。陪国君吃饭，国君行祭食之礼时，孔子先替国君尝饭。孔子卧病，国君亲来看望，他就头向东卧，把朝服盖在身上，拖着大带。国君召见，不等车马驾好，就先步行动身了。进了太庙，每样事都要问一问。 云君賜食云云者，席，猶坐也。 君赐食物，必正了席位先尝它。

t: When a friend died with no one to take charge, he said: Let the…
y: 朋友死，无所归。曰：于我殡。朋友之馈，虽车马，非祭肉，不拜。
x: When a friend died with no one to take charge, he said: Let the funeral be held at my house. For gifts from friends, even a carriage and horses, he did not bow unless it was sacrificial meat. 朋友死了，没有亲属料理后事，孔子说：由我来安排丧事吧。朋友赠送东西，就算贵重如车马，除非是祭过祖先的肉，孔子都不下拜。 孔子有朋友在孔子之家死，而此朋友無親情來迎喪者，故云無所歸也。 病中在我处寄居，死了在我处停柩吧！

t: He did not sleep stretched out like a corpse, nor sit at home…
y: 寝不尸，居不容。见齐衰者，虽狎，必变。见冕者与瞽者，虽亵，必以貌。凶服者式之。式负版者。有盛馔，必变色而作。迅雷风烈，必变。
x: He did not sleep stretched out like a corpse, nor sit at home with formal bearing. When he saw someone in mourning dress, even an intimate, his expression changed. When he saw someone in ceremonial cap or a blind man, even someone he saw often, he showed proper bearing. To one in mourning clothes he bowed from his carriage; he bowed to those carrying the registers of the state. When a fine feast was served, his expression changed and he rose. At sudden thunder or violent wind, his expression changed. 孔子睡时不挺直四肢仰面躺着，在家里不刻意摆出仪容。看见穿丧服的人，即使平日很亲近，也一定改变脸色表示同情。看见戴礼帽的官员和盲人，即使常常见面，也一定以礼相待。乘车遇见穿丧服的人，便俯身扶着车前横木致意；对背着国家户籍图册的人，也同样致意。有丰盛的筵席，一定改变神色，站起身来。碰上急雷狂风，必定神色一变。 云寢不尸者，寢，眠也。尸，謂死人也。 寝卧时，不直挺着四肢像个尸。

t: Mounting his carriage, he always stood upright and held the…
y: 升车，必正立执绥。车中，不内顾，不疾言，不亲指。
x: Mounting his carriage, he always stood upright and held the strap. In the carriage, he did not look around, did not speak hurriedly, and did not point. 孔子上车，一定先站端正，再拉着扶绳上去。在车上，不回头张望，不高声急语，不用手指指点点。 云升車必正立執綏者，謂孔子升車時，則正立而執綏。 升车时，必正立着，两手把执那绳子才上去。

t: Seeing the look on their faces, the birds rose, circled, and…
y: 色斯举矣，翔而后集。曰：山梁雌雉，时哉！时哉！子路共之，三嗅而作。
x: Seeing the look on their faces, the birds rose, circled, and then settled together. He said: The hen pheasants on the mountain bridge — how timely! How timely! Zilu bowed to them; they sniffed three times and flew off. 鸟见人神色不对，便飞起来，在空中盘旋察看，然后才落下停住。孔子说：山脊上那只雌野鸡，懂得时宜啊！懂得时宜啊！子路向它拱手，它振了几下翅膀，飞走了。（朱熹认为这一章末尾文字有缺漏，不宜勉强解说。） 云色斯舉矣者，謂孔子在鄉黨處，觀人顏色而舉動也。 只见人们有少许颜色不善，便一举身飞了。

t: Those who first advanced in ritual and music were country folk
y: 子曰：先进于礼乐，野人也；后进于礼乐，君子也。如用之，则吾从先进。
x: The Master said: Those who first advanced in ritual and music were country folk; those who later advanced in ritual and music were gentlemen. If I were to use them, I would follow those who came first. 孔子说，前辈学习礼乐，被人看作乡野之人；后辈学习礼乐，被人看作有文采的君子。如果要采用礼乐，我选择前辈的做法。 先進者，先進受業者也。 先学习礼乐而后做官的是未曾有过爵禄的一般人，… 先进一辈，从礼乐方面讲，像是朴野人。

t: Those who followed me in Chen and Cai are no longer at my gate
y: 子曰：从我于陈、蔡者，皆不及门也。德行：颜渊，闵子骞，冉伯牛，仲弓。言语：宰我，子贡。政事：冉有，季路。文学：子游，子夏。
x: The Master said: Those who followed me in Chen and Cai are no longer at my gate. In virtuous conduct: Yan Yuan, Min Ziqian, Ran Boniu, Zhonggong. In speech: Zai Wo, Zigong. In government: Ran You, Jilu. In culture and learning: Ziyou, Zixia. 孔子说，曾跟随我在陈国、蔡国受困的弟子，如今都不在我门下了。德行出众的是颜渊、闵子骞、冉伯牛、仲弓，善言辞的是宰我、子贡，善政事的是冉有、季路，长于文献学问的是子游、子夏。 孔子言時世亂離，道不行。 跟着我在陈国、蔡国之间忍饥受饿的人，都不在我这里了。 以前从我在陈蔡的，此刻都不在我门下了。

t: Hui is no help to me; there is nothing I say that he is not…
y: 子曰：回也非助我者也，于吾言无所不说。
x: The Master said: Hui is no help to me; there is nothing I say that he is not pleased with. 孔子说，颜回不是能帮助我提出新见解的人，他对我说的话，没有不领会喜悦的。 聖人為教，須賢啟發。 回呀！

t: How filial Min Ziqian is!
y: 子曰：孝哉闵子骞！人不间于其父母昆弟之言。
x: The Master said: How filial Min Ziqian is! No one can find fault with what his parents and brothers say of him. 孔子说，闵子骞真孝顺啊，人们对他父母兄弟称赞他的话，没有异议。 間，猶非也。昆，兄也。 闵子骞真孝呀！

t: Nan Rong repeated the lines on the white jade tablet three…
y: 南容三复白圭，孔子以其兄之子妻之。
x: Nan Rong repeated the lines on the white jade tablet three times a day, and Confucius gave him his elder brother's daughter as wife. 南容反复诵读白玉之瑕尚可磨去、言语之失却不可挽回的诗句，孔子把哥哥的女儿嫁给了他。 云南容三復白圭者，復，猶反也。 南容一天三次反复读那白圭之诗，孔子把侄女嫁了他。

t: Ji Kangzi asked which of the disciples loved learning
y: 季康子问：弟子孰为好学？孔子对曰：有颜回者好学，不幸短命死矣！今也则亡。
x: Ji Kangzi asked which of the disciples loved learning. Confucius replied: There was Yan Hui who loved learning. Unfortunately, his life was short and he died. Now there is no one. 季康子问哪位弟子好学，孔子回答，有个颜回很好学，不幸短命死了，如今再没有这样的人了。 康子之問此，與哀公問同，而答異者，舊有二通。 你的弟子哪个是好学的呀？

t: When Yan Yuan died, Yan Lu asked for the Master's carriage to…
y: 颜渊死，颜路请子之车以为之椁。子曰：才不才，亦各言其子也。鲤也死，有棺而无椁。吾不徒行以为之椁。以吾从大夫之后，不可徒行也。
x: When Yan Yuan died, Yan Lu asked for the Master's carriage to make an outer coffin for him. The Master said: Talented or not, each speaks of his own son. When Li died, he had an inner coffin but no outer coffin. I did not go on foot to make an outer coffin for him. Since I follow behind the ministers, I cannot go on foot. 颜渊死后，颜路请求卖掉孔子的车，为颜渊置办外椁；孔子说，不论儿子有没有才能，父亲总各自疼爱自己的儿子，我的儿子鲤死时，也只有棺而没有椁。我没有为给他置椁而卖车步行，因为我曾列于大夫之后，不能没有车而步行。 顏淵家貧，死無槨，故其父顏路請孔子車，欲賣以營槨也。 颜渊死了，他父亲颜路请求先生把车卖了好替颜渊做一棺外之椁。

t: When Yan Yuan died, the Master said: Alas!
y: 颜渊死。子曰：噫！天丧予！天丧予！
x: When Yan Yuan died, the Master said: Alas! Heaven has destroyed me! Heaven has destroyed me! 颜渊死了，孔子叹道，唉，天要断送我啊，天要断送我啊！ 云顏淵死子曰噫者，噫，痛憤之聲也。 啊！

t: When Yan Yuan died, the Master wept for him with abandon
y: 颜渊死，子哭之恸。从者曰：子恸矣。曰：有恸乎？非夫人之为恸而谁为！
x: When Yan Yuan died, the Master wept for him with abandon. His followers said: Master, you weep with abandon. He said: Do I? If not for this man, for whom should I weep so? 颜渊死了，孔子哭得极其悲痛，随从说他太悲痛了；孔子说，有这样悲痛吗，不为这个人悲痛，还为谁悲痛呢？ 顏淵死，孔子往顏家哭之，亦慟。 颜渊死后，先生去哭他，哭得哀伤过分。

t: When Yan Yuan died, the disciples wanted to give him a lavish…
y: 颜渊死，门人欲厚葬之，子曰：不可。门人厚葬之。子曰：回也视予犹父也，予不得视犹子也。非我也，夫二三子也。
x: When Yan Yuan died, the disciples wanted to give him a lavish burial. The Master said: No. The disciples gave him a lavish burial. The Master said: Hui looked on me as a father, yet I could not treat him as a son. It was not I; it was you, my friends. 颜渊死后，弟子们想厚葬他，孔子说不可以，弟子们还是厚葬了他。孔子说，颜回把我看作父亲，我却没能像对自己的儿子那样，为他安排合宜的丧葬，这不是我的本意，是你们做的。 云顏淵死門人欲厚葬者，顏淵之死，門人欲厚葬，明其友也。 颜渊死后，门人同学想要厚葬他。

t: Jilu asked about serving the spirits
y: 季路问事鬼神。子曰：未能事人，焉能事鬼？敢问死。曰：未知生，焉知死？
x: Jilu asked about serving the spirits. The Master said: You cannot yet serve people; how can you serve spirits? He ventured to ask about death. The Master said: You do not yet understand life; how can you understand death? 子路问怎样奉事鬼神，孔子说，还不能奉事好人，怎么能奉事好鬼神；子路又请问死亡，孔子说，还不知道生的道理，怎么能知道死的道理？ 發明三世之義。 如何奉事鬼神？

t: Min Ziqian stood beside the Master, respectful and exact
y: 闵子侍侧，訚訚如也；子路，行行如也；冉有、子贡，侃侃如也。子乐。若由也，不得其死然。
x: Min Ziqian stood beside the Master, respectful and exact; Zilu, bold and firm; Ran You and Zigong, direct and at ease. The Master was pleased. 'As for You, I fear he will not die a natural death.' 闵子侍立在旁，中正而能争辩；子路刚强，冉有、子贡坦率和悦，孔子很高兴。孔子又说，像仲由这样，恐怕不得善终啊。 侍側云云者，陪在尊者之側曰侍也。 闵子骞侍奉在侧，訚訚如一派中正气象。

t: The people of Lu were rebuilding the Long Treasury
y: 鲁人为长府。闵子骞曰：仍旧贯，如之何？何必改作？子曰：夫人不言，言必有中。
x: The people of Lu were rebuilding the Long Treasury. Min Ziqian said: Why not keep it as it was? Why must it be rebuilt? The Master said: That man seldom speaks, but when he speaks, he hits the mark. 鲁国要改建长府，闵子骞说，沿用原来的规制怎样，何必一定改建；孔子说，这个人平时不轻易说话，一说就说得中肯。 云魯人為長府者，長府，藏名也。 鲁人计划要改作长府。

t: What is You's zither doing at my gate?
y: 子曰：由之瑟奚为于丘之门？门人不敬子路。子曰：由也升堂矣，未入于室也。
x: The Master said: What is You's zither doing at my gate? The disciples stopped respecting Zilu. The Master said: You has ascended to the hall, though he has not yet entered the inner room. 孔子说，仲由弹的这种瑟声，怎么会出现在我的门下；弟子们因此不尊敬子路，孔子又说，仲由已经登上厅堂，只是还没有进入内室。 云子曰云云者，子路性剛，其鼓琴瑟亦有壯氣。 由的鼓瑟声，为何发在我的门内呀？

t: Who is the worthier, Shi or Shang?
y: 子贡问：师与商也孰贤？子曰：师也过，商也不及。曰：然则师愈与？子曰：过犹不及。
x: Zigong asked: Who is the worthier, Shi or Shang? The Master said: Shi goes too far; Shang does not go far enough. Then is Shi better? The Master said: Going too far is the same as not going far enough. 子贡问子张和子夏谁更贤，孔子说，子张过了头，子夏又不够；子贡问那么子张更好吗，孔子说，过头和不够，同样没有恰到好处。 子貢問孔子，欲辨師商誰為賢勝也。 师与商孰贤呀？

t: The Ji family was richer than the Duke of Zhou, yet Qiu…
y: 季氏富于周公，而求也为之聚敛而附益之。子曰：非吾徒也。小子鸣鼓而攻之，可也。
x: The Ji family was richer than the Duke of Zhou, yet Qiu collected taxes for them and added to their wealth. The Master said: He is no disciple of mine. You may beat the drum and attack him, my young friends. 季氏的财富已经超过周公，冉求还替他搜聚财物，使他更加富有。孔子说，他不是我的学生，你们公开声讨他，也可以。 云季氏富於周公者，季氏，魯大夫。 季氏比周天子王朝的周公还富了，而求呀，还替他聚敛附益。

t: Chai is simple, Shen is slow, Shi is showy, You is coarse
y: 柴也愚，参也鲁，师也辟，由也喭。
x: Chai is simple, Shen is slow, Shi is showy, You is coarse. 高柴质厚而少智，曾参迟钝，子张善于修饰外貌，仲由粗率。 云柴也愚者，柴，弟子也。其累在於愚也。 柴性愚直，参性鲁钝，师性偏辟，由性刚猛。

t: Hui comes close, yet he is often in want
y: 子曰：回也其庶乎，屡空。赐不受命，而货殖焉，亿则屡中。
x: The Master said: Hui comes close, yet he is often in want. Ci does not accept his lot and goes into trade; his guesses often hit the mark. 孔子说，颜回大概已经接近道了，却常常穷得没有东西；端木赐不肯安于天命，却经营财货，猜测行情常常猜中。 記者引孔子更舉顏子上列四子病重於先，自此以下解此義者凡有二通。 回呀！

t: Zizhang asked about the way of the good man
y: 子张问善人之道。子曰：不践迹，亦不入于室。
x: Zizhang asked about the way of the good man. The Master said: He does not follow in others' footsteps, yet he does not enter the inner room. 子张问善人行道的情形，孔子说，本性良善而尚未学习的人，不必循着前人的行迹也能不做恶事，却还不能进入圣人的境地。 云子張問善人之道者，此問善人，非聖人也。 子张问善人的行为。

t: Approving of someone because his talk is earnest — is he a true…
y: 子曰：论笃是与，君子者乎？色庄者乎？
x: The Master said: Approving of someone because his talk is earnest — is he a true gentleman, or only grave in appearance? 孔子说，只因一个人的言论笃实就赞许他，那么他究竟是真君子，还是只有庄重的外表呢？ 云論篤是與者，論篤者，是言語辨善，故優無惡可擇也。 但听他议论笃实，便赞许他，哪知他真是一君子呢？

t: Should I act at once on what I hear?
y: 子路问：闻斯行诸？子曰：有父兄在，如之何其闻斯行之？冉有问：闻斯行诸？子曰：闻斯行之。公西华曰：由也问闻斯行诸，子曰有父兄在；求也问闻斯行诸，子曰闻斯行之。赤也惑，敢问。子曰：求也退，故进之；由也兼人，故退之。
x: Zilu asked: Should I act at once on what I hear? The Master said: While your father and elder brothers are alive, how can you act at once on what you hear? Ran You asked: Should I act at once on what I hear? The Master said: Act at once on what you hear. Gongxi Hua said: When You asked, you said 'your father and elder brothers are alive'; when Qiu asked, you said 'act at once.' I am confused and venture to ask. The Master said: Qiu holds back, so I urged him on; You has the drive of two men, so I held him back. 子路问，听到应当做的事就去做吗，孔子说，有父兄在，怎么能听到就自己去做；冉有问同样的话，孔子却说，听到就去做。公西华问为什么两次回答不同，孔子说，冉求容易退缩，所以鼓励他向前；仲由好胜过人，所以让他退让些。 斯，此也。 是否听到了就该做呢？

t: The Master was in peril in Kuang, and Yan Yuan fell behind
y: 子畏于匡，颜渊后。子曰：吾以女为死矣。曰：子在，回何敢死？
x: The Master was in peril in Kuang, and Yan Yuan fell behind. The Master said: I thought you were dead. He said: While you live, Master, how would I dare die? 孔子在匡地受到围困，颜渊落在后面；见面后孔子说，我以为你死了，颜渊回答，老师还在，我怎么敢轻易去送死？ 猶是前被匡人誤圍時，顏淵與孔子俱為匡人所圍。 先生在匡被围，颜渊落在后。

t: Can Zhong You and Ran Qiu be called great ministers?
y: 季子然问：仲由、冉求可谓大臣与？子曰：吾以子为异之问，曾由与求之问。所谓大臣者：以道事君，不可则止。今由与求也，可谓具臣矣。曰：然则从之者与？子曰：弑父与君，亦不从也。
x: Ji Ziran asked: Can Zhong You and Ran Qiu be called great ministers? The Master said: I thought you would ask about someone remarkable, but you ask about You and Qiu. What is called a great minister serves his ruler by the Way, and when he cannot, he resigns. Now You and Qiu may be called ministers to fill a post. Then would they just go along? The Master said: In killing a father or a ruler, they would not go along. 季子然问仲由、冉求能不能称作大臣，孔子说，我以为你问的是不寻常的人，原来问他们；大臣应依道事君，不能这样做就离开，他们如今只能算备员之臣。季子然问，他们会事事顺从吗，孔子说，弑父弑君的事，他们也不会顺从。 季子然，季氏家之子弟也。 仲由、冉求是否可得称是大臣呀！

t: Zilu had Zigao made steward of Bi
y: 子路使子羔为费宰。子曰：贼夫人之子。子路曰：有民人焉，有社稷焉。何必读书，然后为学？子曰：是故恶夫佞者。
x: Zilu had Zigao made steward of Bi. The Master said: You are harming another man's son. Zilu said: There are people there, and altars to the land and grain. Why must one read books before one counts as learned? The Master said: This is why I dislike glib talkers. 子路让子羔做费邑的长官，孔子说，这是害了人家的孩子；子路说，那里有百姓、有社稷，何必读过书才算学习，孔子说，所以我厌恶这种强辩的人。 云子路使子羔為費宰者，費，季氏采邑也。 子路使子羔去当费宰。

t: Zilu, Zeng Xi, Ran You, and Gongxi Hua sat in attendance
y: 子路、曾皙、冉有、公西华侍坐。子曰：以吾一日长乎尔，毋吾以也。居则曰：不吾知也！如或知尔，则何以哉？子路率尔而对曰：千乘之国，摄乎大国之间，加之以师旅，因之以饥馑；由也为之，比及三年，可使有勇，且知方也。夫子哂之。求！尔何如？对曰：方六七十，如五六十，求也为之，比及三年，可使足民。如其礼乐，以俟君子。赤！尔何如？对曰：非曰能之，愿学焉。宗庙之事，如会同，端章甫，愿为小相焉。点！尔何如？鼓瑟希，铿尔，舍瑟而作。对曰：异乎三子者之撰。子曰：何伤乎？亦各言其志也。曰：莫春者，春服既成。冠者五六人，童子六七人，浴乎沂，风乎舞雩，咏而归。夫子喟然叹曰：吾与点也！三子者出，曾皙后。曾皙曰：夫三子者之言何如？子曰：亦各言其志也已矣。曰：夫子何哂由也？曰：为国以礼，其言不让，是故哂之。唯求则非邦也与？安见方六七十如五六十而非邦也者？唯赤则非邦也与？宗庙会同，非诸侯而何？赤也为之小，孰能为之大？
x: Zilu, Zeng Xi, Ran You, and Gongxi Hua sat in attendance. The Master said: Because I am a little older than you, do not hold back on my account. You often say, 'No one knows me.' If someone did know you, what would you do? Zilu answered at once: A state of a thousand chariots, hemmed in between great states, beset by armies and then by famine — if I governed it, in three years I could give the people courage and a sense of direction. The Master smiled at him. Qiu, what about you? He answered: A territory of sixty or seventy li, or fifty or sixty — if I governed it, in three years I could make the people have enough. As for ritual and music, I would wait for a gentleman. Chi, what about you? He answered: I do not say I could do it, but I would like to learn. At the ancestral temple, or at assemblies of the lords, in robe and cap, I would like to be a junior assistant. Dian, what about you? His zither-playing slowed, it rang out, and he set it aside and rose. He answered: Mine is different from what these three have chosen. The Master said: What harm is there? Each is just speaking of his aims. He said: In late spring, when the spring clothes are made, with five or six young men and six or seven boys, to bathe in the Yi, enjoy the breeze at the rain altar, and come home singing. The Master sighed deeply and said: I am with Dian! When the three went out, Zeng Xi stayed behind and said: What did you think of what those three said? The Master said: Each was just speaking of his aims. Why did you smile at You? To govern a state takes ritual, and his words were not modest; that is why I smiled. And was Qiu not speaking of a state? How is a territory of sixty or seventy li not a state? And was Chi not speaking of a state? The ancestral temple and assemblies — what are they if not the business of the lords? If Chi would be a junior, who could be a senior? 子路、曾皙、冉有、公西华陪孔子坐着，孔子说，不要因为我比你们年长就不敢说话，你们平常说没人了解自己，假如有人了解，会怎样做；子路抢先说，夹在大国之间、受战争和饥荒困扰的千乘之国，交给我三年，可使人勇敢而知所当行，孔子微笑，冉有说，方圆六七十或五六十里的小国，给我三年可使百姓富足，礼乐留待君子，公西华说，我不敢说已经能做，只愿学习，在宗庙祭祀或诸侯会同之时，穿礼服戴礼帽，做个赞礼的小助手，曾皙停瑟起身说，我的志向不同，暮春时节穿好春衣，同五六位成年人、六七个少年，在沂水沐浴、舞雩迎风，唱着歌回来，孔子叹道，我赞同曾点。三人出去后曾皙留下，问孔子怎样看他们、为什么笑子路，孔子说，他们只是各言其志，治国须讲礼，子路说话不谦让，所以笑他，冉求所说的小地方也是国家，公西华所说的宗庙会同也是诸侯之事，他若只做小助手，还有谁能做大助手呢？ 云子路云云者，此四弟子侍孔子坐也。 子路、曾晳、冉有、公西华四人在先生处侍坐。

t: Yan Yuan asked about humaneness
y: 颜渊问仁。子曰：克己复礼为仁。一日克己复礼，天下归仁焉。为仁由己，而由人乎哉？颜渊曰：请问其目。子曰：非礼勿视，非礼勿听，非礼勿言，非礼勿动。颜渊曰：回虽不敏，请事斯语矣。
x: Yan Yuan asked about humaneness. The Master said: To restrain oneself and return to ritual is humaneness. If for one day one could restrain oneself and return to ritual, the whole realm would turn to humaneness. Practicing humaneness comes from oneself — how could it come from others? Yan Yuan said: May I ask for the details? The Master said: Look at nothing contrary to ritual; listen to nothing contrary to ritual; say nothing contrary to ritual; do nothing contrary to ritual. Yan Yuan said: Though I am not quick, I will make these words my task. 颜渊问仁，孔子说，约束自身、回到礼就是仁，一旦做到，天下人都会称许你的仁，行仁在自己，难道在别人吗；颜渊请问具体条目，孔子说，不合礼的不看、不听、不说、不做。颜渊说，我虽不聪敏，请让我照这些话去做。 顏淵問孔子為仁之道也。 抑制自己，使言语行动都合于礼，就是仁。 颜渊问仁如何般求？

t: Zhonggong asked about humaneness
y: 仲弓问仁。子曰：出门如见大宾，使民如承大祭。己所不欲，勿施于人。在邦无怨，在家无怨。仲弓曰：雍虽不敏，请事斯语矣。
x: Zhonggong asked about humaneness. The Master said: Going out the gate, act as if receiving an honored guest; employing the people, act as if conducting a great sacrifice. What you do not want for yourself, do not do to others. In the state, there will be no resentment; in the family, there will be no resentment. Zhonggong said: Though I am not quick, I will make these words my task. 仲弓问仁，孔子说，出门待人如接见贵宾，役使百姓如承办大祭，自己不愿承受的，不施加给别人，仕于诸侯或卿大夫之家都不招怨恨；仲弓说，我虽不聪敏，请让我照这些话去做。 亦答仁道也。 出门〔工作〕好像去接待贵宾，役使百姓好像去承当大祀典，… 仲弓问仁。

t: Sima Niu asked about humaneness
y: 司马牛问仁。子曰：仁者其言也讱。曰：其言也讱，斯谓之仁已乎？子曰：为之难，言之得无讱乎？
x: Sima Niu asked about humaneness. The Master said: The humane are slow to speak. He said: Slow to speak — is that all it takes to be called humane? The Master said: When doing is hard, can one help being slow to speak? 司马牛问仁，孔子说，仁者说话谨慎、不轻易出口；司马牛问，只是说话谨慎就算仁了吗，孔子说，做起来不容易，说的时候能不谨慎吗？ 云司馬牛問仁者，司馬牛是桓魋弟也。 司马牛问仁德。 司马牛问仁。

t: Sima Niu asked about the gentleman
y: 司马牛问君子。子曰：君子不忧不惧。曰：不忧不惧，斯谓之君子已乎？子曰：内省不疚，夫何忧何惧？
x: Sima Niu asked about the gentleman. The Master said: The gentleman neither worries nor fears. He said: Neither worrying nor fearing — is that all it takes to be called a gentleman? The Master said: If one looks within and finds nothing amiss, what is there to worry about or fear? 司马牛问君子，孔子说，君子不忧不惧；司马牛问，不忧不惧就算君子了吗，孔子说，反省自己没有愧疚，又有什么可忧可惧的？ 牛兄桓魋將為亂，牛自宋來學，常憂懼，故孔子解之。 司马牛问怎样去做一个君子。 如何可得谓君子？

t: Sima Niu said sorrowfully: Everyone has brothers
y: 司马牛忧曰：人皆有兄弟，我独亡。子夏曰：商闻之矣：死生有命，富贵在天。君子敬而无失，与人恭而有礼。四海之内，皆兄弟也。君子何患乎无兄弟也？
x: Sima Niu said sorrowfully: Everyone has brothers; I alone have none. Zixia said: I have heard this: life and death are a matter of fate; wealth and rank rest with Heaven. If a gentleman is reverent and makes no mistakes, respectful to others and observant of ritual, then all within the four seas are his brothers. Why should a gentleman worry about having no brothers? 司马牛忧愁地说，别人都有兄弟，只有我没有；子夏说，我听说，死生有命、富贵在天，君子自己敬谨而不失，与人相处恭敬有礼，四海之内都可像兄弟，何必忧虑没有兄弟呢？ 為其兄桓魋有罪，故恆憂也。 别人都有好兄弟，单单我没有。 人人皆有兄弟，独我没有呀！

t: Zizhang asked about clear-sightedness
y: 子张问明。子曰：浸润之谮，肤受之愬，不行焉；可谓明也已矣。浸润之谮，肤受之愬，不行焉；可谓远也已矣。
x: Zizhang asked about clear-sightedness. The Master said: One on whom slander that seeps in slowly and complaints that cut to the skin have no effect may be called clear-sighted. One on whom they have no effect may be called far-sighted. 子张问什么叫明察，孔子说，慢慢渗入的毁谤和迫近自身利害的诉冤，都不能在这里得逞，就可以算明察，也可以算看得远了。 云子張問明者，問人行事而可謂之明乎。 子张问怎样才叫做见事明白。 怎样可算是明呀？

t: Zigong asked about government
y: 子贡问政。子曰：足食。足兵。民信之矣。子贡曰：必不得已而去，于斯三者何先？曰：去兵。子贡曰：必不得已而去，于斯二者何先？曰：去食。自古皆有死，民无信不立。
x: Zigong asked about government. The Master said: Enough food, enough arms, and the trust of the people. Zigong said: If one had no choice but to give up one of the three, which first? The Master said: Give up arms. Zigong said: If one had no choice but to give up one of the remaining two, which first? The Master said: Give up food. Since ancient times, all have died; without the people's trust, nothing stands. 子贡问政，孔子说，粮食充足、军备充足，百姓信任你；子贡问，迫不得已要去掉一项先去什么，孔子说，去军备，再问剩下两项先去什么，孔子说，去粮食。自古人都有一死，百姓没有信任，国家便立不住。 問為政之法也。 充足粮食，充足军备，百姓对政府就有信心了。 子贡问为政之道。

t: A gentleman is substance, that is all
y: 棘子成曰：君子质而已矣，何以文为？子贡曰：惜乎！夫子之说，君子也。驷不及舌。文犹质也，质犹文也。虎豹之鞟犹犬羊之鞟。
x: Ji Zicheng said: A gentleman is substance, that is all; what need is there for refinement? Zigong said: What a pity, sir, that you speak of the gentleman so! A team of four horses cannot overtake the tongue. Refinement is as important as substance, and substance as refinement. The hide of a tiger or leopard, stripped of its hair, is just like the hide of a dog or sheep. 棘子成说，君子有质朴就够了，何必讲文饰；子贡说，可惜，你这番话本有君子的用意，却已经说出口、四匹马也追不回，文饰和质地同样要紧，去掉毛文，虎豹的皮同犬羊的皮也没有分别了。 棘子城云君子之行，但備質樸而足，何必用於文華乎。 先生这样地谈论君子，可惜说错了。 君子只要质就够了，何用再加以文呀？

t: Duke Ai asked You Ruo: The harvest is poor and there is not…
y: 哀公问于有若曰：年饥，用不足，如之何？有若对曰：盍彻乎？曰：二，吾犹不足，如之何其彻也？对曰：百姓足，君孰与不足？百姓不足，君孰与足？
x: Duke Ai asked You Ruo: The harvest is poor and there is not enough for expenses. What should be done? You Ruo replied: Why not tax at one tenth? The Duke said: Even at two tenths I do not have enough; how could I tax at one tenth? He replied: When the people have enough, how can the ruler not have enough? When the people do not have enough, how can the ruler have enough? 哀公问有若，年成不好、国用不足怎么办，有若说，何不实行十分取一的彻法；哀公说，取十分之二还不够，怎么能只取一，有若说，百姓足，国君怎么会不足，百姓不足，国君又能和谁一起富足呢？ 哀公愚暗，政苦賦重，故民廢其業。 年成不好，国家用度不够，应该怎么办？ 年岁荒歉，国用不足，有何办法呀？

t: Zizhang asked about exalting virtue and discerning delusion
y: 子张问崇德、辨惑。子曰：主忠信，徙义，崇德也。爱之欲其生，恶之欲其死。既欲其生，又欲其死，是惑也。诚不以富，亦祗以异。
x: Zizhang asked about exalting virtue and discerning delusion. The Master said: Hold loyalty and good faith as primary and move toward what is right — that is exalting virtue. When you love someone you want him to live; when you hate him you want him to die. Wanting him to live and also wanting him to die — that is delusion. 'Truly it is not for wealth, but only for something different.' 子张问怎样增进德行、分清迷惑，孔子说，以忠信为本，见义就迁从，是增德；爱一个人就希望他活、厌恶他又希望他死，既希望他活又希望他死，就是迷惑。所引诗句说，实在不是因为富有，只是因为不同。 子張問求崇重有德，辨別疑惑之法也。 子张问如何去提高品德，辨别迷惑。 如何可算得崇德辨惑呀！

t: Duke Jing of Qi asked Confucius about government
y: 齐景公问政于孔子。孔子对曰：君君，臣臣，父父，子子。公曰：善哉！信如君不君，臣不臣，父不父，子不子，虽有粟，吾得而食诸？
x: Duke Jing of Qi asked Confucius about government. Confucius replied: Let the ruler be a ruler, the minister a minister, the father a father, the son a son. The Duke said: Excellent! Truly, if the ruler is not a ruler, the minister not a minister, the father not a father, the son not a son, even if there is grain, would I get to eat it? 齐景公问政，孔子说，君主要尽君主之道，臣子、父亲、儿子也要各尽其道；景公说，好啊，若都不能各尽其道，即使有粮食，我还能安稳地吃到吗？ 于時齊弱，為其臣陳恒所制，景公患之，故問政方法於孔子也。 君要像个君，臣要像个臣，父亲要像父亲，儿子要像儿子。 齐景公问为政之道于孔子。

t: One who could settle a lawsuit with half a word — that would be…
y: 子曰：片言可以折狱者，其由也与？子路无宿诺。
x: The Master said: One who could settle a lawsuit with half a word — that would be You, would it not? Zilu never slept on a promise. 孔子说，只用半句话就能使人信服、断定诉讼的，大概是仲由吧。子路答应的事，不会拖延着不去做。 片，猶偏也。折獄，謂判辨獄訟之事也。 根据一方面的语言就可以判决案件的，大概只有仲由吧！ 凭着片面之辞而便可断狱的，怕只有子路的话吧！

t: In hearing lawsuits I am like anyone else
y: 子曰：听讼，吾犹人也，必也使无讼乎！
x: The Master said: In hearing lawsuits I am like anyone else. What is needed is to make sure there are no lawsuits! 孔子说，审理诉讼，我和别人差不多；若一定要有所作为，应当使百姓不再发生诉讼。 孔子言若有訟而使我聽決之，則我與人不異。 审理诉讼，我同别人差不多。 若论听讼，我也和人差不多呀！

t: Zizhang asked about government
y: 子张问政。子曰：居之无倦，行之以忠。
x: Zizhang asked about government. The Master said: Hold your post without weariness, and carry it out with loyalty. 子张问政，孔子说，存心始终不懈怠，做事尽心尽力。 問為政方法也。 在位不要疲倦懈怠，执行政令要忠心。 子张问为政之道。

t: Learn broadly in culture and restrain it with ritual, and you…
y: 子曰：博学于文，约之以礼，亦可以弗畔矣夫！
x: The Master said: Learn broadly in culture and restrain it with ritual, and you may thereby avoid going astray. 孔子说，广泛学习文献知识，用礼约束自己，就可以不背离道了吧。 能以禮約束也。

t: The gentleman helps others achieve what is good in them, not…
y: 子曰：君子成人之美，不成人之恶。小人反是。
x: The Master said: The gentleman helps others achieve what is good in them, not what is bad. The petty man does the opposite. 孔子说，君子帮助别人成就好事，不帮助别人成就坏事；小人正好相反。 美與己同，故成之也。 君子成全别人的好事，不促成别人的坏事。 君子助成别人的美处，不助成别人的恶处，小人恰恰和此相反。

t: Ji Kangzi asked Confucius about government
y: 季康子问政于孔子。孔子对曰：政者，正也。子帅以正，孰敢不正？
x: Ji Kangzi asked Confucius about government. Confucius replied: To govern is to be correct. If you lead by being correct, who will dare not be correct? 季康子问政，孔子说，政就是正，你以正道带头，谁敢不正呢？ 季康子，魯上卿，諸臣之帥也。 季康子向孔子问政治。 季康子以为政之道问孔子。

t: Ji Kangzi was troubled by thieves and asked Confucius
y: 季康子患盗，问于孔子。孔子对曰：苟子之不欲，虽赏之不窃。
x: Ji Kangzi was troubled by thieves and asked Confucius. Confucius replied: If you yourself did not covet, they would not steal even if you rewarded them for it. 季康子为盗贼忧虑，问孔子；孔子说，如果你自己不贪求财物，即使奖赏百姓去偷，他们也不会偷。 國內多偷盜，故問於孔子求除盜之法也。 季康子苦于盗贼太多，向孔子求教。 季康子患虑鲁国多盗，求问于孔子。

t: Ji Kangzi asked Confucius about government: What if I killed…
y: 季康子问政于孔子曰：如杀无道，以就有道，何如？孔子对曰：子为政，焉用杀？子欲善，而民善矣。君子之德风，小人之德草。草上之风，必偃。
x: Ji Kangzi asked Confucius about government: What if I killed those without the Way in order to bring about the Way? Confucius replied: In governing, why use killing? If you desire the good, the people will be good. The virtue of the gentleman is the wind; the virtue of the petty man is the grass. When the wind passes over the grass, it surely bends. 季康子问，杀掉无道的人来成就有道，怎样，孔子说，你主持政事，何必用杀，你愿意向善，百姓也会向善。在上者的德行像风，百姓的德行像草，风吹到草上，草必随之倒伏。 就，成也。 您想把国家搞好，百姓就会好起来。 如能杀无道的来成全有道的，如何呀？

t: What must a scholar be like to be called accomplished?
y: 子张问：士何如斯可谓之达矣？子曰：何哉，尔所谓达者？子张对曰：在邦必闻，在家必闻。子曰：是闻也，非达也。夫达也者，质直而好义，察言而观色，虑以下人。在邦必达，在家必达。夫闻也者，色取仁而行违，居之不疑。在邦必闻，在家必闻。
x: Zizhang asked: What must a scholar be like to be called accomplished? The Master said: What do you mean by accomplished? Zizhang replied: Known throughout the state, known throughout the clan. The Master said: That is being known, not being accomplished. The accomplished man is upright in substance and loves what is right; he weighs people's words and observes their looks, and is mindful to put himself below others. He is sure to succeed in the state and in the clan. As for the man who is merely known, he puts on a look of humaneness but acts against it, and dwells in this without doubt. He is sure to be known in the state and in the clan. 子张问士怎样才算通达，孔子反问他所谓通达是什么，子张说，在诸侯国或卿大夫之家都名声显著，孔子说，那是有名声，不是通达。真正通达的人质朴正直而爱义，观察别人的言语神色，处处谦下，所以在哪里都通达；只求名声的人，外表装成仁而行为违仁，自己却安然不疑，所以在哪里也都能取得名声。 問士通若為德行，而謂得為達也。 做国家的官时一定有名望，在大夫家工作时一定有名望。 一个士如何才算是达了？

t: Fan Chi was walking with the Master below the rain altar and…
y: 樊迟从游于舞雩之下，曰：敢问崇德、修慝、辨惑。子曰：善哉问！先事后得，非崇德与？攻其恶，无攻人之恶，非修慝与？一朝之忿，忘其身，以及其亲，非惑与？
x: Fan Chi was walking with the Master below the rain altar and said: May I ask about exalting virtue, rooting out hidden faults, and discerning delusion? The Master said: A good question! Putting the work first and the reward after — is that not exalting virtue? Attacking your own faults and not those of others — is that not rooting out hidden faults? In a morning's anger forgetting yourself and even your parents — is that not delusion? 樊迟随孔子游舞雩，问怎样增德、除内心之恶、辨惑；孔子说，问得好，先办事后计所得，不是增德吗，治自己的恶而不专攻别人的恶，不是去恶吗，一时愤怒而忘了自己的安危，还牵累父母，不是迷惑吗？ 既從遊，而問此三事也。 请问怎样提高自己的品德，怎样消除别人对自己不露面的怨恨，… 敢问怎样崇德修慝辨惑呀？

t: Fan Chi asked about humaneness
y: 樊迟问仁。子曰：爱人。问知。子曰：知人。樊迟未达。子曰：举直错诸枉，能使枉者直。樊迟退，见子夏。曰：乡也，吾见于夫子而问知，子曰：举直错诸枉，能使枉者直。何谓也？子夏曰：富哉言乎！舜有天下，选于众，举皋陶，不仁者远矣。汤有天下，选于众，举伊尹，不仁者远矣。
x: Fan Chi asked about humaneness. The Master said: Love others. He asked about wisdom. The Master said: Know others. Fan Chi did not understand. The Master said: Raise up the straight and set them over the crooked, and the crooked can be made straight. Fan Chi withdrew and went to see Zixia, saying: Just now I saw the Master and asked about wisdom, and he said, 'Raise up the straight and set them over the crooked, and the crooked can be made straight.' What does this mean? Zixia said: How rich these words are! When Shun held the realm, he chose from among the many and raised up Gao Yao, and the inhumane went far away. When Tang held the realm, he chose from among the many and raised up Yi Yin, and the inhumane went far away. 樊迟问仁，孔子说，爱人，问智，孔子说，知人；樊迟还不明白，孔子说，把正直的人举出来，放在邪曲者之上，能使邪曲者也变正直。樊迟退后请教子夏，子夏说，这话意思多么丰富，舜从众人中选举皋陶、汤从众人中选举伊尹，不仁者就都远离了。 問為仁之道也。 把正直人提拔出来，位置在邪恶人之上，能够使邪恶人正直。 如何是仁？

t: Zigong asked about friendship
y: 子贡问友。子曰：忠告而善道之，不可则止，毋自辱焉。
x: Zigong asked about friendship. The Master said: Advise him faithfully and guide him well; if that fails, stop. Do not bring humiliation on yourself. 子贡问交友，孔子说，诚恳相告，善加劝导，不被接受就暂且停止，不要弄到自己受辱。 諮求朋友之道也。 忠心地劝告他，好好地引导他，他不听从，也就罢了，… 子贡问交友之道。

t: The gentleman gathers friends through culture, and through…
y: 曾子曰：君子以文会友，以友辅仁。
x: Zengzi said: The gentleman gathers friends through culture, and through friends supports his humaneness. 曾子说，君子以学习文献来会合朋友，又以朋友的帮助来增进仁德。 君子友相會，以文德為本也。 君子用文章学问来聚会朋友，用朋友来帮助我培养仁德。 君子因于礼乐文章之讲习来会合朋友。

t: Zilu asked about government
y: 子路问政。子曰：先之，劳之。请益。曰：无倦。
x: Zilu asked about government. The Master said: Go before the people and work hard for them. He asked for more. The Master said: Do not grow weary. 子路问政，孔子说，自己先给百姓做榜样，亲自为他们的事操劳；子路请再说一些，孔子说，不要懈怠。 云子路問政者，問為政之法也。 自己给百姓带头，然后让他们勤劳地工作。 子路请问为政之道。

t: Zhonggong, as steward of the Ji family, asked about government
y: 仲弓为季氏宰，问政。子曰：先有司，赦小过，举贤才。曰：焉知贤才而举之？曰：举尔所知。尔所不知，人其舍诸？
x: Zhonggong, as steward of the Ji family, asked about government. The Master said: Put your officers first, pardon small faults, and raise up the worthy and talented. He said: How can I know the worthy and talented to raise them? The Master said: Raise those you know. Those you do not know — will others pass them over? 仲弓做季氏家宰，问政，孔子说，先让各职官员做各自的事，宽免小过，举用贤能；仲弓问怎样知道贤能而举用，孔子说，先举用你所知道的，你不知道的，别人难道会把他们丢下吗？ 云仲弓為季氏宰問政者，仲弓將往費為季氏采邑之宰，故先諮問孔子，求為政之法也。 仲弓做了季氏的总管，向孔子问政治。 仲弓做了季氏宰，请问为政之道。

t: The ruler of Wei is waiting for you to govern
y: 子路曰：卫君待子而为政，子将奚先？子曰：必也，正名乎？子路曰：有是哉，子之迂也。奚其正？子曰：野哉由也！君子于其所不知，盖阙如也。名不正，则言不顺；言不顺，则事不成；事不成，则礼乐不兴；礼乐不兴，则刑罚不中；刑罚不中，则民无所措手足。故君子名之必可言也，言之必可行也。君子于其言，无所苟而已矣。
x: Zilu said: The ruler of Wei is waiting for you to govern. What will you do first? The Master said: It must be to rectify names! Zilu said: Is that so? How impractical you are, Master! Why rectify them? The Master said: How crude you are, You! A gentleman leaves aside what he does not know. If names are not correct, speech does not follow; if speech does not follow, affairs do not succeed; if affairs do not succeed, ritual and music do not flourish; if ritual and music do not flourish, punishments miss the mark; if punishments miss the mark, the people do not know where to put hand or foot. So when a gentleman names something, it must be sayable; when he says it, it must be doable. In his words the gentleman allows nothing careless. 子路问，卫君等着您主持政事，您先做什么，孔子说，先端正名分吧；子路嫌这太迂远，孔子说，仲由真粗率，不知道的事应当暂留不说。名分不正，言语便不合道理，事情就办不成，礼乐不能兴，刑罚失当，百姓便不知如何举措，所以君子所定的名必须说得通，说出的话必须行得通，一言也不可苟且。 云子路曰云云者，子，孔子也。 那一定是纠正名分上的用词不当罢！ 如卫君有意等待先生来主政，先生对卫事将何从下手呀？

t: Fan Chi asked to learn farming
y: 樊迟请学稼，子曰：吾不如老农。请学为圃。曰：吾不如老圃。樊迟出。子曰：小人哉，樊须也！上好礼，则民莫敢不敬；上好义，则民莫敢不服；上好信，则民莫敢不用情。夫如是，则四方之民襁负其子而至矣，焉用稼？
x: Fan Chi asked to learn farming. The Master said: I am not as good as an old farmer. He asked to learn gardening. The Master said: I am not as good as an old gardener. Fan Chi went out. The Master said: What a petty man Fan Xu is! If those above love ritual, the people will not dare be irreverent; if those above love what is right, the people will not dare disobey; if those above love good faith, the people will not dare be insincere. If it is so, the people of the four quarters will come with their children strapped on their backs. What need is there for farming? 樊迟请学种庄稼、种蔬菜，孔子分别说自己不如老农、老园丁；樊迟出去后，孔子说，樊须想的只是细民之事，在上者爱礼、义、信，百姓就会敬、服而用真情，四方的人会背着孩子来归，何必专学种田呢？ 云樊遲請學稼者，樊須字子遲，稼者種五穀之名，樊遲請於孔子求學種五穀之術也。 统治者讲究礼节，百姓就没有人敢不尊敬；统治者行为正当，… 樊迟请学稼穑之学。

t: One may recite the three hundred Odes, yet when given a post in…
y: 子曰：诵诗三百，授之以政，不达；使于四方，不能专对；虽多，亦奚以为？
x: The Master said: One may recite the three hundred Odes, yet when given a post in government, fail to carry it out, and when sent on missions abroad, be unable to answer on his own. However many he has learned, what use are they? 孔子说，熟读三百篇诗，交给他政事却不能办通，派到各国又不能独立应对，即使读得多，又有什么用呢？ 云誦詩三百者，不用文，背文而念曰誦。 熟读《诗经》三百篇，交给他以政治任务，却办不通；… 诵习了三百首诗，授他以政事，不能通达。

t: If he himself is correct, things are done without orders
y: 子曰：其身正，不令而行；其身不正，虽令不从。
x: The Master said: If he himself is correct, things are done without orders; if he himself is not correct, even with orders they are not obeyed. 孔子说，自己端正，不下命令，事情也能推行；自己不正，即使下命令，人也不服从。 云其身正不令而行者，如直形而影自直。 统治者本身行为正当，不发命令，事情也行得通。 他身正了，不待下令，那事也就行了。

t: The governments of Lu and Wei are brothers
y: 子曰：鲁卫之政，兄弟也。
x: The Master said: The governments of Lu and Wei are brothers. 孔子说，鲁国、卫国的政治，真像兄弟一样。 魯是周公之封，衛是康叔之封，周公康叔是兄弟。 鲁国的政治和卫国的政治，像兄弟一般〔地相差不远〕。 鲁卫两国的政事，真像是兄弟呀！

t: The Master said of Prince Jing of Wei that he managed his…
y: 子谓卫公子荆，善居室。始有，曰：苟合矣。少有，曰：苟完矣。富有，曰：苟美矣。
x: The Master said of Prince Jing of Wei that he managed his household well. When he first had something, he said: It will more or less do. When he had a little more, he said: It is more or less complete. When he was rich, he said: It is more or less fine. 孔子说，卫国公子荆善于经营家业：刚有些家产，就说粗略聚起来了，稍多些，就说粗略齐备了，富有了，又说粗略美好了。 云子謂云云者，衛公子荆是衛家公子也。 他善于居家过日子，刚有一点，便说道：‘差不多够了。 卫公子荆可称得善于处理家业了。

t: The Master went to Wei, with Ran You driving
y: 子适卫，冉有仆。子曰：庶矣哉！冉有曰：既庶矣，又何加焉？曰：富之。曰：既富矣，又何加焉？曰：教之。
x: The Master went to Wei, with Ran You driving. The Master said: How numerous the people are! Ran You said: Now that they are numerous, what more should be done? Make them prosperous. Now that they are prosperous, what more should be done? Teach them. 孔子到卫国，冉有驾车，孔子叹百姓多；冉有问，人多以后还应加什么，孔子说，让他们富足，问富足之后再加什么，孔子说，教育他们。 云子適衛冉子僕者，適，往也，僕，御車也。 孔子到卫国，冉有替他驾车子。 先生到卫国，冉有为先生赶车。

t: If anyone would employ me, within a year things would be in…
y: 子曰：苟有用我者，期月而已可也，三年有成。
x: The Master said: If anyone would employ me, within a year things would be in fair shape, and in three years there would be results. 孔子说，如果有人任用我，一年就可以初立纲纪，三年便能有所成就。 云子曰云云者，苟，誠也。 假若有用我主持国家政事的，一年便差不多了，三年便会很有成绩。 苟有能用我之人，一周年的时间便好了。

t: If good men governed a state for a hundred years, they could…
y: 子曰：善人为邦百年，亦可以胜残去杀矣。诚哉是言也！
x: The Master said: 'If good men governed a state for a hundred years, they could overcome cruelty and do away with killing.' How true this saying is! 孔子说，善人相继治理国家百年，也能化除残暴，不再用刑杀，这话确实说得对啊。 云子曰云云者，善人謂賢人也。 善人治理国政连续到一百年，也可以克服残暴免除虐杀了。 古人说过：‘有善人来主持国政，经历一百年之久，…

t: Even with a true king, it would take a generation for…
y: 子曰：如有王者，必世而后仁。
x: The Master said: Even with a true king, it would take a generation for humaneness to prevail. 孔子说，如果有圣王兴起，也要经过一代，才能使仁的教化深入人心。 王者謂聖人為天子也。 假若有王者兴起，—定需要三十年才能使仁政大行。 如有一位王者兴起，也必三十年时间，才能使仁道行于天下呀！

t: If he can make himself correct, what difficulty would he have…
y: 子曰：苟正其身矣，于从政乎何有？不能正其身，如正人何？
x: The Master said: If he can make himself correct, what difficulty would he have in government? If he cannot make himself correct, how can he correct others? 孔子说，如果端正了自己，主持政事有什么难；连自己也不能端正，又怎么端正别人呢？ 云子曰云云者，苟，誠也。 假若端正了自己，治理国政有什么困难呢？ 苟能自己身正了，这于从事政治还有何难呀？

t: Ran Zi returned from court
y: 冉子退朝。子曰：何晏也？对曰：有政。子曰：其事也。如有政，虽不吾以，吾其与闻之。
x: Ran Zi returned from court. The Master said: Why so late? He replied: There was state business. The Master said: It must have been family business. If there had been state business, though I am not in office, I would have heard of it. 冉有从季氏私朝回来，孔子问为什么这样晚，冉有说，有政务；孔子说，那是家事，若有国家政务，即使不任用我，我也应当知道。 云冉子退朝者，退朝謂旦朝竟而還家，朝廷云退也。 若是有政务，虽然不用我了，我也会知道的。 冉有在季氏的私朝退下，来见先生。

t: Is there a single saying that can make a state flourish?
y: 定公问：一言而可以兴邦，有诸？孔子对曰：言不可以若是其几也。人之言曰：为君难，为臣不易。如知为君之难也，不几乎一言而兴邦乎？曰：一言而丧邦，有诸？孔子对曰：言不可以若是其几也。人之言曰：予无乐乎为君，唯其言而莫予违也。如其善而莫之违也，不亦善乎？如不善而莫之违也，不几乎一言而丧邦乎？
x: Duke Ding asked: Is there a single saying that can make a state flourish? Confucius replied: A saying cannot be expected to do that much. But people say, 'It is hard to be a ruler, and not easy to be a minister.' If one understood how hard it is to be a ruler, would that not come close to a single saying making a state flourish? He asked: Is there a single saying that can ruin a state? Confucius replied: A saying cannot be expected to do that much. But people say, 'I take no joy in being ruler, except that no one contradicts what I say.' If what he says is good and no one contradicts it, is that not good? If what he says is not good and no one contradicts it, would that not come close to a single saying ruining a state? 定公问，有一句话就能兴国的事吗，孔子说，不能这样指望言语必有成效，不过若知道为君为臣不易，因而谨慎，岂不接近一句话兴国。定公又问一句话亡国，孔子说，也不能这样指望，不过有人只以做国君说话无人敢违为乐，话善而无人违尚好，话不善也无人违，岂不接近一句话亡国？ 云定公問云云者，定公，魯君也。 说话不可以像这样地简单机械。 只一句话便可兴国，有吗？

t: The Duke of She asked about government
y: 叶公问政。子曰：近者说，远者来。
x: The Duke of She asked about government. The Master said: When those near are pleased and those far away come. 叶公问政，孔子说，让近处的人悦服，远处的人来归。 云葉公問政者，葉公亦問孔子為政之道。 境内的人使他高兴，境外的人使他来投奔。 叶公问行政之道。

t: Zixia, as steward of Jufu, asked about government
y: 子夏为莒父宰，问政。子曰：无欲速，无见小利。欲速，则不达；见小利，则大事不成。
x: Zixia, as steward of Jufu, asked about government. The Master said: Do not seek speed; do not look to small gains. Seek speed and you will not get there; look to small gains and great affairs will not be accomplished. 子夏做莒父长官，问政，孔子说，不要急求速成，不要只看小利；急求速成反而达不到，专看小利，大事就办不成。 云子夏為莒父宰問政者，子夏欲往莒父為宰，故先問孔子為政之法也。 子夏做了莒父的县长，问政治。 子夏当了莒父宰，问行政之道。

t: The Duke of She said to Confucius: In my village there is an…
y: 叶公语孔子曰：吾党有直躬者，其父攘羊，而子证之。孔子曰：吾党之直者异于是。父为子隐，子为父隐，直在其中矣。
x: The Duke of She said to Confucius: In my village there is an upright man. When his father stole a sheep, the son bore witness against him. Confucius said: The upright in my village are different. The father covers for the son, and the son covers for the father. Uprightness lies in this. 叶公告诉孔子，乡里有个正直的人，父亲偷羊，儿子作证告发；孔子说，我乡里的直者不同，父亲为儿子隐瞒，儿子为父亲隐瞒，直道就在其中。 云葉公云云者，葉公稱己鄉黨中有直躬之人，欲自矜誇於孔子也。 我那里有个坦白直率的人，他父亲偷了羊，他便告发。 我们这里有一个能行直道的人，他父亲盗窃人羊，他出来证明了。

t: Fan Chi asked about humaneness
y: 樊迟问仁。子曰：居处恭，执事敬，与人忠。虽之夷狄，不可弃也。
x: Fan Chi asked about humaneness. The Master said: Be respectful at home, reverent in handling affairs, loyal in dealing with others. Even among the barbarian tribes, these cannot be abandoned. 樊迟问仁，孔子说，平常居处恭谨，办事敬慎，待人尽心，即使到了夷狄之地，也不可放弃。 云樊遲問仁者，問孔子行仁之道也。 平日容貌态度端正庄严，工作严肃认真，为别人忠心诚意。 樊迟问仁道。

t: What must one be like to be called a scholar?
y: 子贡问曰：何如斯可谓之士矣？子曰：行己有耻，使于四方，不辱君命，可谓士矣。曰：敢问其次。曰：宗族称孝焉，乡党称弟焉。曰：敢问其次。曰：言必信，行必果，硁硁然小人哉！抑亦可以为次矣。曰：今之从政者何如？子曰：噫！斗筲之人，何足算也。
x: Zigong asked: What must one be like to be called a scholar? The Master said: One who conducts himself with a sense of shame, and when sent abroad does not disgrace his ruler's commission, may be called a scholar. He said: May I ask about the next level? One whose clan praises his filial piety and whose village praises his respect for elders. May I ask about the next? One whose word is always kept and whose actions are always carried through — stubborn little men! Yet they may count as the next level. He said: What about those in government today? The Master said: Ah! Men of the peck and the bushel — hardly worth counting. 子贡问怎样算士，孔子说，行己知耻，出使不辱君命就算士；再问次一等，答宗族称孝、乡里称弟，再问其次，答言必兑现、做事必坚持到底，虽是拘执浅狭的人，也还能列为其次。子贡问如今从政者怎样，孔子叹道，那些器量像斗筲一样小的人，哪里值得算上。 云子貢問云云者，謂問在朝為士之法，是卿大夫可知也。 自己行为保持羞耻之心，出使外国，很好地完成君主的使命，… 如何才算士？

t: If I cannot find those who walk the middle way to associate…
y: 子曰：不得中行而与之，必也狂狷乎！狂者进取，狷者有所不为也。
x: The Master said: If I cannot find those who walk the middle way to associate with, then I must have the ardent and the cautious! The ardent press forward; the cautious have things they will not do. 孔子说，得不到行事合乎中道的人来相处，便取狂者、狷者吧；狂者有志进取，狷者也有所不肯做。 云不得中行而與之者，中行，行能得其中者也。 得不到言行合乎中庸的人和他相交，… 我不得中道之士和他在一起，那只有狂狷了。

t: The southerners have a saying: 'A man without constancy cannot…
y: 子曰：南人有言曰：人而无恒，不可以作巫医。善夫！不恒其德，或承之羞。子曰：不占而已矣。
x: The Master said: The southerners have a saying: 'A man without constancy cannot even be a shaman or a doctor.' Well said! 'If one is not constant in his virtue, he may meet with disgrace.' The Master said: Such a man simply need not divine. 孔子说，南方有句话，人没有恒心，连巫医也做不了，说得好；又引易辞说，德行不能恒久，就会招来羞辱。孔子说，不过是不占问罢了。 云子曰云云者，南人，南國人也。 南方人有句话说：‘人假若没有恒心，连巫医都做不了。 南方人有句话说：‘人若无恒，不可当巫医。

t: The gentleman is harmonious but does not conform
y: 子曰：君子和而不同，小人同而不和。
x: The Master said: The gentleman is harmonious but does not conform; the petty man conforms but is not harmonious. 孔子说，君子和睦而不一味附和，小人一味附和却不能和睦。 云君子和而不同者，和謂心不爭也。 君子用自己的正确意见来纠正别人的错误意见，… 君子能相和，但不相同。

t: What if everyone in the village likes him?
y: 子贡问曰：乡人皆好之，何如？子曰：未可也。乡人皆恶之，何如？子曰：未可也。不如乡人之善者好之，其不善者恶之。
x: Zigong asked: What if everyone in the village likes him? The Master said: Not enough. What if everyone in the village dislikes him? The Master said: Not enough. Better that the good people of the village like him and the bad ones dislike him. 子贡问，乡里人都喜欢一个人，怎样，孔子说，还不能断定；又问都厌恶他怎样，孔子说，也不能断定，不如乡里善人喜欢他、不善的人厌恶他。 云子貢問云云者，子貢問孔子云，設有一人為鄉人共所崇好，則此人如何。 最好是满乡村的好人都喜欢他，满乡村的坏人都厌恶他。 一乡之人都喜好他，如何呢？

t: The gentleman is easy to serve but hard to please
y: 子曰：君子易事而难说也：说之不以道，不说也；及其使人也，器之。小人难事而易说也：说之虽不以道，说也；及其使人也，求备焉。
x: The Master said: The gentleman is easy to serve but hard to please. Try to please him by other than the Way, and he is not pleased; when he employs people, he uses each according to his capacity. The petty man is hard to serve but easy to please. Try to please him by other than the Way, and he is pleased; when he employs people, he expects everything of them. 孔子说，君子容易共事却难以讨好，不合道的取悦他不接受，用人则量才而使；小人难以共事却容易讨好，取悦不合道也接受，用人却要求样样齐备。 云君子易事難說也者，君子忠恕，故易事也。 在君子底下工作很容易，讨他的欢喜却难。 君子易于和他共事，但难于得他喜欢。

t: The gentleman is at ease but not arrogant
y: 子曰：君子泰而不骄，小人骄而不泰。
x: The Master said: The gentleman is at ease but not arrogant; the petty man is arrogant but not at ease. 孔子说，君子安舒而不骄纵，小人骄纵却不能安舒。 云君子泰而不驕者，君子坦蕩蕩，心貌怡平，是泰而不為驕慢也。 君子安详舒泰，却不骄傲凌人；小人骄傲凌人，却不安详舒泰。 君子舒泰，但不骄矜。

t: Firm, resolute, simple, slow to speak — these are close to…
y: 子曰：刚毅、木讷，近仁。
x: The Master said: Firm, resolute, simple, slow to speak — these are close to humaneness. 孔子说，刚强坚毅、质朴少言的人，接近仁。 言此四事與仁相似，故云近仁。 刚强、果决、朴质而言语不轻易出口，有这四种品德的人近于仁德。 刚强的，坚毅的，质朴的，讷言的，那四者都近仁。

t: What must one be like to be called a scholar?
y: 子路问曰：何如斯可谓之士矣？子曰：切切、偲偲、怡怡如也，可谓士矣。朋友切切、偲偲，兄弟怡怡。
x: Zilu asked: What must one be like to be called a scholar? The Master said: Earnest, encouraging, and congenial — such a one may be called a scholar. Earnest and encouraging with friends, congenial with brothers. 子路问怎样算士，孔子说，恳切劝勉而又和悦，就可以算士；朋友之间要恳切劝勉，兄弟之间要和悦相处。 云子路問云云者，問為士之行和悅切磋之道也。 互相批评，和睦共处，可以叫做‘士’了。 如何可算为士了？

t: When a good man has taught the people for seven years, they too…
y: 子曰：善人教民七年，亦可以即戎矣。
x: The Master said: When a good man has taught the people for seven years, they too can be sent to war. 孔子说，善人教导百姓七年，也可以让他们从军作战了。 云子曰善人，賢人也。 善人教导人民达七年之久，也能够叫他们作战了。 善人在位，教民七年之久，也可使他们上战场了。

t: To send untrained people to war is to throw them away
y: 子曰：以不教民战，是谓弃之。
x: The Master said: To send untrained people to war is to throw them away. 孔子说，用没有经过教导的百姓去作战，就是抛弃他们。 民命可重，故孔子愼戰，所以教至七年，猶曰亦可。 用未经受过训练的人民去作战，这等于糟踏生命。 用不经教练的民众去临战阵，只好说是抛弃了他们。

t: Xian asked about shame. The Master said: When the state has the…
y: 宪问耻。子曰：邦有道，谷；邦无道，谷，耻也。
x: Xian asked about shame. The Master said: When the state has the Way, to draw a salary; when the state lacks the Way, to draw a salary — that is shameful. 原宪问什么可耻，孔子说，国家有道、无道，都只知道领俸禄而不尽该尽的道，就是可耻。 云憲問恥者，弟子原憲問孔子可恥事也。 国家政治清明，做官领薪俸；国家政治黑暗，做官领薪俸，… 原宪问什么是可耻的？

t: If one does not give way to domineering, boasting, resentment…
y: 克、伐、怨、欲不行焉，可以为仁矣？子曰：可以为难矣，仁则吾不知也。
x: If one does not give way to domineering, boasting, resentment, or greed, can he be called humane? The Master said: He may be called hard to find; whether he is humane, I do not know. 原宪问，好胜、自夸、怨恨、贪欲都控制住，不表现出来，可以算仁了吗；孔子说，可以算难能，至于仁，我还不敢说。 云克伐怨欲者，克，勝也。 好胜，自夸，怨恨，与贪欲，这四者都能制之使不行，可算得仁吗？

t: A scholar who cherishes his comfort is not worthy to be called…
y: 子曰：士而怀居，不足以为士矣。
x: The Master said: A scholar who cherishes his comfort is not worthy to be called a scholar. 孔子说，士若只想安居享受，就不足以算士。 懷居猶居求安也。 一个士，若系恋于他家室乡里之安，那就够不上一士了。

t: When the state has the Way, be lofty in speech and lofty in…
y: 子曰：邦有道，危言危行；邦无道，危行言孙。
x: The Master said: When the state has the Way, be lofty in speech and lofty in action; when the state lacks the Way, be lofty in action but modest in speech. 孔子说，国家有道，言语、行为都要正直严肃；国家无道，行为仍正直，言语则谦顺些。 云子曰云云者，危，厲也。 国家有道，便正言正行。

t: Those with virtue are sure to have words worth hearing
y: 子曰：有德者必有言，有言者不必有德；仁者必有勇，勇者不必有仁。
x: The Master said: Those with virtue are sure to have words worth hearing; those with words are not necessarily virtuous. The humane are sure to have courage; the courageous are not necessarily humane. 孔子说，有德的人必有值得听的言语，能说话的人却未必有德；仁者必有勇气，勇敢的人却未必仁。 云子曰云云者，既有德則其言語多及中，故必有言也。 一个有德的人，必然能有好言语。

t: Nangong Kuo asked Confucius: Yi was a fine archer and Ao could…
y: 南宫适问于孔子曰：羿善射，奡荡舟，俱不得其死然；禹稷躬稼，而有天下。夫子不答，南宫适出。子曰：君子哉若人！尚德哉若人！
x: Nangong Kuo asked Confucius: Yi was a fine archer and Ao could push a boat over land, yet neither died a natural death. Yu and Ji labored at farming themselves, yet came to possess the realm. The Master did not answer. When Nangong Kuo had gone out, the Master said: What a gentleman that man is! How he esteems virtue! 南宫适说，羿善射、奡力能推舟，却都不得善终，禹、稷亲自种庄稼，自己或后代却有了天下；孔子当时不答，等他出去后说，这个人真是君子，真尊重德行。 云南宮适者，姓南宮，名适，字敬叔。 羿善射，奡能荡覆敌国的战船，但都不得好死。

t: There may be gentlemen who are not humane, but there has never…
y: 子曰：君子而不仁者有矣夫，未有小人而仁者也。
x: The Master said: There may be gentlemen who are not humane, but there has never been a petty man who is humane. 孔子说，君子有时也会有不仁的过失，却没有成为仁者的小人。 云子曰云云者，此謂賢人以下。 君子或许有时也会不仁，这是有的吧！

t: Can you love someone without making him work hard?
y: 子曰：爱之，能勿劳乎？忠焉，能勿诲乎？
x: The Master said: Can you love someone without making him work hard? Can you be loyal to someone without instructing him? 孔子说，爱一个人，能不让他勤劳吗；对一个人尽忠，能不教诲他吗？ 云愛之能勿勞乎者，愛慕此人學問之心，有所愛必欲勞來之。 爱他，能勿教他勤劳吗？

t: In drafting state documents, Pi Chen made the first draft…
y: 子曰：为命：裨谌草创之，世叔讨论之，行人子羽修饰之，东里子产润色之。
x: The Master said: In drafting state documents, Pi Chen made the first draft, Shishu examined and discussed it, the envoy Ziyu revised and polished it, and Zichan of Dongli gave it its final luster. 孔子说，郑国拟定外交辞令，由裨谌起草，世叔讨论，行人子羽修饰，东里子产润色。 云為命者，為作盟會之詔書也。 郑国造一辞命，先由裨谌起草稿，再经世叔讨论内容，…

t: Someone asked about Zichan
y: 或问子产。子曰：惠人也。问子西。曰：彼哉！彼哉！问管仲。曰：人也。夺伯氏骈邑三百，饭疏食，没齿无怨言。
x: Someone asked about Zichan. The Master said: A kind man. He asked about Zixi. The Master said: That man! That man! He asked about Guan Zhong. The Master said: He was a man indeed. He took the three hundred households of Pian from the Bo family, and Bo, living on coarse food, never uttered a word of resentment to the end of his days. 有人问子产，孔子说，他是惠爱人的人，问子西，孔子说，那个人啊，那个人啊。问管仲，孔子说，他夺去伯氏骈邑三百户，伯氏只能吃粗饭，却终身没有怨言。 云或問子產者，或人問於孔子，鄭之子產德行於民何如也。 有人问子产，其人怎样呀？

t: To be poor without resentment is hard
y: 子曰：贫而无怨难，富而无骄易。
x: The Master said: To be poor without resentment is hard; to be rich without arrogance is easy. 孔子说，贫穷而没有怨恨难，富有而不骄傲容易些。 云貧而無怨難者，貧賤因於飢寒，所以有怨。 在贫困中能无怨，是难的。

t: Meng Gongchuo would be more than fit to be chief retainer of…
y: 子曰：孟公绰为赵魏老则优，不可以为滕薛大夫。
x: The Master said: Meng Gongchuo would be more than fit to be chief retainer of the Zhao or Wei families, but he could not be a minister of Teng or Xue. 孔子说，孟公绰做赵氏、魏氏的家臣长还有余力，却不能做滕国、薛国主持国政的大夫。 明人生性分各有所能。 孟公绰要他做赵、魏的家臣是有余的，…

t: Zilu asked about the complete man
y: 子路问成人。子曰：若臧武仲之知，公绰之不欲，卞庄子之勇，冉求之艺，文之以礼乐，亦可以为成人矣。曰：今之成人者何必然？见利思义，见危授命，久要不忘平生之言，亦可以为成人矣。
x: Zilu asked about the complete man. The Master said: One with the wisdom of Zang Wuzhong, the freedom from desire of Gongchuo, the courage of Bian Zhuangzi, and the skill of Ran Qiu, refined by ritual and music, may be called a complete man. He added: But why must the complete man of today be so? One who, seeing profit, thinks of what is right; seeing danger, offers his life; and does not forget a long-standing promise however long ago he made it — he too may be called a complete man. 子路问怎样算完备的人，孔子说，有臧武仲的智慧、公绰的少欲、卞庄子的勇气、冉求的才艺，再用礼乐修饰，也就可以算了。孔子又说，如今所说的完人何必全都如此，见利益想到义，遇危难肯献身，旧日约定不忘，也可以算了。 云子路問成人者，問人何所行德可為成人者。 如何才可算一成人了？

t: The Master asked Gongming Jia about Gongshu Wenzi: Is it true…
y: 子问公叔文子于公明贾曰：信乎，夫子不言、不笑、不取乎？公明贾对曰：以告者过也。夫子时然后言，人不厌其言；乐然后笑，人不厌其笑；义然后取，人不厌其取。子曰：其然，岂其然乎？
x: The Master asked Gongming Jia about Gongshu Wenzi: Is it true that your master does not speak, does not laugh, and does not take? Gongming Jia replied: Those who told you exaggerated. My master speaks only when it is time, so people do not tire of his speaking; he laughs only when he is happy, so people do not tire of his laughing; he takes only when it is right, so people do not tire of his taking. The Master said: Is that so? Can it really be so? 孔子问公明贾，公叔文子果真不说话、不笑、不取财吗，公明贾说，传话的人说过了，他该说才说、心乐才笑、合义才取，所以人不厌烦；孔子说，真是这样吗，难道真能这样吗？ 云子問云云者，孔子見公明賈，相訪而問公叔文子之事。 真的吗？

t: Zang Wuzhong held on to Fang and demanded that an heir be…
y: 子曰：臧武仲以防求为后于鲁，虽曰不要君，吾不信也。
x: The Master said: Zang Wuzhong held on to Fang and demanded that an heir be appointed for him in Lu. Though he says he was not coercing his ruler, I do not believe it. 孔子说，臧武仲据着防邑，请求鲁国为臧氏立后，即使说自己不是要挟国君，我也不信。 云子曰云云者，姓，臧，名，紇，武，諡也。 臧武仲拿他的防邑来请立后于鲁，虽说不是要挟其君，我不敢信。

t: Duke Wen of Jin was crafty and not upright
y: 子曰：晋文公谲而不正，齐桓公正而不谲。
x: The Master said: Duke Wen of Jin was crafty and not upright; Duke Huan of Qi was upright and not crafty. 孔子说，晋文公行事诡谲而不正，齐桓公行事正当而不诡谲。 云子曰云云者，晉文公，子重耳也。 晋文公谲诡，不仗正义。

t: Duke Huan had Prince Jiu killed
y: 子路曰：桓公杀公子纠，召忽死之，管仲不死。曰：未仁乎？子曰：桓公九合诸侯，不以兵车，管仲之力也。如其仁！如其仁！
x: Zilu said: Duke Huan had Prince Jiu killed. Shao Hu died with him, but Guan Zhong did not. Was he not lacking in humaneness? The Master said: Duke Huan gathered the lords together nine times without using war chariots — that was Guan Zhong's doing. Such was his humaneness! Such was his humaneness! 子路说，桓公杀公子纠，召忽为他而死，管仲却不死，这算不上仁吧；孔子说，桓公召集诸侯，不靠武力，这是管仲的力量，谁能比得上他的仁德，谁能比得上呢！ 云子路曰云云者，桓公是齊桓公，名小白也。 齐桓公杀公子纠，召忽为公子纠死了，管仲不死，如此，…

t: Was Guan Zhong not inhumane?
y: 子贡曰：管仲非仁者与？桓公杀公子纠，不能死，又相之。子曰：管仲相桓公，霸诸侯，一匡天下，民到于今受其赐。微管仲，吾其被发左衽矣。岂若匹夫匹妇之为谅也，自经于沟渎而莫之知也。
x: Zigong said: Was Guan Zhong not inhumane? When Duke Huan killed Prince Jiu, he could not die for him, and even became Huan's minister. The Master said: Guan Zhong served as Duke Huan's minister, made him leader of the lords, and set the whole realm in order; to this day the people enjoy his gifts. But for Guan Zhong, we would be wearing our hair loose and folding our robes to the left. Would he be like a common man or woman keeping petty faith, hanging himself in a ditch with no one knowing? 子贡怀疑管仲不为公子纠死、又辅佐桓公不仁，孔子说，管仲辅佐桓公称霸诸侯，使天下归正，百姓到今天还受他的恩惠；没有管仲，我们恐怕已披发左衽了。哪里能像普通男女只守小信，自缢在沟渠里而没有人知道。 云子貢曰云云者，此亦是為子糾故，並舉管仲非仁之迹言也。 管仲不好算是一仁者吧！

t: Zhuan, a household officer of Gongshu Wenzi, rose together with…
y: 公叔文子之臣大夫僎，与文子同升诸公。子闻之曰：可以为文矣。
x: Zhuan, a household officer of Gongshu Wenzi, rose together with Wenzi to the ducal court. When the Master heard of it, he said: He deserves to be called Wen. 公叔文子把家臣大夫僎荐举到公朝，使他和自己同列；孔子听说后说，这就可以称为文了。 云公叔文子之臣大夫僎者，僎，卽前孔子所問公明賈之文子有臣名僎，亦為大夫也。 这人真可以文为谥了。

t: The Master spoke of Duke Ling of Wei's lack of the Way
y: 子言卫灵公之无道也，康子曰：夫如是，奚而不丧？孔子曰：仲叔圉治宾客，祝𬶍治宗庙，王孙贾治军旅。夫如是，奚其丧？
x: The Master spoke of Duke Ling of Wei's lack of the Way. Ji Kangzi said: If he is like that, why has he not lost his state? Confucius said: Zhongshu Yu handles foreign guests, Priest Tuo handles the ancestral temple, and Wangsun Jia handles the army. With such men, how would he lose it? 孔子说卫灵公无道，季康子问，那他为什么不失位，孔子说，仲叔圉主持宾客，祝鮀主持宗庙，王孙贾主持军旅，有这样的人任事，怎么会失位呢？ 云子曰云云者，孔子歎衞君無道行，意致其亡國乎。 先生述说卫灵公之无道。

t: One who speaks without shame will find it hard to carry out his…
y: 子曰：其言之不怍，则为之也难。
x: The Master said: One who speaks without shame will find it hard to carry out his words. 孔子说，大话说得毫不惭愧，真正做起来就难了。 積其實者，為之難也。 他说来不怍惭，那就做来困难了。

t: Chen Chengzi murdered Duke Jian
y: 陈成子弑简公。孔子沐浴而朝，告于哀公曰：陈恒弑其君，请讨之。公曰：告夫三子！孔子曰：以吾从大夫之后，不敢不告也。君曰告夫三子者。之三子告，不可。孔子曰：以吾从大夫之后，不敢不告也。
x: Chen Chengzi murdered Duke Jian. Confucius bathed and went to court, and reported to Duke Ai: Chen Heng has murdered his ruler. I request that he be punished. The Duke said: Tell the three lords. Confucius said: Because I follow behind the ministers, I dared not fail to report. And the ruler says, 'Tell the three lords.' He went to the three lords and told them; they refused. Confucius said: Because I follow behind the ministers, I dared not fail to report. 陈成子杀了齐简公，孔子沐浴后朝见鲁哀公，请讨陈恒，哀公却让他去告诉三桓；孔子去告而三家不许。孔子前后都说，我曾列于大夫之后，不敢不告。 云陳成子殺簡公者，陳成子，陳恒也。 陈恒弑了他的君，请快发兵去讨伐他。

t: Zilu asked about serving a ruler
y: 子路问事君。子曰：勿欺也，而犯之。
x: Zilu asked about serving a ruler. The Master said: Do not deceive him, but stand up to him. 子路问怎样事君，孔子说，不要欺骗他，但要敢当面劝谏。 云子路問事君者，問孔子求事君之法。 子路问事君之道。

t: The gentleman reaches upward
y: 子曰：君子上达，小人下达。
x: The Master said: The gentleman reaches upward; the petty man reaches downward. 孔子说，君子向高明处进，小人向卑下处进。 云子曰云云者，識其履道而行之也。 君子日日长进向上，小人日日沉沦向下。

t: In ancient times, people learned for their own sake
y: 子曰：古之学者为己，今之学者为人。
x: The Master said: In ancient times, people learned for their own sake; nowadays, people learn for the sake of others. 孔子说，古人学习为了使自己真正有所得，如今的人学习却为了让别人知道自己。 明今古有異也。 古之学者，是为己而学的。

t: Qu Boyu sent a messenger to Confucius
y: 蘧伯玉使人于孔子。孔子与之坐而问焉，曰：夫子何为？对曰：夫子欲寡其过而未能也。使者出。子曰：使乎！使乎！
x: Qu Boyu sent a messenger to Confucius. Confucius sat with him and asked: What is your master doing? He replied: My master wishes to reduce his faults but has not yet managed it. When the messenger had left, the Master said: What a messenger! What a messenger! 蘧伯玉派人问候孔子，孔子让使者坐下，问他主人做什么，使者说，主人想减少自己的过失，还没做到；使者出去后，孔子连声称赞，这真是使者，这真是使者。 云蘧伯玉使人於孔子者，使人往孔子處。 近来先生做些什么呀！

t: When not in the office, do not plan its affairs
y: 子曰：不在其位，不谋其政。
x: The Master said: When not in the office, do not plan its affairs. 孔子说，不居于那个职位，就不谋划那个职位的政事。 云子曰云云者，各專己職，不得濫謀圖他人之事。

t: The gentleman does not let his thoughts go beyond his position
y: 曾子曰：君子思不出其位。
