x: Zengzi said: The gentleman does not let his thoughts go beyond his position. 曾子说，君子思虑不越出自己的职分。 云曾子曰云云者，君子思慮當己分內，不得出己之外，而思他人事也。 君子用思，不越出他自己当前的职位。

t: The gentleman is ashamed to let his words outrun his deeds
y: 子曰：君子耻其言而过其行。
x: The Master said: The gentleman is ashamed to let his words outrun his deeds. 孔子说，君子说话不敢说尽，做事却希望超过所说的。 君子之人，顧言愼行。 君子以他的说话过了他的行为为可耻。

t: The way of the gentleman has three parts, and I have achieved…
y: 子曰：君子道者三，我无能焉：仁者不忧，知者不惑，勇者不惧。子贡曰：夫子自道也。
x: The Master said: The way of the gentleman has three parts, and I have achieved none of them: the humane do not worry, the wise are not perplexed, the brave do not fear. Zigong said: That is the Master describing himself. 孔子说，君子的道有三项，我还没能做到，仁者不忧，智者不惑，勇者不惧；子贡说，这是老师谦逊地说自己啊。 云子曰云云者，言君子所行之道有三，夫子自謙我不能行其一也。 君子之道有三：仁者不忧，知者不惑，勇者不惧。

t: Zigong was comparing people
y: 子贡方人。子曰：赐也贤乎哉？夫我则不暇。
x: Zigong was comparing people. The Master said: Ci must be very worthy! As for me, I have no time for that. 子贡比较人物的长短，孔子说，端木赐已经很贤了吗，我却没有这样闲暇。 云子貢方人者，比方人也。 子贡批评人物。

t: Do not worry that others do not know you
y: 子曰：不患人之不己知，患其不能也。
x: The Master said: Do not worry that others do not know you; worry that you lack ability. 孔子说，不必忧虑别人不了解自己，应忧虑自己没有本领。 言不患人之不知我之有才能也，正患無才能耳。 不要愁别人不知我，只愁我自己的不能。

t: Not anticipating deceit, not presuming bad faith, yet being the…
y: 子曰：不逆诈，不亿不信。抑亦先觉者，是贤乎！
x: The Master said: Not anticipating deceit, not presuming bad faith, yet being the first to perceive it — that is worthy indeed! 孔子说，不预先猜别人欺诈，也不凭空料想别人怀疑自己，却能及早察觉实情，这样才贤啊。 云不逆詐者，逆者，迎也。 不在事前逆测人诈我，不在事前揣想人对我有不信，…

t: Qiu, why are you always so busily on the move?
y: 微生亩谓孔子曰：丘，何为是栖栖者与？无乃为佞乎？孔子曰：非敢为佞也，疾固也。
x: Weisheng Mu said to Confucius: Qiu, why are you always so busily on the move? Are you not just a smooth talker? Confucius said: I would not dare be a smooth talker. It is stubbornness I dislike. 微生亩问孔子，孔丘，你为什么这样奔忙不安，莫非要靠口才取悦人；孔子说，不敢以口才取悦人，只是厌恶固执不通。 云微生畝云云者，微生，姓也，畝，名也。 丘呀！

t: A fine steed is praised not for its strength but for its…
y: 子曰：骥不称其力，称其德也。
x: The Master said: A fine steed is praised not for its strength but for its character. 孔子说，千里马受称赞，不只因它有力气，而因它性情驯良。 稱德重力也。 称为骥马的，并不是称它之力，乃是称它之德呀。

t: What about repaying injury with kindness?
y: 或曰：以德报怨，何如？子曰：何以报德？以直报怨，以德报德。
x: Someone said: What about repaying injury with kindness? The Master said: Then with what would you repay kindness? Repay injury with uprightness, and repay kindness with kindness. 有人问，用恩惠回报怨恨怎样，孔子说，那拿什么回报恩惠；应以公正回报怨恨，用恩惠回报恩惠。 云或曰者，或人問孔子曰，彼與世有怨，而此人欲行德以報彼怨，其事理何如也。 以德报怨，如何呀？

t: No one knows me! Zigong said: Why does no one know you?
y: 子曰：莫我知也夫！子贡曰：何为其莫知子也？子曰：不怨天，不尤人。下学而上达。知我者其天乎！
x: The Master said: No one knows me! Zigong said: Why does no one know you? The Master said: I do not resent Heaven, nor blame others. I learn from below and reach up above. The one who knows me — is it Heaven? 孔子叹没有人了解自己，子贡问为什么这样说；孔子说，我不怨天，不责人，从平常人事学起而上达天理，了解我的，大概只有天吧。 莫，無也。 没有人能知道得我了吧！

t: Gongbo Liao slandered Zilu to Jisun
y: 公伯寮愬子路于季孙。子服景伯以告，曰：夫子固有惑志于公伯寮，吾力犹能肆诸市朝。子曰：道之将行也与？命也。道之将废也与？命也。公伯寮其如命何！
x: Gongbo Liao slandered Zilu to Jisun. Zifu Jingbo reported it, saying: My master has certainly been misled by Gongbo Liao, but I still have the power to have his corpse displayed in the marketplace. The Master said: If the Way is to prevail, it is fate. If the Way is to be cast aside, it is fate. What can Gongbo Liao do against fate? 公伯寮在季孙面前谗毁子路，子服景伯告诉孔子，季孙已受公伯寮的话迷惑，我还有力量杀他、陈尸示众；孔子说，道要推行或被废弃，都有命，公伯寮能把命怎么样？ 云公伯寮云云者，公伯寮季氏，令信讒子路也。 季孙听了公伯寮谗诉，已对子路有疑惑。

t: The worthy withdraw from the world
y: 子曰：贤者辟世，其次辟地，其次辟色，其次辟言。
x: The Master said: The worthy withdraw from the world; the next withdraw from a place; the next withdraw at a look; the next withdraw at a word. 孔子说，贤者有避开乱世隐居的，其次是离乱国往治国，再其次是见君上变了脸色便离开，再其次是听到不合的话才离开。 云子曰賢者避世者，聖賢者去就順時，若天地閉塞，則賢人使隱高蹈塵外也。 贤者避去此世。

t: Seven men have done so
y: 子曰：作者七人矣。
x: The Master said: Seven men have done so. 孔子说，起身退隐的，已有七个人了。 言此謂避世，已下自古已來作者唯七人而已矣。 起而避去的，已有七人了。

t: Zilu spent the night at Stone Gate
y: 子路宿于石门。晨门曰：奚自？子路曰：自孔氏。曰：是知其不可而为之者与？
x: Zilu spent the night at Stone Gate. The gatekeeper said: Where are you from? Zilu said: From the house of Kong. He said: Is that the one who knows it cannot be done and still does it? 子路在石门过夜，守门人问他从哪里来，他说从孔氏来；守门人说，就是那个知道做不成还坚持去做的人吗？ 云子路宿於石門者，名門，地名也。 你由何方来？

t: The Master was playing the stone chimes in Wei
y: 子击磬于卫。有荷蒉而过孔氏之门者，曰：有心哉！击磬乎！既而曰：鄙哉！硁硁乎！莫己知也，斯已而已矣。深则厉，浅则揭。子曰：果哉！末之难矣。
x: The Master was playing the stone chimes in Wei. A man carrying a basket passed the gate of the Kong household and said: There is a heart in this playing of the chimes! After a while he said: How petty, this clanging! If no one knows you, then just stop. 'When the water is deep, wade in your clothes; when it is shallow, lift your hem.' The Master said: How decisive! There is nothing hard about that. 孔子在卫国击磬，一个挑草筐的人经过，说这磬声真有心事，随后又说，太固执了，没人了解就算了，水深连衣涉过，水浅提衣走过；孔子说，真能果断地离开世事，这样便没有什么难处了。 云子擊磬於衞者，孔子難時在衞而自以槌擊磬而為聲也。 先生在卫国，一日正击磬。

t: The Documents say, 'Gaozong, in the mourning hut, did not speak…
y: 子张曰：书云：高宗谅阴，三年不言。何谓也？子曰：何必高宗，古之人皆然。君薨，百官总己以听于冢宰三年。
x: Zizhang said: The Documents say, 'Gaozong, in the mourning hut, did not speak for three years.' What does this mean? The Master said: Why only Gaozong? The ancients were all so. When the ruler died, all the officials attended to their duties and took orders from the chief minister for three years. 子张问，书上说高宗居丧三年不言，是什么意思，孔子说，何止高宗，古人都这样，国君死后，百官各守自己的职务，听命于冢宰三年。 云子張曰云云者，高宗，殷中興王也，名武丁。 （尚书）上说：‘高宗谅阴，三年不言。

t: When those above love ritual, the people are easy to employ
y: 子曰：上好礼，则民易使也。
x: The Master said: When those above love ritual, the people are easy to employ. 孔子说，在上者喜好礼，百姓就容易役使。 則民莫敢不敬，故易使也。 在上位者能知好礼，在下民众就易于使命了。

t: Zilu asked about the gentleman
y: 子路问君子。子曰：修己以敬。曰：如斯而已乎？曰：修己以安人。曰：如斯而已乎？曰：修己以安百姓。修己以安百姓，尧舜其犹病诸！
x: Zilu asked about the gentleman. The Master said: He cultivates himself with reverence. Is that all? He cultivates himself to bring peace to others. Is that all? He cultivates himself to bring peace to all the people. Cultivating oneself to bring peace to all the people — even Yao and Shun found this hard! 子路问君子，孔子说，以敬慎修养自己，子路问仅此而已吗，孔子说，修养自己而使别人安定；子路再问，孔子说，修养自己而使所有百姓安定，做到这一层，尧舜尚且担心不足。 云子路問君子者，問為君子之法也。 子路问：在上位的君子，该如何始得呀？

t: Yuan Rang sat squatting, waiting
y: 原壤夷俟。子曰：幼而不孙弟，长而无述焉，老而不死，是为贼！以杖叩其胫。
x: Yuan Rang sat squatting, waiting. The Master said: Young, you were not humble or respectful to elders; grown, you accomplished nothing worth mentioning; old, you do not die — you are a pest! And he tapped him on the shin with his staff. 原壤蹲踞着等孔子，孔子说，小时不谦逊敬长，长大没什么可称道，老而不死，真是害人；便用手杖轻敲他的小腿。 云原壤夷俟者，原壤者，方外之聖人，孔子之朋友，夷，踞也，俟，待也。 原壤蹲着两脚不坐不起，以待孔子之来。

t: A boy from Que village was carrying messages
y: 阙党童子将命。或问之曰：益者与？子曰：吾见其居于位也，见其与先生并行也。非求益者也，欲速成者也。
x: A boy from Que village was carrying messages. Someone asked about him: Is he making progress? The Master said: I see him sitting in the seat of an adult and walking side by side with his elders. He is not seeking progress; he wants to grow up fast. 阙党的童子传达宾主的话，有人问他是否很有长进；孔子说，我见他占着成人的座位，又与长者并行，他不是循序求进，而是急着装成大人。 云闕黨童子將命者，五百家為黨，此黨名闕，故云闕黨也。 阙党有一童子，为宾主传命。

t: Duke Ling of Wei asked Confucius about military formations
y: 卫灵公问陈于孔子。孔子对曰：俎豆之事，则尝闻之矣；军旅之事，未之学也。明日遂行。在陈绝粮，从者病，莫能兴。子路愠见曰：君子亦有穷乎？子曰：君子固穷，小人穷斯滥矣。
x: Duke Ling of Wei asked Confucius about military formations. Confucius replied: Matters of sacrificial vessels I have heard about; military matters I have never studied. The next day he left. In Chen, their provisions ran out; his followers fell ill and could not rise. Zilu came to him, indignant: Does the gentleman, too, end up in straits? The Master said: The gentleman holds firm in straits; the petty man in straits loses all restraint. 卫灵公问军阵，孔子说，祭礼的事我听过，军旅的事没学过，第二天便离开；在陈国断粮，随从饥病得起不来，子路愠怒地问，君子也会穷困吗？孔子说，君子困穷仍能固守，小人困穷便胡作非为了。 云衞靈公云云者，靈公不慕勝業，唯知問於軍陣之事。 卫灵公向孔子问军队陈列之法。 卫灵公问孔子兵阵之事。

t: Ci, do you think I am someone who has learned a great deal and…
y: 子曰：赐也，女以予为多学而识之者与？对曰：然，非与？曰：非也，予一以贯之。
x: The Master said: Ci, do you think I am someone who has learned a great deal and remembers it all? He replied: Yes. Is it not so? The Master said: No. I have one thread running through it all. 孔子问子贡，你以为我是学得多、记得多的人吗，子贡说，是，难道不是吗；孔子说，不是，我以一个根本道理贯通它们。 時人見孔子多識，並謂孔子多學世事而識之，故孔子問子貢而釋之也。 赐呀！

t: You, those who understand virtue are few
y: 子曰：由！知德者鲜矣。
x: The Master said: You, those who understand virtue are few. 孔子说，仲由，真正懂得德的人很少啊。 由，子路也，呼子路而告之。 由呀！

t: One who governed by doing nothing — was that not Shun?
y: 子曰：无为而治者，其舜也与？夫何为哉？恭己正南面而已矣。
x: The Master said: One who governed by doing nothing — was that not Shun? What did he do? He made himself reverent and sat facing south, that was all. 孔子说，不亲自多所作为而能天下治的，大概是舜吧；他做了什么呢，不过是端正恭敬自身，坐在南面的君位上罢了。 云子曰云云者，舜上受堯禪於己，己又下禪於禹，受授得人，故孔子歎舜無為而能治也。 能无为而治的，该是舜了吧！

t: Zizhang asked how to get along
y: 子张问行。子曰：言忠信，行笃敬，虽蛮貊之邦行矣；言不忠信，行不笃敬，虽州里行乎哉？立，则见其参于前也；在舆，则见其倚于衡也。夫然后行。子张书诸绅。
x: Zizhang asked how to get along. The Master said: Let your words be loyal and true and your conduct sincere and reverent, and you will get along even among the barbarian states. If your words are not loyal and true and your conduct not sincere and reverent, will you get along even in your own neighborhood? Standing, see these before you; in your carriage, see them leaning on the crossbar. Then you will get along. Zizhang wrote this on his sash. 子张问怎样让所行通达，孔子说，说话忠信、行为笃敬，即使到蛮貊之国也行，反过来即使乡里也行不通；站立时像看见忠信笃敬在面前，坐车时像看见它倚着车前横木，这样才行。子张把这些话写在腰间的大带上。 云子張問行者，問人立身居世修善若為事而其道事可得行於世乎。 如何始可向外行得通？

t: How upright Shi Yu is! When the state has the Way, he is like…
y: 子曰：直哉史鱼！邦有道，如矢；邦无道，如矢。君子哉蘧伯玉！邦有道，则仕；邦无道，则可卷而怀之。
x: The Master said: How upright Shi Yu is! When the state has the Way, he is like an arrow; when the state lacks the Way, he is like an arrow. What a gentleman Qu Boyu is! When the state has the Way, he serves; when the state lacks the Way, he can roll himself up and put himself away. 孔子说，史鱼真直啊，国家有道无道，都像箭一样直；蘧伯玉真是君子，国家有道就出仕，无道就可以收起本领，藏在怀里。 史魚之行正直也。 史鱼可算得直了。

t: Not to speak with someone you should speak with is to lose a…
y: 子曰：可与言而不与之言，失人；不可与言而与之言，失言。知者不失人，亦不失言。
x: The Master said: Not to speak with someone you should speak with is to lose a person; to speak with someone you should not speak with is to waste words. The wise lose neither people nor words. 孔子说，该与他说话却不说，便错过了人，不该与他说话却说了，便说失了话；有智慧的人既不失人，也不失言。 云子曰云云者，謂此人可與之言，則與之言。 可和他言，而我不言，则失了人。

t: A resolute scholar and a humane man will not seek to live at…
y: 子曰：志士仁人，无求生以害仁，有杀身以成仁。
x: The Master said: A resolute scholar and a humane man will not seek to live at the expense of humaneness; they will give their lives to achieve humaneness. 孔子说，有志之士、有仁之人，不会为了活命而损害仁，必要时会牺牲生命来成全仁。 云志士仁人者，謂心有善志之士及能行仁之人也。 一个志士仁人，没有为求生命安全而宁愿妨害仁道的，…

t: Zigong asked about practicing humaneness
y: 子贡问为仁。子曰：工欲善其事，必先利其器。居是邦也，事其大夫之贤者，友其士之仁者。
x: Zigong asked about practicing humaneness. The Master said: A craftsman who wants to do his work well must first sharpen his tools. Living in a state, serve the worthiest of its ministers and befriend the most humane of its scholars. 子贡问怎样实行仁，孔子说，工匠要做好工作，先得磨利工具；住在一个国家，要敬事其中贤能的大夫，结交其中有仁德的士。 子貢問為仁之術，故先以工人為譬也。 子贡问为仁之方。

t: Yan Yuan asked about governing a state
y: 颜渊问为邦。子曰：行夏之时，乘殷之辂，服周之冕，乐则韶舞。放郑声，远佞人。郑声淫，佞人殆。
x: Yan Yuan asked about governing a state. The Master said: Use the calendar of Xia, ride the carriage of Yin, wear the cap of Zhou; for music, the Shao and its dances. Banish the tunes of Zheng and keep away glib talkers. The tunes of Zheng are licentious; glib talkers are dangerous. 颜渊问怎样治理国家，孔子说，采用夏代的历法、殷代的车制、周代的礼帽，音乐用韶舞；弃掉郑声，远离佞人，因为郑声淫荡，佞人危险。 云顏淵問為邦者，為猶治也。 颜渊问为国之道。

t: One who does not think far ahead will surely have worries close…
y: 子曰：人无远虑，必有近忧。
x: The Master said: One who does not think far ahead will surely have worries close at hand. 孔子说，人若不作长远考虑，近处的忧患就必会来到。 人之生當思漸慮遠，防於未然，則憂患之事不得近至。 一个人若不能有久远之虑，则必然有朝夕之忧。

t: It is hopeless! I have never seen anyone who loves virtue as…
y: 子曰：已矣乎！吾未见好德如好色者也。
x: The Master said: It is hopeless! I have never seen anyone who loves virtue as much as he loves beauty. 孔子说，算了吧，我还没见过爱德像爱美色那样真切的人。 既先云己未見也。 罢了吧！

t: Was Zang Wenzhong not one who held his post like a thief?
y: 子曰：臧文仲其窃位者与？知柳下惠之贤，而不与立也。
x: The Master said: Was Zang Wenzhong not one who held his post like a thief? He knew Liuxia Hui was worthy, yet did not bring him to stand beside him at court. 孔子说，臧文仲大概是窃据职位的人吧，明知柳下惠贤能，却不让他在朝廷与自己同列。 云子曰云云者，臧文仲，魯大夫也。 臧文仲，好算是偷窃官位的吧！

t: Demand much of yourself and little of others, and you will keep…
y: 子曰：躬自厚而薄责于人，则远怨矣。
x: The Master said: Demand much of yourself and little of others, and you will keep resentment far away. 孔子说，严格责求自己，少责求别人，就能远离别人的怨恨。 躬，身也。 对自身督责严，对人督责轻，便可避远自心的怨望了。

t: With one who never asks, 'What should I do?
y: 子曰：不曰如之何如之何者，吾末如之何也已矣。
x: The Master said: With one who never asks, 'What should I do? What should I do?', I can do nothing at all. 孔子说，不肯反复想该怎么办的人，我也拿他没有办法。 云不曰如之何者，不曰猶不謂也。 从不说如之何如之何的人，吾亦就无如之何了。

t: Those who gather all day long, whose talk never touches on what…
y: 子曰：群居终日，言不及义，好行小慧，难矣哉！
x: The Master said: Those who gather all day long, whose talk never touches on what is right, and who love to show off petty cleverness — they are hard to deal with! 孔子说，聚在一起整天说话不谈义，却好耍小聪明，这样就难了。 云子曰云云者，三人以上為群居，群居共聚有所談說。 相聚群居，终日不散，言谈不及道义，专好逞使小聪明，…

t: The gentleman takes what is right as his substance, carries it…
y: 子曰：君子义以为质，礼以行之，孙以出之，信以成之。君子哉！
x: The Master said: The gentleman takes what is right as his substance, carries it out through ritual, expresses it with modesty, and completes it with good faith. That is a gentleman! 孔子说，以义作行事的根本，用礼实行，谦逊地表达，诚信地完成，真是君子啊。 義，宜也，質，本也。 君子把义来做他一切行事的本质，又把礼的节文来推行，…

t: The gentleman is troubled by his own lack of ability, not by…
y: 子曰：君子病无能焉，不病人之不己知也。
x: The Master said: The gentleman is troubled by his own lack of ability, not by others' failure to know him. 孔子说，君子担心自己没有本领，不担心别人不知道自己。 病猶患也。 君子只愁自己无能，不愁别人不知道自己。

t: The gentleman dreads leaving the world without his name being…
y: 子曰：君子疾没世而名不称焉。
x: The Master said: The gentleman dreads leaving the world without his name being spoken of. 孔子说，君子担心终身没有值得传述的名声。 沒世，謂身沒以後也。 一个君子，恨他身后声名之不传。

t: The gentleman seeks it in himself
y: 子曰：君子求诸己，小人求诸人。
x: The Master said: The gentleman seeks it in himself; the petty man seeks it in others. 孔子说，君子从自己身上寻求，小人却向别人求取。 君子自責己德行之不足，不責人也。 君子一切求之于己，小人一切求之于人。

t: The gentleman is dignified but does not contend
y: 子曰：君子矜而不争，群而不党。
x: The Master said: The gentleman is dignified but does not contend; he is sociable but not partisan. 孔子说，君子庄重自持而不争竞，与人和群而不结私党。 云子曰云云者，矜，矜莊也。 君子只是庄敬自守，但与人无所争。

t: The gentleman does not promote a man because of his words, nor…
y: 子曰：君子不以言举人，不以人废言。
x: The Master said: The gentleman does not promote a man because of his words, nor reject words because of the man. 孔子说，君子不因一个人说得好就举用他，也不因为一个人不好，就废弃他有道理的话。 云子曰云云者，舉人必須知其德行，不可聽言語而薦舉之。 一个君子，不专因一人的说话来举荐那一人，…

t: Is there one word that one can practice all one's life?
y: 子贡问曰：有一言而可以终身行之者乎？子曰：其恕乎！己所不欲，勿施于人。
x: Zigong asked: Is there one word that one can practice all one's life? The Master said: Is it not reciprocity? What you do not want for yourself, do not do to others. 子贡问，有一个字可以终身实行吗，孔子说，大概是恕吧，自己不愿承受的，不施加给别人。 云子貢問云云者，問求善事，欲以終身奉行之一言也。 有没有一个字可以终身行它的呢？

t: In my dealings with people, whom have I disparaged, whom have I…
y: 子曰：吾之于人也，谁毁谁誉？如有所誉者，其有所试矣。斯民也，三代之所以直道而行也。
x: The Master said: In my dealings with people, whom have I disparaged, whom have I praised? If there is someone I have praised, it is because he has been tested. These people are the same people by whom the Three Dynasties walked the straight Way. 孔子说，我对人，哪里有过分贬损或夸奖，若有所称赞，必是经过检验的；眼前这些百姓，也就是夏商周凭正道治理的百姓，我怎能歪曲他们的是非实情。 云子曰云云者，孔子言我之於世平等如一，無有憎愛毀譽之心。 我对人，哪个是我毁了，哪个是我誉了的呢？

t: I can still recall when scribes left blanks in their texts, and…
y: 子曰：吾犹及史之阙文也，有马者借人乘之。今亡矣夫！
x: The Master said: I can still recall when scribes left blanks in their texts, and when those with horses lent them to others to ride. Now that is gone! 孔子说，我还见过史官遇疑留下缺文、有马的人借给别人骑的做法，如今没有了啊。 澆流迅速，時異一時也。 我犹看到官文书上有空阙的字，又有有马的借人乘用，…

t: Clever words confuse virtue
y: 子曰：巧言乱德，小不忍则乱大谋。
x: The Master said: Clever words confuse virtue. Lack of patience in small things ruins great plans. 孔子说，花言巧语会搅乱德行，小处不能忍耐，就会搅乱大计划。 云巧言亂德者，辭達而已，不須巧辯，巧辯文多，更於德為亂之也。 巧言可以乱人之品德。

t: When everyone hates someone, you must look into it
y: 子曰：众恶之，必察焉；众好之，必察焉。
x: The Master said: When everyone hates someone, you must look into it; when everyone loves someone, you must look into it. 孔子说，众人都厌恶他，必须考察，众人都喜欢他，也必须考察。 云衆惡之必察焉者，設有一人為衆所憎惡者，必當察其德，不可從衆而同而惡之也。 人人都厌恶他，必得仔细审察。

t: It is people who can broaden the Way, not the Way that broadens…
y: 子曰：人能弘道，非道弘人。
x: The Master said: It is people who can broaden the Way, not the Way that broadens people. 孔子说，人能够使道光大，并不是道能自己使人光大。 道者，通物之妙也。 人能弘大道，道不能弘大人。

t: To err and not correct it — that is truly to err
y: 子曰：过而不改，是谓过矣。
x: The Master said: To err and not correct it — that is truly to err. 孔子说，有了过失却不改，这才叫过失。 人有過，皆能改，如日食及明也。 有了过失不改，这才真说得是过失了。

t: I once went all day without eating and all night without…
y: 子曰：吾尝终日不食，终夜不寝，以思，无益，不如学也。
x: The Master said: I once went all day without eating and all night without sleeping in order to think. It was of no use. It is better to learn. 孔子说，我曾整天不吃饭、整夜不睡觉，只顾思索，结果没有益处，不如学习。 勸人學也。 我曾竟天不吃，竟夜不睡，尽自思量，总是无益，…

t: The gentleman plans for the Way, not for food
y: 子曰：君子谋道不谋食。耕也，馁在其中矣；学也，禄在其中矣。君子忧道不忧贫。
x: The Master said: The gentleman plans for the Way, not for food. Farm, and hunger may still be there; learn, and a salary may come of it. The gentleman worries about the Way, not about poverty. 孔子说，君子谋求的是道，不是口粮，耕作仍可能挨饿，学习也可能得到俸禄；君子忧虑道不能立，不把贫穷当作首要忧虑。 謀猶圖也。 君子只计谋于道，不计谋于食。

t: If knowledge reaches it but humaneness cannot hold it, then…
y: 子曰：知及之，仁不能守之；虽得之，必失之。知及之，仁能守之，不庄以涖之，则民不敬。知及之，仁能守之，庄以涖之，动之不以礼，未善也。
x: The Master said: If knowledge reaches it but humaneness cannot hold it, then even if he gains it, he is sure to lose it. If knowledge reaches it and humaneness can hold it, but he does not govern with dignity, the people will not be reverent. If knowledge reaches it, humaneness can hold it, and he governs with dignity, but does not move the people by ritual, it is still not good. 孔子说，智慧懂得了，仁德却守不住，即使得到也必失去，智慧懂得、仁德守住，若不庄重临民，百姓也不会敬重；即使三者都有了，役使百姓不依礼，也还没有完善。 謂人有智識得及為官位者，故云智及之也。 一个在上位者，他的知足以知到此道了，若其心之仁不足以守，…

t: The gentleman cannot be known through small things, but can be…
y: 子曰：君子不可小知，而可大受也；小人不可大受，而可小知也。
x: The Master said: The gentleman cannot be known through small things, but can be entrusted with great ones; the petty man cannot be entrusted with great things, but can be known through small ones. 孔子说，君子不宜只凭一件小事评量，却可承担重任；小人不能承担重任，却可能有一项可取的本领。 君子之道深遠，不與凡人可知。 一个君子，不可从小处去赏识他，但他可接受大任务。

t: The people need humaneness more than water and fire
y: 子曰：民之于仁也，甚于水火。水火，吾见蹈而死者矣，未见蹈仁而死者也。
x: The Master said: The people need humaneness more than water and fire. I have seen people die stepping into water and fire, but never seen anyone die stepping into humaneness. 孔子说，百姓需要仁，比需要水火还紧要；我见过走进水火而死的人，没见过实行仁却因此自陷于死的人。 甚，猶勝也。 人生有赖于仁，尤甚其有赖于水火。

t: When it comes to humaneness, do not yield even to your teacher
y: 子曰：当仁不让于师。
x: The Master said: When it comes to humaneness, do not yield even to your teacher. 孔子说，担当行仁之事，即使在老师面前也不必退让。 當行仁之事，不復讓於師，行仁急也。 若遇行仁之事，在己即当率先向前，莫让给众人为之。

t: The gentleman is steadfast, but not rigidly bound by small…
y: 子曰：君子贞而不谅。
x: The Master said: The gentleman is steadfast, but not rigidly bound by small promises. 孔子说，君子守正坚定，却不拘守不问是非的小信。 君子之人正其道耳，言不必有信也。 君子只固守正道，不拘执小信。

t: In serving a ruler, be reverent in your duties and put your…
y: 子曰：事君，敬其事而后其食。
x: The Master said: In serving a ruler, be reverent in your duties and put your salary last. 孔子说，事奉国君，应先敬慎尽职，后考虑俸禄。 先盡力，然後食其食也。 事君之道，先当敬守职事，把食禄之心放在后。

t: In teaching, there are no classes of people
y: 子曰：有教无类。
x: The Master said: In teaching, there are no classes of people. 孔子说，经过教化，人都可以回到善，不应再以原来的善恶类别区别对待。 人有貴賤，同宜資教，不可以種類庶鄙而不教之也。 人只该有教化，不再分类别。

t: Those whose ways differ do not make plans together
y: 子曰：道不同，不相为谋。
x: The Master said: Those whose ways differ do not make plans together. 孔子说，所行之道不同，便不能相互谋划共事。 必須先謀，若道同者共謀為事，若道不同而與共謀，則事不成也。 各人道路不同，便无法互为谋虑了。

t: In words, it is enough that they get the meaning across
y: 子曰：辞达而已矣。
x: The Master said: In words, it is enough that they get the meaning across. 孔子说，言辞把意思表达清楚就够了。 言語之法，使辭達則足矣，不煩文艷之辭也。 奉命出使，他的辞令，只求能传达国家使命便够了。

t: Music Master Mian came to see the Master
y: 师冕见，及阶，子曰：阶也。及席，子曰：席也。皆坐，子告之曰：某在斯，某在斯。师冕出。子张问曰：与师言之道与？子曰：然。固相师之道也。
x: Music Master Mian came to see the Master. When he reached the steps, the Master said: Here are the steps. When he reached the mat, the Master said: Here is your mat. When all were seated, the Master told him: So-and-so is here; so-and-so is here. When Music Master Mian had left, Zizhang asked: Is that the way to speak with a music master? The Master said: Yes. That is indeed the way to assist a music master. 盲乐师冕来见孔子，到台阶、席边，孔子都分别告诉他，坐定后又一一告诉他谁坐在哪里；师冕出去后，子张问，这就是与乐师说话的道理吗，孔子说，是的，这本来就是帮助盲乐师的办法。 云師冕見者，師冕，魯之樂師也。 这是阶了。

t: The Ji family was about to attack Zhuanyu
y: 季氏将伐颛臾。冉有、季路见于孔子曰：季氏将有事于颛臾。孔子曰：求！无乃尔是过与？夫颛臾，昔者先王以为东蒙主，且在邦域之中矣，是社稷之臣也。何以伐为？冉有曰：夫子欲之，吾二臣者皆不欲也。孔子曰：求！周任有言曰：陈力就列，不能者止。危而不持，颠而不扶，则将焉用彼相矣？且尔言过矣。虎兕出于柙，龟玉毁于椟中，是谁之过与？冉有曰：今夫颛臾，固而近于费。今不取，后世必为子孙忧。孔子曰：求！君子疾夫舍曰欲之，而必为之辞。丘也闻有国有家者，不患寡而患不均，不患贫而患不安。盖均无贫，和无寡，安无倾。夫如是，故远人不服，则修文德以来之。既来之，则安之。今由与求也，相夫子，远人不服而不能来也；邦分崩离析而不能守也。而谋动干戈于邦内。吾恐季孙之忧，不在颛臾，而在萧墙之内也。
x: The Ji family was about to attack Zhuanyu. Ran You and Jilu came to see Confucius and said: The Ji family is about to take action against Zhuanyu. Confucius said: Qiu, is this not your fault? Zhuanyu was long ago made by the former kings the lord of the sacrifices to Mount Dongmeng; moreover, it lies within our borders and is a vassal of the state. Why attack it? Ran You said: Our master wants it; neither of us two ministers does. Confucius said: Qiu, Zhou Ren had a saying: 'Put forth your strength and take your place; if you cannot, step down.' If he is in danger and you do not hold him steady, if he stumbles and you do not support him, what use are you as his helper? And what you say is wrong. When a tiger or rhinoceros escapes from its cage, or tortoiseshell and jade are smashed in their case, whose fault is it? Ran You said: But Zhuanyu is well fortified and close to Bi. If it is not taken now, it will surely trouble his descendants in later generations. Confucius said: Qiu, the gentleman hates those who, instead of saying 'I want it,' insist on making excuses. I have heard that those who hold a state or a family do not worry about having few people but about unequal shares, do not worry about poverty but about unrest. For where there is equality there is no poverty, where there is harmony there is no shortage of people, where there is peace there is no toppling. That being so, if people far away do not submit, cultivate culture and virtue to attract them; once they have come, give them peace. Now you, You and Qiu, assist your master; people far away do not submit and you cannot attract them; the state is splitting apart and you cannot hold it together; and yet you plan to take up arms within the state. I fear that the Ji family's trouble lies not in Zhuanyu, but within their own walls. 季氏准备攻打颛臾，冉有和子路把这件事告诉孔子；孔子责问冉有，说颛臾本受先王之命主持东蒙山的祭祀，又在鲁国境内，是鲁国公室的臣属，何必攻打，冉有却说是季孙想打，他们两人并不赞成，孔子便引周任“能尽职便居位，不能便退下”的话，指出见人危险不扶持、跌倒不搀助，这样的助手无用，正如虎兕逃出笼子、龟甲玉器毁在匣中，守护者不能推卸过错。冉有又以颛臾城坚、离费邑近，恐后世成患为理由，孔子批评想要夺取却替它编借口，说治国治家应忧分配不均、人心不安，均平便不至贫困，和睦便不嫌人少，安定便不致倾覆，远方人不归服应修明文德招徕、来了便使其安居，而由与求如今辅佐季孙，既招不来远人、又保不住分裂的国家，反在国内发动战争，他担忧季孙真正的祸患在家内而不在颛臾。 此章明季氏專征濫伐之惡也。 季氏准备对颛臾使用兵力。 季氏将向颛臾用兵了。

t: When the realm has the Way, ritual, music, and punitive…
y: 孔子曰：天下有道，则礼乐征伐自天子出；天下无道，则礼乐征伐自诸侯出。自诸侯出，盖十世希不失矣；自大夫出，五世希不失矣；陪臣执国命，三世希不失矣。天下有道，则政不在大夫。天下有道，则庶人不议。
x: Confucius said: When the realm has the Way, ritual, music, and punitive expeditions come from the Son of Heaven; when the realm lacks the Way, they come from the lords. When they come from the lords, it is rare for power not to be lost within ten generations; when from the ministers, rare within five; when retainers of ministers hold the state's commands, rare within three. When the realm has the Way, government does not rest with the ministers. When the realm has the Way, the common people do not debate it. 孔子说，天下有道时，礼乐制度和征伐由天子决定，天下无道时便由诸侯决定，权出诸侯大约不到十代便会失去，权出大夫大约不到五代便会失去，家臣掌握国命大约不到三代便会失去。天下有道，政权不由大夫擅专，平民也没有可私议的失政。 云天下有道云云者，禮樂先王所以飾喜，誅戮先王所以飾怒，故有道世則禮樂征伐並由天子而出也。 天下太平，制礼作乐以及出兵都决定于天子；天下昏乱，… 天下有道之时，一切礼乐征伐都从天子那边出来。

t: It has been five generations since the revenues left the ducal…
y: 孔子曰：禄之去公室，五世矣；政逮于大夫，四世矣；故夫三桓之子孙，微矣。
x: Confucius said: It has been five generations since the revenues left the ducal house, and four since government passed to the ministers. That is why the descendants of the Three Huan are in decline. 孔子说，俸禄与政权离开鲁国公室已经五代，政权落到大夫手中已经四代，所以三桓的后人也已衰微。 孔子見其數將彌知季氏必出亡，故發斯言也。 国家政权离开了鲁君，〔从鲁君来说，〕已经五代了；… 爵禄之权自公家失去，已五世了。

t: There are three kinds of friends who help and three who harm
y: 孔子曰：益者三友，损者三友。友直，友谅，友多闻，益矣。友便辟，友善柔，友便佞，损矣。
x: Confucius said: There are three kinds of friends who help and three who harm. Friends who are upright, friends who are faithful, friends who know much — they help. Friends who are ingratiating, friends who are fawning, friends who are glib — they harm. 孔子说，有益的朋友有三种，有害的朋友也有三种，结交正直、诚信、见闻广博的人有益，结交只熟于仪表、善于逢迎、能说会道却无实学的人有害。 云益者三友者，明與朋友益者有三事，故云益者三友。 有益的朋友三种，有害的朋友三种。 有益的朋友有三类，有损的朋友亦有三类。

t: There are three kinds of enjoyment that help and three that harm
y: 孔子曰：益者三乐，损者三乐。乐节礼乐，乐道人之善，乐多贤友，益矣。乐骄乐，乐佚游，乐宴乐，损矣。
x: Confucius said: There are three kinds of enjoyment that help and three that harm. Enjoying the regulation of ritual and music, enjoying speaking of others' good points, enjoying having many worthy friends — they help. Enjoying arrogant pleasures, enjoying idle wandering, enjoying feasting — they harm. 孔子说，有益的爱好有三种，有害的爱好也有三种，喜爱辨明礼乐的节度、称道人家的善行、多交贤友，有益，喜爱骄纵享乐、闲游无度、宴饮取乐，有害。 云益者三樂者，謂以心中有所愛樂有三事為益者也。 有益的快乐三种，有害的快乐三种。 对人有益的快乐有三种，对人有损的快乐亦有三种。

t: In attending a gentleman there are three errors
y: 孔子曰：侍于君子有三愆：言未及之而言谓之躁，言及之而不言谓之隐，未见颜色而言谓之瞽。
x: Confucius said: In attending a gentleman there are three errors. To speak before it is your turn is called rashness; not to speak when it is your turn is called concealment; to speak without watching his expression is called blindness. 孔子说，陪侍君子有三种过失，还没有轮到自己说便说叫急躁，到了该说的时候却不说叫隐瞒，没有察看对方神色便开口叫没有眼力。 云孔子曰云云者，愆，過也。 陪着君子说话容易犯三种过失：没轮到他说话，却先说，… 侍奉君子，易犯三种的过失。

t: The gentleman guards against three things
y: 孔子曰：君子有三戒：少之时，血气未定，戒之在色；及其壮也，血气方刚，戒之在斗；及其老也，血气既衰，戒之在得。
x: Confucius said: The gentleman guards against three things. In youth, when the blood and breath are not yet settled, he guards against lust. In his prime, when the blood and breath are strong, he guards against strife. In old age, when the blood and breath have declined, he guards against greed. 孔子说，君子有三项戒惧，年少血气未定，要戒迷恋女色，壮年血气强盛，要戒争斗，老年血气衰退，要戒贪得。 云君子有三戒者，君子自戒，其事有三，故云有三戒也。 君子有三件事情应该警惕戒备：年轻的时候，血气未定，… 君子当有三戒。

t: The gentleman holds three things in awe: the decree of Heaven…
y: 孔子曰：君子有三畏：畏天命，畏大人，畏圣人之言。小人不知天命而不畏也，狎大人，侮圣人之言。
x: Confucius said: The gentleman holds three things in awe: the decree of Heaven, great men, and the words of the sages. The petty man does not know the decree of Heaven and so does not hold it in awe; he is overfamiliar with great men and mocks the words of the sages. 孔子说，君子敬畏天命、身居高位者和圣人的言论；小人不懂天命，便不敬畏，轻慢身居高位者，戏侮圣人的言论。 云君子有三畏者，君子所畏有三事也。 君子害怕的有三件事：怕天命，怕王公大人，怕圣人的言语。 君子有三项敬畏。

t: Those born knowing are the highest
y: 孔子曰：生而知之者，上也；学而知之者，次也；困而学之，又其次也；困而不学，民斯为下矣。
x: Confucius said: Those born knowing are the highest; those who learn and come to know are next; those who learn when they meet difficulty are next again; those who meet difficulty and still do not learn — these people are the lowest. 孔子说，生来便懂得的是上等，经过学习才懂得的次一等，遇到不通再学习的又次一等，遇到不通仍不学习的人，便是最下等。 此章勸學也，故先從聖人始也。 生来就知道的是上等，学习然后知道的是次一等；… 生来就知道的，那是最上等。

t: The gentleman has nine things to think about: in seeing, to see…
y: 孔子曰：君子有九思：视思明，听思聪，色思温，貌思恭，言思忠，事思敬，疑思问，忿思难，见得思义。
x: Confucius said: The gentleman has nine things to think about: in seeing, to see clearly; in hearing, to hear keenly; in his expression, to be warm; in his bearing, to be respectful; in his words, to be loyal; in his work, to be reverent; in doubt, to ask; in anger, to think of the consequences; and when seeing gain, to think of what is right. 孔子说，君子有九项自省，看要想到明白，听要想到清楚，脸色要想到温和，仪容要想到恭敬，说话要想到忠实，做事要想到敬慎，有疑难要想到请教，发怒要想到后患，面临可得之物要想到是否合义。 云君子有九思者，言君子所宜用思之事，其條有九也。 君子有九种考虑：看的时候，考虑看明白了没有；听的时候，… 君子有九样的思。

t: Seeing good, act as if you could not reach it
y: 孔子曰：见善如不及，见不善如探汤。吾见其人矣，吾闻其语矣。隐居以求其志，行义以达其道。吾闻其语矣，未见其人也。
x: Confucius said: 'Seeing good, act as if you could not reach it; seeing evil, act as if testing boiling water.' I have seen such men and heard such words. 'Living in seclusion to pursue one's aims, practicing what is right to fulfill one's Way.' I have heard such words, but have not seen such men. 孔子说，看见善就像唯恐追不上，见到不善就像伸手碰到滚水，这样的人他见过，这样的话他也听过。隐居以守自己的志向，依义而行以实现自己的道，这样的话他听过，这样的人却没有见到。 云見善如不及者，見有善者當慕而齊之，恒恐己不能相及也。 看见善良，努力追求，好像赶不上似的；遇见邪恶，使劲避开，… ‘看见有善的，自己像来不及般。

t: Duke Jing of Qi had a thousand teams of four horses, yet on the…
y: 齐景公有马千驷，死之日，民无德而称焉。伯夷叔齐饿于首阳之下，民到于今称之。其斯之谓与？
x: Duke Jing of Qi had a thousand teams of four horses, yet on the day he died the people found no virtue in him to praise. Boyi and Shuqi starved at the foot of Mount Shouyang, and the people praise them to this day. Is this not what it means? 齐景公拥有四千匹马，死时百姓却没有什么德行可以称颂，伯夷、叔齐饿死在首阳山下，百姓至今仍称颂他们，说的大概就是这样的事。 云齊景公有馬千駟者，千駟，四千匹馬也。 齐景公有马四千匹，死了以后，… 齐景公有马四千匹，到他死之日，人民对他没有可称的。

t: Chen Kang asked Boyu: Have you heard anything different from…
y: 陈亢问于伯鱼曰：子亦有异闻乎？对曰：未也。尝独立，鲤趋而过庭。曰：学诗乎？对曰：未也。不学诗，无以言。鲤退而学诗。他日又独立，鲤趋而过庭。曰：学礼乎？对曰：未也。不学礼，无以立。鲤退而学礼。闻斯二者。陈亢退而喜曰：问一得三，闻诗，闻礼，又闻君子之远其子也。
x: Chen Kang asked Boyu: Have you heard anything different from your father? He replied: Not yet. Once when he was standing alone, I hurried across the courtyard. He said: Have you studied the Odes? I replied: Not yet. Without studying the Odes, you will have nothing to say. I withdrew and studied the Odes. Another day he was again standing alone, and I hurried across the courtyard. He said: Have you studied ritual? I replied: Not yet. Without studying ritual, you will have nothing to stand on. I withdrew and studied ritual. These two things I have heard. Chen Kang withdrew and said happily: I asked one thing and got three: I heard about the Odes, I heard about ritual, and I also heard that the gentleman keeps a distance from his own son. 陈亢问伯鱼，是否从父亲那里听到过特别的教导，伯鱼说没有，只是有次父亲独自站着，他快步经过庭院，父亲问学诗没有，说不学诗便无从言说，他便退下学诗，另一次又这样问学礼没有，说不学礼便无从立身，他便退下学礼，所听到的只有这两件事。陈亢离开后高兴地说，问一件事却得到三点，懂得了学诗、学礼，也懂得君子不私厚自己的儿子。 云陳亢問云云者，陳亢即子禽也。 他曾经一个人站在庭中，我恭敬地走过。 你在你父亲那里听到些特别的教训吗？

t: The wife of a ruler of a state: the ruler calls her 'Lady'
y: 邦君之妻，君称之曰夫人，夫人自称曰小童；邦人称之曰君夫人，称诸异邦曰寡小君；异邦人称之亦曰君夫人。
x: The wife of a ruler of a state: the ruler calls her 'Lady'; she calls herself 'little child'; the people of the state call her 'the ruler's Lady'; speaking of her to other states, they call her 'our little ruler'; people of other states also call her 'the ruler's Lady'. 国君称自己的妻子为夫人，夫人自称小童，本国人称她为君夫人，向外国人提起她称寡小君，外国人也称她为君夫人。 云當時禮亂，稱謂不明，故孔子正之也。 国君的妻子，国君称她为夫人，她自称为小童；… 夫人”。

t: Yang Huo wanted Confucius to come see him, but Confucius would…
y: 阳货欲见孔子，孔子不见，归孔子豚。孔子时其亡也，而往拜之，遇诸涂。谓孔子曰：来！予与尔言。曰：怀其宝而迷其邦，可谓仁乎？曰：不可。好从事而亟失时，可谓知乎？曰：不可。日月逝矣，岁不我与。孔子曰：诺。吾将仕矣。
x: Yang Huo wanted Confucius to come see him, but Confucius would not, so Yang Huo sent Confucius a pig. Confucius chose a time when he was out to go and thank him, but met him on the road. Yang Huo said to Confucius: Come, I will talk with you. Can one who hides his treasure and lets his state go astray be called humane? He said: He cannot. Can one who loves to take part in affairs yet keeps missing his chances be called wise? He said: He cannot. The days and months slip by; the years do not wait for us. Confucius said: Very well. I will take office. 阳货想让孔子来见自己，孔子不去，他便送一只小猪给孔子，孔子也趁他不在家时前往拜谢，却在路上遇见他；阳货叫孔子近前，指责有才能却任国家迷乱不能算仁，想做事却屡失时机不能算智，并催他说岁月流逝不等人。孔子答应说，好，他将要出仕。 云陽貨欲見孔子者，陽貨者，季氏家臣陽虎也。 阳货想要孔子来拜会他，孔子不去，… 阳货想要见孔子，孔子不见他。

t: By nature people are close to one another
y: 子曰：性相近也，习相远也。
x: The Master said: By nature people are close to one another; by practice they grow far apart. 孔子说，人的禀性原来相近，经过不同的习染，才渐渐相距很远。 云子曰云云者，性者，人所稟以生也。 人性情本相近，因为习染不同，便相距悬远。 人的天性是相近的，由于习惯而相远。

t: Only the wisest and the most foolish do not change
y: 子曰：唯上知与下愚不移。
x: The Master said: Only the wisest and the most foolish do not change. 孔子说，只有最高明的人和最愚昧的人不会改变。 云子曰云云者，性者，人所稟以生也。 只有上等的智者和下等的愚人是改变不了的。 只有上知与下愚之人不可迁移。

t: The Master went to Wucheng and heard the sound of strings and…
y: 子之武城，闻弦歌之声。夫子莞尔而笑，曰：割鸡焉用牛刀？子游对曰：昔者偃也闻诸夫子曰：君子学道则爱人，小人学道则易使也。子曰：二三子！偃之言是也。前言戏之耳。
x: The Master went to Wucheng and heard the sound of strings and singing. The Master smiled and said: Why use an ox knife to kill a chicken? Ziyou replied: Some time ago I heard you say, Master: 'When the gentleman learns the Way, he loves others; when the petty man learns the Way, he is easy to employ.' The Master said: My friends, what Yan says is right. What I said before was only a joke. 孔子到武城听见弦歌，微笑着说宰鸡何必用宰牛的刀，子游便引孔子从前的话，说明在位者学道就爱人，百姓学道就容易使唤。孔子对学生们说，言偃说得对，自己先前的话只是玩笑。 云子之云云者，之，往也。 孔子到了〔子游作县长〕的武城，听到了弹琴瑟唱诗歌的声音。 先生去游武城，听到弦歌之声。

t: Gongshan Furao held Bi in revolt and summoned the Master, and…
y: 公山弗扰以费畔，召，子欲往。子路不说，曰：末之也已，何必公山氏之之也。子曰：夫召我者而岂徒哉？如有用我者，吾其为东周乎？
x: Gongshan Furao held Bi in revolt and summoned the Master, and the Master wanted to go. Zilu was displeased and said: If there is nowhere to go, then do not go. Why must you go to Gongshan? The Master said: Would the one who summons me do so for nothing? If anyone would employ me, could I not make a Zhou in the east? 公山弗扰据费邑反叛，派人召孔子，孔子想去，子路不高兴，说没有地方去也就罢了，何必到公山氏那里。孔子说，召自己难道是没有用意，若真有人任用自己，便可以在东方复兴周道。 公山不擾者，姓公山，名不擾也。 公山弗扰盘踞在费邑图谋造反，叫孔子去，孔子准备去。 公山弗扰据费邑叛季孙氏，来召孔子，孔子考虑欲往赴召。

t: Zizhang asked Confucius about humaneness
y: 子张问仁于孔子。孔子曰：能行五者于天下，为仁矣。请问之。曰：恭、宽、信、敏、惠。恭则不侮，宽则得众，信则人任焉，敏则有功，惠则足以使人。
x: Zizhang asked Confucius about humaneness. Confucius said: One who can practice five things throughout the world is humane. He asked what they were. Respect, generosity, good faith, diligence, and kindness. With respect, you will not be insulted; with generosity, you will win the many; with good faith, others will rely on you; with diligence, you will achieve results; with kindness, you will be able to employ others. 子张向孔子问仁，孔子说，能在任何地方实行恭敬、宽厚、守信、勤敏、施惠这五项，就可以成仁。恭敬便不受侮辱，宽厚便得众人拥护，守信便有人倚任，勤敏便能成事，施惠便能够使人效力。 云子張云云者，言若能行五事於天下，則可謂之為仁人也。 能够处处实行五种品德，便是仁人了。 子张问仁道于孔子。

t: Bi Xi summoned the Master, and the Master wanted to go
y: 佛肸召，子欲往。子路曰：昔者由也闻诸夫子曰：亲于其身为不善者，君子不入也。佛肸以中牟畔，子之往也，如之何！子曰：然。有是言也。不曰坚乎，磨而不磷；不曰白乎，涅而不缁。吾岂匏瓜也哉？焉能系而不食？
x: Bi Xi summoned the Master, and the Master wanted to go. Zilu said: Some time ago I heard you say, Master: 'A gentleman does not enter the domain of one who personally does wrong.' Bi Xi holds Zhongmou in revolt. How can you go to him? The Master said: Yes, I did say that. But is it not said that what is truly hard can be ground without being worn thin, and what is truly white can be dyed without turning black? Am I a bitter gourd, to hang there and not be eaten? 佛肸召孔子，孔子想去，子路便拿孔子从前“不进入亲自作恶者之党”的话，质问为何要到据中牟反叛的佛肸那里。孔子承认说过，却又说真正坚硬的磨不薄，真正洁白的染不黑，自己难道是只能挂着、不供食用的匏瓜。 胇肹召者，胇肹使人召於孔子。 佛肸叫孔子，孔子打算去。 佛肸来召孔子，孔子考虑欲往。

t: You, have you heard of the six words and their six flaws?
y: 子曰：由也，女闻六言六蔽矣乎？对曰：未也。居！吾语女。好仁不好学，其蔽也愚；好知不好学，其蔽也荡；好信不好学，其蔽也贼；好直不好学，其蔽也绞；好勇不好学，其蔽也乱；好刚不好学，其蔽也狂。
x: The Master said: You, have you heard of the six words and their six flaws? He replied: Not yet. Sit down; I will tell you. Loving humaneness without loving learning, the flaw is foolishness. Loving wisdom without loving learning, the flaw is aimlessness. Loving good faith without loving learning, the flaw is doing harm. Loving straightness without loving learning, the flaw is harshness. Loving courage without loving learning, the flaw is disorder. Loving firmness without loving learning, the flaw is recklessness. 孔子问子路听过六种美德及其六种弊病没有，子路说没有，孔子便叫他坐下，说喜仁而不好学会受愚昧蒙蔽，喜智而不好学会放荡无所守，喜信而不好学会害人，喜直而不好学会尖刻，喜勇而不好学会作乱，喜刚而不好学会狂妄。 子曰由者，呼子路名而問之也。 爱仁德，却不爱学问，那种弊病就是容易被人愚弄；爱耍聪明，… 由呀！

t: My young friends, why does none of you study the Odes?
y: 子曰：小子！何莫学夫诗？诗，可以兴，可以观，可以群，可以怨。迩之事父，远之事君。多识于鸟兽草木之名。
x: The Master said: My young friends, why does none of you study the Odes? The Odes can rouse you, help you observe, help you live with others, and let you voice complaints. Near at hand, they teach you to serve your father; further off, to serve your ruler. And you learn many names of birds, beasts, plants, and trees. 孔子说，学生们为什么不学诗，诗可以感发志意、观察得失、使人合群、表达怨意，近可用于侍奉父亲，远可用于侍奉君主，还可以认识许多鸟兽草木的名称。 子曰小子者，呼諸弟子欲語之也。 读诗，可以培养联想力，可以提高观察力，可以锻炼合群性，… 小子们，为何没有人学诗呀！

t: Have you studied the Zhounan and Shaonan?
y: 子谓伯鱼曰：女为周南召南矣乎？人而不为周南召南，其犹正墙面而立也与？
x: The Master said to Boyu: Have you studied the Zhounan and Shaonan? A man who has not studied the Zhounan and Shaonan is like one standing with his face right up against a wall! 孔子问伯鱼学过《周南》《召南》没有，说人不学这两部分诗，就像正对着墙站着，看不见，也无从向前走。 云子謂云云者，伯魚，孔子之子也。 人假若不研究《周南》和《召南》，那会像面正对着墙壁而站着罢！ 你学了周南、召南的诗吗？

t: Ritual, they say, ritual — is it only jade and silk?
y: 子曰：礼云礼云，玉帛云乎哉？乐云乐云，钟鼓云乎哉？
x: The Master said: Ritual, they say, ritual — is it only jade and silk? Music, they say, music — is it only bells and drums? 孔子说，人们口口声声讲礼，难道只是说玉帛，口口声声讲乐，难道只是说钟鼓。 此章辨禮樂之本也。 礼呀礼呀，仅是指玉帛等等礼物而说的吗？ 尽说礼呀礼呀！

t: Stern in appearance but weak within — among petty men, he is…
y: 子曰：色厉而内荏，譬诸小人，其犹穿窬之盗也与？
x: The Master said: Stern in appearance but weak within — among petty men, he is like a thief who bores through walls! 孔子说，外表严厉而内心软弱，拿普通人作比，大概就像穿墙越壁的盗贼。 色厲而內荏者，厲，矜正也。 颜色严厉，内心怯弱，若用坏人作比喻，怕像个挖洞跳墙的小偷罢！ 外貌装得很威严，内心实是软怯，那样的人，…

t: The village worthy is the thief of virtue
y: 子曰：乡原，德之贼也。
x: The Master said: The village worthy is the thief of virtue. 孔子说，那种一乡都称他老实、实则媚俗苟合的人，是损害德行的人。 鄉者，鄉里也。 没有真是非的好好先生是足以败坏道德的小人。 一乡中全不得罪的那种好人，是人类品德中的败类呀！

t: To hear something on the road and repeat it along the way is to…
y: 子曰：道听而涂说，德之弃也。
x: The Master said: To hear something on the road and repeat it along the way is to throw virtue away. 孔子说，在路上听到便沿途传说，是把自己的德业丢弃了。 道，路也。 听到道路传言就四处传播，这是应该革除的作风。 在道路上听便在道路上说的那些人，是品德中的弃物呀！

t: Can one serve a ruler alongside a base man?
y: 子曰：鄙夫可与事君也与哉？其未得之也，患得之；既得之，患失之。苟患失之，无所不至矣。
x: The Master said: Can one serve a ruler alongside a base man? Before he gets it, he worries about getting it; once he has it, he worries about losing it. If he worries about losing it, there is nothing he will not do. 孔子说，鄙陋的人怎能与他一同事君，职位未得到时担心得不到，得到后又担心失掉。既然怕失去，就什么事都干得出来。 言凡鄙之人不可與事君。 当他没有得到职位的时候，生怕得不着；已经得着了，又怕失去。 一个鄙夫，可和他共同事君吗？

t: In ancient times, people had three failings
y: 子曰：古者民有三疾，今也或是之亡也。古之狂也肆，今之狂也荡；古之矜也廉，今之矜也忿戾；古之愚也直，今之愚也诈而已矣。
x: The Master said: In ancient times, people had three failings; now perhaps even these are gone. The wild of old were unrestrained; the wild of today are dissolute. The proud of old were scrupulous; the proud of today are quarrelsome. The foolish of old were straightforward; the foolish of today are simply deceitful. 孔子说，古人有三种偏失，如今连偏失中可取的部分也没有了，古时狂放的人只是疏于小节，如今却放荡越界，古时矜持的人还有棱角，如今却乖戾易怒，古时愚朴的人还直率，如今却只剩欺诈。 古謂淳時也。 古代的人民还有三种〔可贵的〕毛病，现在呢，或许都没有了。 古人常见有三种病，现在或许连这些病也不见了。

t: Clever words and an ingratiating look — seldom are they humane
y: 子曰：巧言令色，鲜矣仁。
x: The Master said: Clever words and an ingratiating look — seldom are they humane. 孔子说，花巧的言辞、讨好的脸色，往往很少有仁德。

t: I hate purple taking the place of vermilion
y: 子曰：恶紫之夺朱也，恶郑声之乱雅乐也，恶利口之覆邦家者。
x: The Master said: I hate purple taking the place of vermilion; I hate the tunes of Zheng confusing proper music; I hate sharp tongues that overturn states and families. 孔子说，他厌恶紫色取代正红，厌恶郑声扰乱雅乐，厌恶伶俐的口舌颠覆国家。 云惡紫者，紫是間色，朱是正色。 紫色夺去了大红色的光彩和地位，可憎恶；… 我厌恶紫色夺去了朱色，厌恶郑声扰乱了雅乐，…

t: I would rather not speak
y: 子曰：予欲无言。子贡曰：子如不言，则小子何述焉？子曰：天何言哉？四时行焉，百物生焉，天何言哉？
x: The Master said: I would rather not speak. Zigong said: If you do not speak, Master, what will we disciples pass on? The Master said: Does Heaven speak? The four seasons go round, and all things are born. Does Heaven speak? 孔子说自己想不说话了，子贡问这样学生还能传述什么。孔子说，天说过什么，四季却照常运行，万物照常生长，天说过什么。 云子欲無言者，孔子欲不復言也。 我想不说话了。 我想不再有所言说了。

t: Ru Bei wanted to see Confucius
y: 孺悲欲见孔子，孔子辞以疾。将命者出户，取瑟而歌。使之闻之。
x: Ru Bei wanted to see Confucius; Confucius declined, pleading illness. As the messenger went out the door, he took up his zither and sang, making sure he heard it. 孺悲求见，孔子以生病推辞，传话的人刚走出门，他就拿瑟来弹唱，故意让孺悲听见。 孺悲，魯人也。 孺悲来，要会晤孔子，孔子托言有病，拒绝接待。 孺悲要求见孔子，孔子不肯见，推辞有病。

t: Three years of mourning — a year is already long enough
y: 宰我问：三年之丧，期已久矣。君子三年不为礼，礼必坏；三年不为乐，乐必崩。旧谷既没，新谷既升，钻燧改火，期可已矣。子曰：食夫稻，衣夫锦，于女安乎？曰：安。女安则为之！夫君子之居丧，食旨不甘，闻乐不乐，居处不安，故不为也。今女安，则为之！宰我出。子曰：予之不仁也！子生三年，然后免于父母之怀。夫三年之丧，天下之通丧也。予也有三年之爱于其父母乎？
x: Zai Wo asked: Three years of mourning — a year is already long enough. If a gentleman does not practice ritual for three years, ritual will surely decay; if he does not practice music for three years, music will surely collapse. The old grain is used up, the new grain has risen, the fire-drilling woods have gone round — a year should be enough. The Master said: Eating that rice and wearing that brocade — would you be at ease? He said: I would. If you would be at ease, then do it! When a gentleman is in mourning, fine food has no taste, music gives no joy, and his home gives no comfort, so he does not do these things. Now if you are at ease, then do it! Zai Wo went out. The Master said: How inhumane Yu is! A child is three years old before it leaves its parents' arms. Three years of mourning is the mourning common to all under Heaven. Did Yu not have three years of love from his parents? 宰我认为三年守丧太久，三年不习礼乐会使礼乐败坏，旧谷用尽新谷登场、取火的木料轮换一遍，满一年就可以停止；孔子问他守丧时吃稻米、穿锦衣是否心安，他说心安，孔子便说心安就去做，但君子居丧时好吃的也不觉得甘美，听音乐也不快乐，平常居处也不安适，所以不这样做。宰我出去后，孔子批评他不仁，说孩子生下三年才离开父母怀抱，三年之丧是通行的丧礼，反问宰我是否也受过父母三年的爱护。 云宰我問云云者，宰我問說喪制不宜三年之義也。 父母死了，守孝三年，为期也太久了。 三年之丧，似乎期限太久了。

t: To eat one's fill all day and give one's mind to nothing — that…
y: 子曰：饱食终日，无所用心，难矣哉！不有博弈者乎，为之犹贤乎已。
x: The Master said: To eat one's fill all day and give one's mind to nothing — that is hard indeed! Are there not games like bo and yi? Playing them would still be better than nothing. 孔子说，整天吃饱却不用心，真难有所成，难道没有博戏、围棋可做，做那些还胜过完全不动心思。 云子曰云云者，夫人衣食，所以充飽寒虛也。 整天吃饱了饭，什么事也不做，不行的呀！ 吃饱了，一天到晚心没处用，这真难呀！

t: Does the gentleman esteem courage?
y: 子路曰：君子尚勇乎？子曰：君子义以为上。君子有勇而无义为乱，小人有勇而无义为盗。
x: Zilu said: Does the gentleman esteem courage? The Master said: The gentleman holds what is right as highest. A gentleman with courage but without rightness makes trouble; a petty man with courage but without rightness becomes a robber. 子路问君子是否崇尚勇，孔子说，君子把义放在首位，身居上位者有勇无义就会作乱，在下者有勇无义就会做盗贼。 子路曰云云者，子路人常尚勇。 君子认为义是最可尊贵的，君子只有勇，没有义，… 君子看重勇吗？

t: Does the gentleman also have things he hates?
y: 子贡曰：君子亦有恶乎？子曰：有恶：恶称人之恶者，恶居下流而讪上者，恶勇而无礼者，恶果敢而窒者。曰：赐也亦有恶乎？恶徼以为知者，恶不孙以为勇者，恶讦以为直者。
x: Zigong said: Does the gentleman also have things he hates? The Master said: He does. He hates those who speak of others' faults; he hates those in low places who slander those above; he hates the brave who lack ritual; he hates the bold who are obstinate. He said: Ci, do you also have things you hate? I hate those who take prying for wisdom, those who take insolence for courage, and those who take exposing others for honesty. 子贡问君子是否也有厌恶的人，孔子说有，厌恶宣扬别人坏处的人、在下毁谤在上的人、有勇无礼的人、果断却闭塞不通的人，又问子贡厌恶什么。子贡说，厌恶把窥察别人的私事当作聪明、把不谦逊当勇敢、把揭人隐私当正直的人。 云子貢問云云者，惡，謂憎疾也。 有憎恨的事：憎恨一味传播别人的坏处的人，… 君子亦对人有厌恶吗？

t: Women and petty men are the hardest to deal with
y: 子曰：唯女子与小人为难养也，近之则不孙，远之则怨。
x: The Master said: Women and petty men are the hardest to deal with. Keep them close and they become insolent; keep them at a distance and they resent it. 孔子说，女子和仆役难以相处，过分亲近便不恭顺，疏远又会怨恨。 並稟陰陽間氣多，故其意淺促，所以難可養也。 只有女子和小人是难得同他们共处的，亲近了，他会无礼；… 只有家里的妾侍和仆人最难养。

t: One who is still disliked at forty will end that way
y: 子曰：年四十而见恶焉，其终也已。
x: The Master said: One who is still disliked at forty will end that way. 孔子说，到了四十岁还被人厌恶，这个人也就到此为止了。 年未四十則在不惑之時，當猶為眾人所觀瞻。 到了四十岁还被厌恶，他这一生也就完了。 年到四十，还是被人厌恶，这就怕无望了。

t: The Viscount of Wei left, the Viscount of Ji became a slave…
y: 微子去之，箕子为之奴，比干谏而死。孔子曰：殷有三仁焉。
x: The Viscount of Wei left, the Viscount of Ji became a slave, and Bi Gan remonstrated and died. Confucius said: Yin had three humane men. 微子离开了纣，箕子被纣降为奴隶，比干因进谏而死，孔子说，殷朝有三位仁人。 微子，殷王帝乙之元子，紂庶兄也。 〔纣王昏乱残暴，〕微子便离开了他，箕子做了他的奴隶，… 微子避而去，箕子囚为奴，比干谏而死。

t: Liuxia Hui served as chief judge and was dismissed three times
y: 柳下惠为士师，三黜。人曰：子未可以去乎？曰：直道而事人，焉往而不三黜？枉道而事人，何必去父母之邦？
x: Liuxia Hui served as chief judge and was dismissed three times. Someone said: Is it not time for you to leave? He said: If I serve others by the straight Way, where could I go and not be dismissed three times? If I serve others by a crooked Way, why should I leave the land of my parents? 柳下惠做士师，屡次被罢黜，有人劝他离去，他说，依正道事人，去哪里不会被罢黜，若屈道事人，又何必离开父母之邦。 柳下惠者，柳下季也。 柳下惠做法官，多次地被撤职。 柳下惠当鲁国的狱官，三次被黜。

t: Duke Jing of Qi, discussing how to treat Confucius, said: I…
y: 齐景公待孔子，曰：若季氏则吾不能，以季、孟之闲待之。曰：吾老矣，不能用也。孔子行。
x: Duke Jing of Qi, discussing how to treat Confucius, said: I cannot treat him as the Ji family is treated; I will treat him somewhere between the Ji and the Meng. Then he said: I am old; I cannot make use of him. Confucius left. 齐景公说，对待孔子不能像鲁君对待季氏那样，只能给他介于季氏、孟氏之间的待遇，后来又说自己老了，不能任用他，孔子便离开了。 云齊景公待孔子者，孔子往齊，而景公初欲虛待孔子共為政化也。 用鲁君对待季氏的模样对待孔子，那我做不到；… 像鲁君待遇季氏般，我就不能了。

t: The people of Qi sent a troupe of female musicians, and Ji…
y: 齐人归女乐，季桓子受之。三日不朝，孔子行。
x: The people of Qi sent a troupe of female musicians, and Ji Huanzi accepted them. For three days no court was held, and Confucius left. 齐国人送来女乐，季桓子接受后，接连三天不上朝，孔子便离开鲁国。 云齊人歸女樂者，歸，猶饋也。 齐国送了许多歌姬舞女给鲁国，季桓子接受了，三天不问政事，… 齐人送来一批女乐队，季桓子接受了，三天不举行朝礼，…

t: Jieyu, the madman of Chu, passed Confucius singing: Phoenix!
y: 楚狂接舆歌而过孔子曰：凤兮！凤兮！何德之衰？往者不可谏，来者犹可追。已而，已而！今之从政者殆而！孔子下，欲与之言。趋而辟之，不得与之言。
x: Jieyu, the madman of Chu, passed Confucius singing: Phoenix! Phoenix! How your virtue has declined! What is past cannot be corrected; what is to come can still be pursued. Give it up, give it up! Those who govern today are in peril! Confucius got down, wanting to speak with him, but he hurried away to avoid him, and Confucius could not speak with him. 楚国隐者接舆经过孔子的车旁唱歌，以凤凰比孔子，叹他德衰，说过去的事已无法挽回，未来的还来得及，劝他停止奔走，因为如今从政很危险。孔子下车想与他谈话，他却快步避开，使孔子未能同他说话。 云楚狂者，楚地人也。 过去的不能再挽回，未来的还可不再着迷。 楚国一狂人，接在孔子车后而歌，越过孔子车而前。

t: Changju and Jieni were ploughing side by side
y: 长沮、桀溺耦而耕，孔子过之，使子路问津焉。长沮曰：夫执舆者为谁？子路曰：为孔丘。曰：是鲁孔丘与？曰：是也。曰：是知津矣。问于桀溺，桀溺曰：子为谁？曰：为仲由。曰：是鲁孔丘之徒与？对曰：然。曰：滔滔者天下皆是也，而谁以易之？且而与其从辟人之士也，岂若从辟世之士哉？耰而不辍。子路行以告。夫子怃然曰：鸟兽不可与同群，吾非斯人之徒与而谁与？天下有道，丘不与易也。
x: Changju and Jieni were ploughing side by side. Confucius passed by and sent Zilu to ask them where the ford was. Changju said: Who is that holding the reins? Zilu said: It is Kong Qiu. Is it Kong Qiu of Lu? It is. Then he knows where the ford is. Zilu asked Jieni. Jieni said: Who are you? I am Zhong You. Are you a follower of Kong Qiu of Lu? He replied: I am. The whole world is a rushing flood, and who can change it? Rather than follow a man who avoids certain people, would you not do better to follow a man who avoids the whole world? And he went on covering the seed without stopping. Zilu went and reported this. The Master said sadly: One cannot flock with birds and beasts. If I do not associate with these people, with whom should I associate? If the world had the Way, I would not be trying to change it. 长沮、桀溺一起耕田，孔子经过，派子路询问渡口，长沮得知车上是鲁国孔丘，便说他自会知道渡口，桀溺得知子路是孔门弟子，便说天下都像滔滔洪水，谁能改变，与其跟随避开某些人的人，不如跟随避开整个世道的人，说着仍不停耕作。子路回来转告，孔子怅然说，自己不能与鸟兽同群，不同人群相处还能同谁相处，若天下已有道，自己也就不必去改变它。 云長沮桀溺耦而耕者，長沮桀溺二人皆隱士也。 长沮、桀溺两人一同耕田，孔子在那儿经过，叫子路去问渡口。 长沮、桀溺两人作对在田中耕，孔子路过，…

t: Zilu, following the Master, fell behind and met an old man…
y: 子路从而后，遇丈人，以杖荷蓧。子路问曰：子见夫子乎？丈人曰：四体不勤，五谷不分。孰为夫子？植其杖而芸。子路拱而立。止子路宿，杀鸡为黍而食之，见其二子焉。明日，子路行以告。子曰：隐者也。使子路反见之。至则行矣。子路曰：不仕无义。长幼之节，不可废也；君臣之义，如之何其废之？欲洁其身，而乱大伦。君子之仕也，行其义也。道之不行，已知之矣。
x: Zilu, following the Master, fell behind and met an old man carrying a basket on his staff. Zilu asked: Have you seen my master? The old man said: Your four limbs do no work, you cannot tell the five grains apart — who is your master? He planted his staff and began weeding. Zilu stood with his hands folded. The old man kept Zilu for the night, killed a chicken, cooked millet, fed him, and introduced his two sons. The next day Zilu went on and reported this. The Master said: He is a recluse. He sent Zilu back to see him, but when he arrived the man had gone. Zilu said: Not to serve is not right. The proper order between old and young cannot be discarded; how can the duty between ruler and minister be discarded? Wishing to keep himself pure, he throws the great relationships into disorder. A gentleman serves in order to do what is right. That the Way does not prevail, he already knows. 子路掉队，遇见一位用杖挑着竹器的老人，问他见过老师没有，老人责他四肢不劳、五谷不辨，反问谁是老师，随即立杖除草，子路恭敬站着，老人留他住宿，杀鸡做黍饭招待，并让两个儿子出来相见，次日子路把事情告诉孔子，孔子说这是隐者，派他返回去见，老人却已经走了。子路说，不出仕便不能实行应有之义，长幼之礼尚且不能废，君臣之义又怎能废，想洁身却乱了大伦，君子出仕是为行义，道不能施行本来就已知道。 子路從而後者，孔子先發，子路在後隨從而後至。 子路跟随着孔子，却远落在后面，碰到一个老头，… 子路从行，落后了，遇见一老者，杖头担着一竹器，在路行走。

t: Men who withdrew from the world: Boyi, Shuqi, Yuzhong, Yiyi…
y: 逸民：伯夷、叔齐、虞仲、夷逸、朱张、柳下惠、少连。子曰：不降其志，不辱其身，伯夷、叔齐与？谓：柳下惠、少连，降志辱身矣。言中伦，行中虑，其斯而已矣。谓：虞仲、夷逸，隐居放言。身中清，废中权。我则异于是，无可无不可。
x: Men who withdrew from the world: Boyi, Shuqi, Yuzhong, Yiyi, Zhu Zhang, Liuxia Hui, Shaolian. The Master said: Not lowering their aims nor disgracing themselves — that was Boyi and Shuqi. Of Liuxia Hui and Shaolian he said: They lowered their aims and disgraced themselves, but their words accorded with reason and their conduct with forethought — that was all. Of Yuzhong and Yiyi he said: They lived in seclusion and spoke freely; their persons were pure, and their withdrawal was well judged. I am different from all of them: for me there is nothing that must be done and nothing that must not be done. 遗逸无位的人有伯夷、叔齐、虞仲、夷逸、朱张、柳下惠、少连，孔子说，不降低志向、不使自身受辱的是伯夷叔齐，柳下惠少连虽降志辱身，言论仍合义理、行动仍经得起思量，虞仲夷逸隐居、不谈世事，自身合于清洁，弃仕合于权宜。孔子说自己与他们不同，没有预定什么必可、什么必不可。 云逸民者，逸民者謂民中節行超逸不拘於世者也。 古今被遗落的人才有伯夷、叔齐、虞仲、夷逸、朱张、柳下惠、… 逸民有伯夷、叔齐、虞仲、夷逸、朱张、柳下惠、少连。

t: Grand Music Master Zhi went to Qi
y: 大师挚适齐，亚饭干适楚，三饭缭适蔡，四饭缺适秦。鼓方叔入于河，播鼗武入于汉，少师阳、击磬襄入于海。
x: Grand Music Master Zhi went to Qi; Gan, master of the second meal, went to Chu; Liao, master of the third meal, went to Cai; Que, master of the fourth meal, went to Qin. Fangshu the drummer went to the Yellow River region; Wu, player of the hand drum, went to the Han; Yang, the assistant music master, and Xiang, player of the stone chimes, went to the coast. 鲁国太师挚去了齐国，侑食乐官干去了楚国、缭去了蔡国、缺去了秦国，击鼓的方叔去了河内，摇鼗的武去了汉中，少师阳和击磬的襄去了海边。 大師摯適齊者，自此以下皆魯之樂人名也。 太师挚逃到了齐国，二饭乐师干逃到了楚国，… 太师挚去了齐国，亚饭干去了楚国，三饭缭去了蔡国，…

t: The Duke of Zhou said to the Duke of Lu: The gentleman does not…
y: 周公谓鲁公曰：君子不施其亲。不使大臣怨乎不以。故旧无大故，则不弃也。无求备于一人。
x: The Duke of Zhou said to the Duke of Lu: The gentleman does not neglect his kin. He does not give the great ministers cause to resent not being used. Old friends, unless there is a grave reason, he does not cast off. He does not expect everything of one person. 周公告诫儿子鲁公，不要疏弃亲族，不要使大臣因不被任用而怨恨，旧交没有重大的恶行就不要抛弃，也不要向一个人求全责备。 周公謂魯公者，周公謂伯禽也。 君子不怠慢他的亲族，不让大臣抱怨没被信用。 君子不要忘忽他亲属。

t: Zhou had eight scholars: Boda, Bokuo, Zhongtu, Zhonghu, Shuye…
y: 周有八士：伯达、伯适、仲突、仲忽、叔夜、叔夏、季随、季騧。
x: Zhou had eight scholars: Boda, Bokuo, Zhongtu, Zhonghu, Shuye, Shuxia, Jisui, and Jigua. 周朝有八位贤士，伯达、伯适、仲突、仲忽、叔夜、叔夏、季随、季騧。 舊云周世有一母四乳而生。 周朝有八个有教养的人：伯达、伯适、仲突、仲忽、叔夜、叔夏… 周代有八个士：伯达、伯适，仲突、仲忽，叔夜、叔夏，…

t: A scholar who, seeing danger, offers his life
y: 子张曰：士见危致命，见得思义，祭思敬，丧思哀，其可已矣。
x: Zizhang said: A scholar who, seeing danger, offers his life; seeing gain, thinks of what is right; at sacrifices, thinks of reverence; in mourning, thinks of grief — such a one will do. 子张说，士人在危险时肯献出生命，遇可得之物想到义，祭祀时想到恭敬，居丧时想到悲哀，这样大概就可以了。 就此篇凡有二十四章，大分為五段，總明弟子稟仰記言行，皆可軌則。 读书人看见危险便肯豁出生命，看见有所得便考虑是否该得，… 一个士，见危难能授命，不爱其身。

t: One who holds to virtue but not broadly, who believes in the…
y: 子张曰：执德不弘，信道不笃，焉能为有？焉能为亡？
x: Zizhang said: One who holds to virtue but not broadly, who believes in the Way but not firmly — how can it be said he has it? How can it be said he lacks it? 子张说，持德不宽弘，信道不坚定，这样的人有他不算有，少他也不算少。 弘，大也；篤，厚也；亡，無也。 对于道德，行为不坚强，信仰不忠实，〔这种人，… 执德不能弘大，信道不能笃实，这样，怎好算他有？

t: Zixia's disciples asked Zizhang about making friends
y: 子夏之门人问交于子张。子张曰：子夏云何？对曰：子夏曰：可者与之，其不可者拒之。子张曰：异乎吾所闻：君子尊贤而容众，嘉善而矜不能。我之大贤与，于人何所不容？我之不贤与，人将拒我，如之何其拒人也？
x: Zixia's disciples asked Zizhang about making friends. Zizhang said: What does Zixia say? They replied: Zixia says, 'Associate with those who are suitable; reject those who are not.' Zizhang said: That is different from what I have heard. The gentleman honors the worthy and embraces the many; he praises the good and pities those who lack ability. If I am greatly worthy, whom could I not embrace? If I am not worthy, others will reject me — how could I reject others? 子夏的学生向子张问交友，转述子夏“可交者交，不可交者拒”的话，子张说，自己听到的不同，君子尊敬贤人而容纳众人，嘉奖善者而体谅能力不足者。自己若很贤，何人不能容纳，自己若不贤，别人将拒绝自己，又如何拒绝别人。 此以下是第三子夏語，自有十一章。 子夏的学生向子张问怎样去交朋友。 子夏的门人问交友之道于子张。

t: Even minor arts surely have something worth seeing
y: 子夏曰：虽小道，必有可观者焉；致远恐泥，是以君子不为也。
x: Zixia said: Even minor arts surely have something worth seeing; but if pursued far, one fears getting bogged down. That is why the gentleman does not pursue them. 子夏说，即使是小的技艺学问，也一定有值得看的地方，不过恐怕会妨碍走向远大的目标，所以君子不以此为业。 云子夏曰云云者，小道謂諸百家之書也。 就是小技艺，一定有可取的地方；恐怕它妨碍远大事业，… 就算是小道，也一定有可观处。

t: One who each day learns what he did not know, and each month…
y: 子夏曰：日知其所亡，月无忘其所能，可谓好学也已矣。
x: Zixia said: One who each day learns what he did not know, and each month does not forget what he has mastered, may be called fond of learning. 子夏说，每天知道自己原来不知道的，每月不忘自己已经掌握的，就可以算好学了。 此勸人學也。 每天知道所未知的，每月复习所已能的，可以说是好学了。 每天能知道所不知道的，每月能不忘了所已能的，可说是好学了。

t: Learn broadly and keep your aims firm
y: 子夏曰：博学而笃志，切问而近思，仁在其中矣。
x: Zixia said: Learn broadly and keep your aims firm; ask earnestly and reflect on what is close at hand. Humaneness lies in this. 子夏说，广泛学习而坚定志向，切实发问而思考切近自身的事，仁便在其中。 亦勸廣學也。 广泛地学习，坚守自己志趣；恳切地发问，多考虑当前的问题，… 博学而能笃守其志，又能就己身亲切处去问，接近处去思，…

t: The hundred artisans stay in their workshops to complete their…
y: 子夏曰：百工居肆以成其事，君子学以致其道。
x: Zixia said: The hundred artisans stay in their workshops to complete their work; the gentleman learns in order to reach his Way. 子夏说，工匠在工场中专心完成各自工作，君子通过学习使自己的道达到完备。 子夏先為設譬，百工者，巧師也。 各种工人居住于其制造场所完成他们的工作，… 百工长日居在肆中以成其器物，君子终身在学之中以求致此道。

t: When the petty man errs, he is sure to gloss it over
y: 子夏曰：小人之过也必文。
x: Zixia said: When the petty man errs, he is sure to gloss it over. 子夏说，小人有了过错，一定要加以掩饰。 君子有過，是已誤行非，故云過也。 小人对于错误一定加以掩饰。 小人有了过失，必把它来文饰。

t: The gentleman has three aspects
y: 子夏曰：君子有三变：望之俨然，即之也温，听其言也厉。
x: Zixia said: The gentleman has three aspects. From afar he looks stern; up close he is warm; when you hear him speak, he is exacting. 子夏说，君子有三种不同的样子，远望庄严，近前温和，听他说话又严正。 云君子有三變者，變者有三也。 君子有三变：远远望着，庄严可畏；向他靠拢，温和可亲；… 一个君子像会有三种的变化。

t: The gentleman wins the trust of his people before he works them
y: 子夏曰：君子信而后劳其民，未信则以为厉己也；信而后谏，未信则以为谤己也。
x: Zixia said: The gentleman wins the trust of his people before he works them; without their trust, they will think he is oppressing them. He wins trust before he remonstrates; without trust, the ruler will think he is slandering him. 子夏说，君子先使百姓信任自己，再使他们出力，否则百姓会认为是在伤害他们，先得到信任再进谏，否则对方会认为是在诽谤自己。 云君子信而後勞其民者，君子謂國君也。 君子必须得到信仰以后才去动员百姓；… 君子等待民众信他了，再来劳使他们。

t: In great matters of virtue, do not overstep the bounds
y: 子夏曰：大德不逾闲，小德出入可也。
x: Zixia said: In great matters of virtue, do not overstep the bounds; in small matters, some leeway is acceptable. 子夏说，大的节操不能越过界限，小的细节略有出入是可以的。 云大德不踰閑者，大德，賢人也。 人的重大节操不能逾越界限，作风上的小节稍稍放松一点是可以的。 人的德行，大处不可逾越界限，小处有一些出入是可以的。

t: Zixia's disciples and young followers are fine when it comes to…
y: 子游曰：子夏之门人小子，当洒扫、应对、进退，则可矣。抑末也，本之则无。如之何？子夏闻之曰：噫！言游过矣！君子之道，孰先传焉？孰后倦焉？譬诸草木，区以别矣。君子之道，焉可诬也？有始有卒者，其惟圣人乎！
x: Ziyou said: Zixia's disciples and young followers are fine when it comes to sprinkling and sweeping, answering and responding, coming forward and withdrawing. But these are mere branches; of the root they have nothing. What about that? Zixia heard this and said: Ah, Yan You is mistaken! In the way of the gentleman, what is to be taught first, and what is to be left until later? It is like plants, which are sorted into kinds. How can the way of the gentleman be falsified? Having both beginning and end — only the sage, perhaps! 子游批评子夏的学生会洒扫、应对、进退，却只有末节、没有根本，子夏听到后说，言游说错了，君子之道，哪里是有的先传授，有的后来便厌倦不教，学习者像草木各有类别，怎能不顾差别而妄教。能从开始到终了全都贯通的，恐怕只有圣人。 云子游曰云云者，門人小子謂子夏之弟子也。 子夏的学生，叫他们做做打扫、接待客人、应对进退的工作，… 子夏的门人小子，担当些洒水扫地，言语应对，…

t: When one in office has energy to spare, he should learn
y: 子夏曰：仕而优则学，学而优则仕。
x: Zixia said: When one in office has energy to spare, he should learn; when one who learns has energy to spare, he should take office. 子夏说，做官尽了职责尚有余力，就去学习，学习有余力，就去做官。 亦勸學也。 做官了，有余力便去学习；学习了，有余力便去做官。 仕者有余力宜从学。

t: In mourning, carry grief to its fullest, and stop there
y: 子游曰：丧致乎哀而止。
x: Ziyou said: In mourning, carry grief to its fullest, and stop there. 子游说，居丧把悲哀尽到极处就可以了。 此以下第三子游語，自有二章。 居丧，充分表现了他的悲哀也就够了。 丧礼只要极尽到遭丧者之哀情便够了。

t: My friend Zhang does what is hard to do
y: 子游曰：吾友张也，为难能也。然而未仁。
x: Ziyou said: My friend Zhang does what is hard to do. Yet he is not yet humane. 子游说，自己的朋友子张做到了难能的事，却还没有达到仁。 云子游曰云云者，張子為人容貌堂堂，儀之難及者也。 我的朋友子张是难能可贵的了，然而还不能做到仁。 我的朋友张呀！

t: How imposing Zhang is! It is hard to practice humaneness…
y: 曾子曰：堂堂乎张也，难与并为仁矣。
x: Zengzi said: How imposing Zhang is! It is hard to practice humaneness alongside him. 曾子说，子张仪表堂堂，但很难同他一道成就仁德。 此以下是第四曾參語，自有四章。 子张的为人高得不可攀了，难以携带别人一同进入仁德。 堂堂乎我的朋友张呀！

t: I have heard from the Master: People never give themselves…
y: 曾子曰：吾闻诸夫子：人未有自致者也，必也亲丧乎！
x: Zengzi said: I have heard from the Master: People never give themselves fully — except, surely, at the mourning of their parents! 曾子说，听老师讲过，人平时未必能把自己的真情完全尽到，到了父母丧亡时才会如此。 曾子據有所聞於孔子也。 我听老师说过，平常时候，人不可能来自动地充分发挥感情，… 我在先生处听过：‘人没有能自己竭尽其情的，…

t: I have heard from the Master: As for the filial piety of Meng…
y: 曾子曰：吾闻诸夫子：孟庄子之孝也，其他可能也；其不改父之臣，与父之政，是难能也。
x: Zengzi said: I have heard from the Master: As for the filial piety of Meng Zhuangzi, the rest of it others could manage; but his not changing his father's ministers or his father's policies — that is hard to manage. 曾子说，听老师讲过，孟庄子的其他孝行或许可以做到，但他不改变父亲任用的臣子和父亲实行的政事，这一点最难做到。 云曾子曰云云者，人子為孝皆以愛敬為體。 我听老师说过：孟庄子的孝，别的都容易做到；… 我听先生说过：‘孟庄子之孝，其他还是可能的，…

t: The Meng family made Yang Fu chief judge, and he asked Zengzi…
y: 孟氏使阳肤为士师，问于曾子。曾子曰：上失其道，民散久矣。如得其情，则哀矜而勿喜。
x: The Meng family made Yang Fu chief judge, and he asked Zengzi for advice. Zengzi said: Those above have lost the Way, and the people have long been scattered. If you get at the truth of a case, feel grief and pity, and do not rejoice. 孟氏让阳肤担任士师，阳肤向曾子请教，曾子说，上面失去治道，百姓的情义离散已经很久，若查明案件实情，应当怜悯他们，不要因此高兴。 云使陽膚為士師者，孟氏，魯下卿也。 孟氏任命阳肤做法官，阳肤向曾子求教。 孟氏使阳肤当治狱官，阳肤去问曾子。

t: Zhou's wickedness was not as extreme as they say
y: 子贡曰：纣之不善，不如是之甚也。是以君子恶居下流，天下之恶皆归焉。
x: Zigong said: Zhou's wickedness was not as extreme as they say. That is why the gentleman hates to dwell in low places, where all the evils of the world flow together. 子贡说，纣的恶并没有传说中那么重，因此君子厌恶把自己置于污下之地，否则天下的恶名都会汇聚到他身上。 此以下是第五子貢語，自有五章。 商纣的坏，不像现在传说的这么厉害。 纣的不善，并不像后世所说的那么过分呀！

t: The faults of the gentleman are like eclipses of the sun and…
y: 子贡曰：君子之过也，如日月之食焉：过也，人皆见之；更也，人皆仰之。
x: Zigong said: The faults of the gentleman are like eclipses of the sun and moon. When he errs, everyone sees it; when he corrects it, everyone looks up to him. 子贡说，君子的过失像日食月食，有过失，人人都看得见，改正了，人人又仰望他。 云子貢曰云云者，日月之蝕非日月故為。 君子的过失好比日蚀月蚀：错误的时候，每个人都看得见；… 君子有过失，好像日蚀月蚀般。

t: Gongsun Chao of Wei asked Zigong: From whom did Zhongni learn?
y: 卫公孙朝问于子贡曰：仲尼焉学？子贡曰：文武之道，未坠于地，在人。贤者识其大者，不贤者识其小者，莫不有文武之道焉。夫子焉不学？而亦何常师之有？
x: Gongsun Chao of Wei asked Zigong: From whom did Zhongni learn? Zigong said: The Way of Kings Wen and Wu has not fallen to the ground; it lives among people. The worthy remember its great parts, the unworthy its small parts; there is no one without something of the Way of Wen and Wu. From whom did the Master not learn? And what need had he of a fixed teacher? 卫国公孙朝问孔子从哪里学习，子贡说，文王武王的道没有失落，在人们那里保存着，贤者记住重要部分，不贤者记住细小部分，没有人完全没有文武之道。老师到哪里不能学，又何必有固定的老师。 云衛公孫朝問云云者，公孫朝，衛人。 周文王、武王之道，并没有失传，散在人间。 仲尼那样的学问，从哪里学来的呀？

t: Shusun Wushu said to the ministers at court: Zigong is worthier…
y: 叔孙武叔语大夫于朝，曰：子贡贤于仲尼。子服景伯以告子贡。子贡曰：譬之宫墙，赐之墙也及肩，窥见室家之好。夫子之墙数仞，不得其门而入，不见宗庙之美，百官之富。得其门者或寡矣。夫子之云，不亦宜乎！
x: Shusun Wushu said to the ministers at court: Zigong is worthier than Zhongni. Zifu Jingbo told Zigong. Zigong said: Compare it to the walls of a house. My wall reaches only to the shoulder, so one can peer over and see the fine rooms inside. The Master's wall is many yards high; unless one finds the gate and goes in, one cannot see the beauty of the ancestral temple or the richness of its many officers. Those who find the gate may be few. That the gentleman should say so — is it not natural? 叔孙武叔在朝廷说子贡胜过孔子，子服景伯转告后，子贡以院墙作比，说自己的墙只到肩膀，外面就能看见室内之好，老师的墙却有几仞高，若找不到门进去，就看不见宗庙之美、众多房舍。能找到门的人或许很少，武叔说出那样的话，也就不足为怪。 云叔孫武叔者，魯大夫也。 子贡比他老师仲尼要强些。 子贡实比仲尼更贤呀。

t: Shusun Wushu disparaged Zhongni
y: 叔孙武叔毁仲尼。子贡曰：无以为也，仲尼不可毁也。他人之贤者，丘陵也，犹可逾也；仲尼，日月也，无得而逾焉。人虽欲自绝，其何伤于日月乎？多见其不知量也！
x: Shusun Wushu disparaged Zhongni. Zigong said: It is no use; Zhongni cannot be disparaged. The worthiness of other men is like hills and mounds, which can still be climbed over. Zhongni is like the sun and moon, which no one can climb over. Though a man may wish to cut himself off from them, what harm does that do the sun and moon? It only shows he does not know his own measure. 叔孙武叔毁谤孔子，子贡说，不要这样做，别人之贤如丘陵，尚可越过，孔子如日月，无从越过，有人想与他断绝关系，也伤不了日月，只显出不自知分量。 叔孫武叔毀仲尼者，猶是前之武叔，又譖毀孔子也。 别人的贤能，好比山丘，还可以超越过去；仲尼，… 叔孙武叔谤毁仲尼。

t: You are just being modest
y: 陈子禽谓子贡曰：子为恭也，仲尼岂贤于子乎？子贡曰：君子一言以为知，一言以为不知，言不可不慎也。夫子之不可及也，犹天之不可阶而升也。夫子之得邦家者，所谓立之斯立，道之斯行，绥之斯来，动之斯和。其生也荣，其死也哀，如之何其可及也。
x: Chen Ziqin said to Zigong: You are just being modest. How could Zhongni be worthier than you? Zigong said: A gentleman is judged wise by one word and foolish by one word; one cannot be careless in speech. That the Master cannot be equaled is like the sky, which cannot be climbed by steps. If the Master had obtained a state or a family to govern, it would have been as they say: he sets them up and they stand, he guides them and they go, he comforts them and they come, he moves them and they live in harmony. In life he was honored, in death he was mourned. How could he be equaled? 陈子禽认为子贡只因谦让才说孔子胜过自己，子贡批评他不谨慎，说君子一句话就能显出有知或无知，孔子不可企及，就像天不能沿着阶梯爬上去。若孔子得到国家或采邑，扶立百姓他们就能立足，引导他们便会跟从，安抚他们便来归附，发动他们便同心和睦，他活着光荣，死后令人悲哀，哪里赶得上。 云陳子禽云云者，子禽既非陳亢，當是同姓名之人也。 高贵人物由一句话表现他的有知，也由一句话表现他的无知，… 你故意作为恭敬的吧？

t: Ah, you, Shun! The succession ordained by Heaven rests in your…
y: 尧曰：咨！尔舜！天之历数在尔躬。允执其中。四海困穷，天禄永终。舜亦以命禹。曰：予小子履，敢用玄牡，敢昭告于皇皇后帝：有罪不敢赦。帝臣不蔽，简在帝心。朕躬有罪，无以万方；万方有罪，罪在朕躬。周有大赉，善人是富。虽有周亲，不如仁人。百姓有过，在予一人。谨权量，审法度，修废官，四方之政行焉。兴灭国，继绝世，举逸民，天下之民归心焉。所重：民、食、丧、祭。宽则得众，信则民任焉，敏则有功，公则说。
x: Yao said: Ah, you, Shun! The succession ordained by Heaven rests in your person. Hold faithfully to the middle. If all within the four seas suffer hardship, Heaven's bounty will end forever. Shun likewise charged Yu with this. Tang said: I, the little one, Lü, dare to offer a black bull and dare to announce plainly to the most august Lord on High: the guilty I dare not pardon; your servants I will not conceal; the choice rests in your heart, O Lord. If I myself am guilty, let it not fall on the people of the myriad lands; if the people of the myriad lands are guilty, let the guilt rest on me. Zhou bestowed great gifts, and good men were enriched. 'Though I have close kin, they are not equal to humane men. If the people have faults, they rest on me alone.' He set weights and measures with care, examined the statutes, restored the offices that had lapsed, and government prevailed in all four quarters. He revived states that had been destroyed, restored lines that had been cut off, raised up men who had withdrawn, and the people of the realm gave him their hearts. What he gave weight to: the people, food, mourning, and sacrifice. Generosity wins the many; good faith earns the people's reliance; diligence brings results; fairness brings contentment. 尧把帝位传给舜，嘱他诚守中道，百姓若陷困穷，天赐之位便会永远断绝，舜后来也这样告诫禹；汤以黑色牡牛告祭上帝，说有罪不敢赦免，贤臣不敢掩没，上帝自会察知，自己有罪不要牵连天下，天下有罪由自己承担，周朝大加赏赐，使善人富足，又说至亲不如仁人、百姓有过由自己一人负责。谨慎校正衡器量器，审定法制，恢复废置官职，四方政事便能推行，恢复被灭的国、延续断绝的世系、举用遗逸之人，天下百姓便归心，所重的是百姓、粮食、丧礼、祭祀，宽厚可得众，守信可得民任，勤敏可成事，公正可使人喜悦。 云堯曰者，古聖天子所言也。 上天的大命已经落到你的身上了，诚实地保持着那正确罢！ 唉！

t: Zizhang asked Confucius: What must one do to take part in…
y: 子张问于孔子曰：何如斯可以从政矣？子曰：尊五美，屏四恶，斯可以从政矣。子张曰：何谓五美？子曰：君子惠而不费，劳而不怨，欲而不贪，泰而不骄，威而不猛。子张曰：何谓惠而不费？子曰：因民之所利而利之，斯不亦惠而不费乎？择可劳而劳之，又谁怨？欲仁而得仁，又焉贪？君子无众寡，无小大，无敢慢，斯不亦泰而不骄乎？君子正其衣冠，尊其瞻视，俨然人望而畏之，斯不亦威而不猛乎？子张曰：何谓四恶？子曰：不教而杀，谓之虐。不戒视成，谓之暴。慢令致期，谓之贼。犹之与人也，出纳之吝；谓之有司。
x: Zizhang asked Confucius: What must one do to take part in government? The Master said: Honor the five excellences and banish the four evils; then you may take part in government. Zizhang said: What are the five excellences? The Master said: The gentleman is generous without being wasteful, works the people without their resenting it, desires without being greedy, is at ease without being arrogant, and is commanding without being fierce. Zizhang said: What is meant by generous without being wasteful? The Master said: To benefit the people by what benefits them — is that not generous without being wasteful? To choose what work is fit and have them do it — who will resent it? To desire humaneness and attain it — what greed is there? The gentleman, whether dealing with many or few, with great or small, never dares be negligent — is that not being at ease without arrogance? The gentleman straightens his robe and cap and makes his gaze dignified, so that people look on him with awe — is that not commanding without being fierce? Zizhang said: What are the four evils? The Master said: To execute without having taught is called cruelty. To demand results without having given warning is called tyranny. To be slack in giving orders yet insist on deadlines is called harming. And to give to people grudgingly, as if one were the clerk in charge of stores — that is called being a petty official. 子张问怎样才能从政，孔子说要尊行五美、除去四恶，五美是施惠而不耗费、使民劳而不招怨、有所欲而不贪、安舒而不傲慢、有威仪而不凶猛，顺民本来的利益使他们得利就是施惠不费，选择合宜的劳动使民劳便无怨，求仁而得仁便不是贪，不论人多人少、势大势小都不轻慢便是安舒不骄，端正衣冠、严肃目光，使人望而敬畏便是有威不猛。四恶是不先教导便杀人，叫虐，不先告诫便责成，叫暴，起初怠慢下令却逼人按期完成，叫贼，同样是把东西给人，却吝啬地不肯爽快付出，叫小吏式的作风。 此章第二，明孔子同於堯舜諸聖為政之義也。 尊贵五种美德，排除四种恶政，这就可以治理政事了。 如何始可从事政治呀？

t: Without knowing fate, one cannot be a gentleman
y: 子曰：不知命，无以为君子也。不知礼，无以立也。不知言，无以知人也。
x: The Master said: Without knowing fate, one cannot be a gentleman. Without knowing ritual, one cannot stand. Without knowing words, one cannot know people. 孔子说，不懂天命，不能成为君子，不懂礼，不能立身，不懂分辨言语，就不能了解人。 此章第三，明為君子所以為政也。 不懂得命运，没有可能作为君子；不懂得礼，… 不知命，便无以为君子。

t: The Way that can be told is not the constant Way
y: 道可道，非常道；名可名，非常名。無名，天地之始；有名，萬物之母。故常無欲，以觀其妙；常有欲，以觀其徼。此兩者，同出而異名，同謂之玄。玄之又玄，衆妙之門。
x: The Way that can be told is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name. Nameless, it is the beginning of heaven and earth; named, it is the mother of the ten thousand things. So, ever without desire, one sees its subtlety; ever with desire, one sees where it ends. These two come out together but are named differently; together they are called the dark. Dark upon dark: the gate of all subtleties.

t: When all under heaven know beauty as beauty, there is…
y: 天下皆知美之為美，斯惡已；皆知善之為善，斯不善已。故有無相生，難易相成，長短相較，高下相傾，音聲相和，前後相隨。是以聖人處無為之事，行不言之教，萬物作焉而不辭，生而不有，為而不恃，功成而弗居。夫唯弗居，是以不去。
x: When all under heaven know beauty as beauty, there is already ugliness; when all know good as good, there is already the not-good. So being and non-being give birth to each other, hard and easy complete each other, long and short measure each other, high and low lean on each other, note and voice harmonize with each other, front and back follow each other. Therefore the sage abides in doing without contrivance and practices the teaching without words. The ten thousand things arise and he does not turn them away; he gives them life but does not possess them, acts but does not rely on it, completes the work but does not dwell in it. Because he does not dwell in it, it never leaves him.

t: Do not exalt the worthy, and the people will not contend
y: 不尚賢，使民不爭；不貴難得之貨，使民不為盜；不見可欲，使民心不亂。是以聖人之治，虛其心，實其腹，弱其志，强其骨。常使民無知無欲，使夫智者不敢為也。為無為，則無不治。
x: Do not exalt the worthy, and the people will not contend. Do not prize goods hard to get, and the people will not steal. Do not display what can be desired, and the people's hearts will not be stirred. So the sage governs by emptying their hearts and filling their bellies, softening their ambitions and strengthening their bones. He keeps the people without cunning and without craving, and sees that the clever do not dare to act. Act without contrivance, and nothing will be left ungoverned.

t: The Way is empty, yet in use it is never filled
y: 道沖而用之或不盈，淵兮似萬物之宗。挫其銳，解其紛，和其光，同其塵，湛兮似或存。吾不知誰之子，象帝之先。
x: The Way is empty, yet in use it is never filled; deep, it seems the ancestor of the ten thousand things. It blunts the sharp, unties the tangled, softens the glare, and mingles with the dust. Still and clear, it seems perhaps to be there. I do not know whose child it is; it seems to come before the Lord on High.

t: Heaven and earth are not humane
y: 天地不仁，以萬物為芻狗；聖人不仁，以百姓為芻狗。天地之間，其猶橐籥乎？虛而不屈，動而愈出。多言數窮，不如守中。
x: Heaven and earth are not humane; they treat the ten thousand things as straw dogs. The sage is not humane; he treats the people as straw dogs. The space between heaven and earth, is it not like a bellows? Empty, yet never exhausted; the more it moves, the more comes out. Many words soon run out; better to keep to the center.

t: The spirit of the valley never dies
y: 谷神不死，是謂玄牝。玄牝之門，是謂天地根。綿綿若存，用之不勤。
x: The spirit of the valley never dies; it is called the dark female. The gate of the dark female is called the root of heaven and earth. Unbroken, as if always there; use it, and it never wears out.

t: Heaven endures and earth lasts
y: 天長地久。天地所以能長且久者，以其不自生，故能長生。是以聖人後其身而身先，外其身而身存。非以其無私耶？故能成其私。
x: Heaven endures and earth lasts. Heaven and earth can endure and last because they do not live for themselves; so they live long. Therefore the sage puts himself last and finds himself first, treats himself as outside and finds himself preserved. Is it not because he has no self-interest? So he can fulfill himself.

t: The highest good is like water
y: 上善若水。水善利萬物而不爭，處衆人之所惡，故幾於道。居善地，心善淵，與善仁，言善信，正善治，事善能，動善時。夫唯不爭，故無尤。
x: The highest good is like water. Water benefits the ten thousand things and does not contend; it stays in the places people dislike, and so it is close to the Way. In dwelling, good is the ground; in the heart, good is depth; in giving, good is kindness; in speech, good is trust; in governing, good is order; in affairs, good is ability; in action, good is timing. Because it does not contend, it incurs no blame.

t: To hold a thing and fill it to the brim is not as good as…
y: 持而盈之，不如其已；揣而棁之，不可長保。金玉滿堂，莫之能守；富貴而驕，自遺其咎。功遂身退，天之道。
x: To hold a thing and fill it to the brim is not as good as stopping in time. Hammer an edge to sharpness and it cannot keep for long. A hall full of gold and jade, no one can guard it; wealth and rank with arrogance bring their own ruin. When the work is done, step back: that is the Way of heaven.

t: Carrying the soul and embracing the One, can you keep them…
y: 載營魄抱一，能無離乎？專氣致柔，能嬰兒乎？滌除玄覽，能無疵乎？愛民治國，能無知乎？天門開闔，能無雌乎？明白四達，能無為乎？生之畜之，生而不有，為而不恃，長而不宰，是謂玄德。
x: Carrying the soul and embracing the One, can you keep them from parting? Concentrating your breath to reach softness, can you be like an infant? Cleansing the dark mirror, can you leave no flaw? Loving the people and governing the state, can you do without cunning? As heaven's gate opens and closes, can you play the female? Clear and bright in every direction, can you do without contrivance? It gives life and rears them; gives life but does not possess, acts but does not rely on it, raises them but does not rule them. This is called dark virtue.

t: Thirty spokes share one hub
y: 三十輻共一轂，當其無，有車之用。埏埴以為器，當其無，有器之用。鑿戶牖以為室，當其無，有室之用。故有之以為利，無之以為用。
x: Thirty spokes share one hub; it is the empty space that makes the cart useful. Clay is shaped into a vessel; it is the empty space that makes the vessel useful. Doors and windows are cut to make a room; it is the empty space that makes the room useful. So what is there gives the benefit, and what is not there gives the use.

t: The five colors blind the eye, the five notes deafen the…
y: 五色令人目盲，五音令人耳聾，五味令人口爽，馳騁畋獵令人心發狂，難得之貨令人行妨。是以聖人為腹不為目，故去彼取此。
x: The five colors blind the eye, the five notes deafen the ear, the five flavors dull the palate; racing and hunting madden the heart, and goods hard to get hinder one's conduct. Therefore the sage cares for the belly, not the eye. So he rejects that and takes this.

t: Favor and disgrace alike are alarming
y: 寵辱若驚，貴大患若身。何謂寵辱若驚？寵為下，得之若驚，失之若驚，是謂寵辱若驚。何謂貴大患若身？吾所以有大患者，為吾有身；及吾無身，吾有何患？故貴以身為天下，若可寄天下；愛以身為天下，若可託天下。
x: Favor and disgrace alike are alarming; prize great trouble as you prize your body. What does it mean that favor and disgrace alike are alarming? Favor is lowly: gaining it is alarming, losing it is alarming. That is what it means. What does it mean to prize great trouble as your body? The reason I have great trouble is that I have a body; if I had no body, what trouble would I have? So one who prizes his own person as he would the world can be entrusted with the world; one who loves his own person as he would the world can be given the world in trust.

t: Looked at but not seen, it is called the invisible
y: 視之不見名曰夷，聽之不聞名曰希，搏之不得名曰微。此三者不可致詰，故混而為一。其上不皦，其下不昧，繩繩不可名，復歸於無物。是謂無狀之狀，無物之象，是謂惚恍。迎之不見其首，隨之不見其後。執古之道，以御今之有。能知古始，是謂道紀。
x: Looked at but not seen, it is called the invisible; listened to but not heard, it is called the inaudible; grasped at but not caught, it is called the intangible. These three cannot be fathomed, so they blend into one. Its top is not bright, its bottom not dark; unending, it cannot be named, and it returns again to nothing. This is the shape without shape, the image without a thing; it is called the elusive and evasive. Meet it and you do not see its head; follow it and you do not see its back. Hold to the Way of old to manage what exists today. To know the ancient beginning is called the thread of the Way.

t: Those of old who were good at being officers were subtle…
y: 古之善為士者，微妙玄通，深不可識。夫唯不可識，故强為之容：豫焉若冬涉川，猶兮若畏四鄰，儼兮其若容，渙兮若冰之將釋，敦兮其若樸，曠兮其若谷，混兮其若濁。孰能濁以靜之徐清？孰能安以久動之徐生？保此道者不欲盈。夫唯不盈，故能蔽不新成。
x: Those of old who were good at being officers were subtle, mysterious, profound, and penetrating, too deep to be known. Because they cannot be known, I can only describe them by force: hesitant, as if crossing a river in winter; wary, as if fearing neighbors on all sides; dignified, like a guest; yielding, like ice about to melt; simple, like uncarved wood; open, like a valley; murky, like muddy water. Who can make the muddy still and slowly clear? Who can make the calm move for long and slowly come to life? Those who keep this Way do not wish to be full. Because they are not full, they can stay worn and not be newly made.

t: Reach the utmost emptiness
y: 致虛極，守靜篤。萬物並作，吾以觀復。夫物芸芸，各復歸其根。歸根曰靜，是謂復命。復命曰常，知常曰明。不知常，妄作凶。知常容，容乃公，公乃王，王乃天，天乃道，道乃久，沒身不殆。
x: Reach the utmost emptiness; hold fast to stillness. The ten thousand things rise together, and I watch them return. Things flourish in abundance, and each returns to its root. Returning to the root is called stillness; this is called returning to one's destiny. Returning to destiny is called the constant; knowing the constant is called clarity. Not knowing the constant, one acts recklessly and meets misfortune. Knowing the constant, one is all-embracing; all-embracing, one is impartial; impartial, one is kingly; kingly, one is like heaven; like heaven, one is with the Way; with the Way, one endures, and to the end of life one is in no danger.

t: The best rulers
y: 太上，下知有之；其次，親而譽之；其次，畏之；其次，侮之。信不足焉，有不信焉。悠兮其貴言。功成事遂，百姓皆謂我自然。
x: The best rulers: those below merely know they exist. Next: they are loved and praised. Next: they are feared. Next: they are despised. When trust is lacking, there is distrust. Unhurried, the best ruler values his words. The work is done, the task achieved, and the people all say, "We did it naturally ourselves."

t: When the great Way is abandoned, there are humaneness and…
y: 大道廢，有仁義；慧智出，有大偽；六親不和，有孝慈；國家昏亂，有忠臣。
x: When the great Way is abandoned, there are humaneness and righteousness. When cleverness and knowledge appear, there is great falseness. When the six relations are out of harmony, there are filial piety and parental love. When the state is in disorder, there are loyal ministers.

t: Cut off sageliness, discard knowledge, and the people will…
y: 絕聖棄智，民利百倍；絕仁棄義，民復孝慈；絕巧棄利，盜賊無有。此三者以為文不足，故令有所屬：見素抱樸，少私寡欲。
x: Cut off sageliness, discard knowledge, and the people will benefit a hundredfold. Cut off humaneness, discard righteousness, and the people will return to filial piety and love. Cut off craft, discard profit, and there will be no thieves. These three, taken as ornament, are not enough; so let people have something to hold to: show plainness, embrace the uncarved, lessen self-interest, reduce desires.

t: Cut off learning and there will be no worries
y: 絕學無憂。唯之與阿，相去幾何？善之與惡，相去若何？人之所畏，不可不畏。荒兮其未央哉！衆人熙熙，如享太牢，如春登臺。我獨泊兮其未兆，如嬰兒之未孩；儽儽兮若無所歸。衆人皆有餘，而我獨若遺。我愚人之心也哉！沌沌兮。俗人昭昭，我獨昏昏；俗人察察，我獨悶悶。澹兮其若海，飂兮若無止。衆人皆有以，而我獨頑似鄙。我獨異於人，而貴食母。
x: Cut off learning and there will be no worries. Between a yes and a yeah, how much difference is there? Between good and bad, how far apart are they? What others fear, one cannot but fear. How vast, with no end in sight! The crowd is merry, as if feasting at a great sacrifice, as if climbing a terrace in spring. I alone am placid, giving no sign, like an infant who has not yet learned to smile; listless, as if with nowhere to return. The crowd all have more than enough, and I alone seem to have lost out. Mine is the heart of a fool! Muddled and dull. Ordinary people are bright; I alone am dim. Ordinary people are sharp; I alone am dull. Calm like the sea, drifting as if without rest. The crowd all have their uses; I alone am stubborn and rustic. I alone differ from others, and I prize being fed by the mother.

t: The bearing of great virtue follows the Way alone
y: 孔德之容，惟道是從。道之為物，惟恍惟惚。惚兮恍兮，其中有象；恍兮惚兮，其中有物；窈兮冥兮，其中有精。其精甚真，其中有信。自古及今，其名不去，以閱衆甫。吾何以知衆甫之狀哉？以此。
x: The bearing of great virtue follows the Way alone. The Way as a thing is elusive and evasive. Evasive and elusive, yet within it there is an image; elusive and evasive, yet within it there is a thing. Dim and dark, yet within it there is an essence; that essence is utterly real, and within it there is trust. From of old until now its name has never gone, and by it we see the beginning of all things. How do I know what the beginning of all things is like? By this.

t: Bent, then whole
y: 曲則全，枉則直，窪則盈，敝則新，少則得，多則惑。是以聖人抱一為天下式。不自見故明，不自是故彰，不自伐故有功，不自矜故長。夫唯不爭，故天下莫能與之爭。古之所謂曲則全者，豈虛言哉？誠全而歸之。
x: Bent, then whole; crooked, then straight; hollow, then full; worn, then new; little, then gain; much, then confusion. Therefore the sage embraces the One and becomes the model for the world. He does not show himself, so he is seen clearly; he does not insist he is right, so he is recognized; he does not boast, so he has merit; he does not brag, so he lasts. Because he does not contend, no one in the world can contend with him. What the ancients said, "Bent, then whole," was it an empty saying? Truly, wholeness returns to him.

t: To speak little is natural
y: 希言自然。故飄風不終朝，驟雨不終日。孰為此者？天地。天地尚不能久，而況於人乎？故從事於道者，道者同於道，德者同於德，失者同於失。同於道者，道亦樂得之；同於德者，德亦樂得之；同於失者，失亦樂得之。信不足焉，有不信焉。
x: To speak little is natural. So a whirlwind does not last the morning, a downpour does not last the day. Who makes these? Heaven and earth. If even heaven and earth cannot keep them going long, how much less can man? So one who follows the Way in his affairs: with those of the Way, he is one with the Way; with those of virtue, one with virtue; with those who have lost, one with loss. One with the Way, the Way gladly receives him; one with virtue, virtue gladly receives him; one with loss, loss gladly receives him. When trust is lacking, there is distrust.

t: On tiptoe, one cannot stand
y: 企者不立，跨者不行，自見者不明，自是者不彰，自伐者無功，自矜者不長。其在道也，曰餘食贅行。物或惡之，故有道者不處。
x: On tiptoe, one cannot stand; with straddling strides, one cannot walk. One who shows himself is not seen clearly; one who insists he is right is not recognized; one who boasts has no merit; one who brags does not last.
